I love ERIK. He is the best professor at the school. He somehow made Excel fun and enjoyable, and I actively wanted to learn it in every class. I would recommend him to everyone.

He is a great professor!  I had never used Excel before this course, but he clearly explained every task.  During the lecture, he walks through everything with you and pauses often to make sure everyone understands.  He cares a lot about his students and really loves teaching this class.

Best professor at the University of Oregon. I also had him for BA 240 and these have been some of my favorite classes here. You can tell he loves his job and wants to see every single one of his students succeed, not only in his classes, but in life.

Man I love this guy. He's wildly entertaining. He's just a regular dude with a day job that's also great at teaching. He teaches the same two courses and has for like a decade. For BA 101 just go to class and participate, and for BA 240 if the homework is hard, take advantage of the daily office hours and study sessions with various GEs.

Erik is the best teacher at the UO. Super knowledgeable and cares about his students not just as a professor, but also as a mentor in the business world. Take a class with him and you'll walk away feeling like you learned so much.

2nd course I've taken with him, he's definitely my favorite professor at UO. His lectures were very clear and are very accessible for both pc and mac users. I used my ipad to watch the lectures while following along on my mac. This course was very enjoyable, and I highly recommend taking this course online so you can follow along at your own pace.

Erik Ford has been my favorite professor at the UO. He not only has a lot of passion for business but is also there to support your goals in and outside of the classroom. Grade wise there are 3 exams each 20% of the grade book. The class average tends to be ~83%. 6+ Hours of study per test for an A.
I would highly recommend you take BA 101 with him

Erik is an amazing guy who clearly loves his job and working with students. I found his class to be super useful in learning a hard skill as a business major. All of the content was well-organized and paced, easy to follow along. Definitely recommend a class with him!

Erik Ford is so awesome, he really wants you to succeed and will work with you to get you back on track. I got super sick and missed two weeks of class, assignments, and tests. I emailed him week 8 about it and he not only let me make up all the missing work, but allowed me to take the tests I missed in my discussion. TAKE ANY CLASS FROM HIM!!
The greatest teacher I have ever had was an easy class but gave me valuable real-life business skills I'll use for the rest of my life.
The GOAT!!!!

Dr. Ford's class is extremely well structured, and he is a great teacher. Aside from showing up to class, there is not a lot of outside work that needs to be done. The class is consistent and well organized and Dr. Ford is an excellent and helpful teacher.

He sets you up for success for the online version of this class. As long as you stay on top of the due dates and watch the video lectures it is very easy to pass. He also makes sure you are very very prepared for the weekly lab exams and midterms. Overall he's a really great professor!
Great Professor with engaging lectures. By far the best teacher I had during my first two terms at UO.
If you apply yourself there is no reason to not pass this class. He gives you so many opportunities to pass the class, although there are quizzes every week, he more than prepares you for them.

I dont know if I am just stupid but make sure if you are taking the online version of BA101 to study because I did not study that much but did all the assignments and did horribly on the 3 midterms. However he did bump everyones grade up by 5% at the end. I got 3 60%s on the midterms and still passed with a B overall. Great teacher and funny guy
I could not say enough positive things about taking BA101 with Erik Ford. He makes the concepts digestible and is overall an amazing, straightforward, and receptive professor.

I learned more in this class than I did all of last year combined. On top of that, the class really is not hard at seal you just need to pay attention and do the homework and I found the homework to be kinda fun.

If you gotta take BA 101, do it with Prof. Ford. He's funny and self aware and made it interesting. I never had to take notes, tests are taken off the slides. He's very funny, and makes a 300 person lecture very personal, and also treats it like stand up. I also learned things as well which is what you are probably trying to see from this website.

This is my second time taking a class with the goat, Erik Ford. I truly love him as a professor. I had no idea I would like Excel as much as I do now. You have to work for it in this class. It is time-consuming, but it's worth it. 2 Midterms and a "class" every Tuesday/Thursday, my only complaint is it being P/NP, could've gotten an A+ if it wasn't
Such a good professor, really cares about his students and makes class fun and engaging. I would 100% recommend him to anyone

Erik Ford is the GOAT. He stands out because of his engaging teaching style, deep expertise, and genuine care for his students' success. He creates a welcoming environment for learning, inspires critical thinking, and goes above and beyond to ensure everyone understands the material. His passion truly motivates and empowers students!

I really enjoyed taking BA101 with professor Ford. His teaching style was very engaging, humorous but thorough. Online resources organized well, he made himself accessible and made us aware of other supportive resources. I also appreciated his transparency regarding exam preparation, suggesting affective way to study and best materials to review.
All I can say is, I don't care what your major is, take a class taught by Erik! He will change your life!

Literally the best prof ever. Cares about his students and what he's teaching, super engaging and informative, not a lot of work but the work you do really helps. Love him so much and you can't find a better prof than him
Love this guy, good class

The greatest prof literally ever. Cares a lot about his subject and students, super clear on directions and grading, nicest guy ever. Took the class for an easy A and he was so engaging I was actually interested in the Course. Easy A, very engaging, great prof.

Kindest, most interesting, best prof I've taken. I did the online course. moderate amount of work, none of it too hard. he really cares about what he does and his students. im not a business major, took it for a gen ed class. absolutely great guy and class, would def recommend .

Hands down the best professor I've ever had. If you want to take a perfectly formatted course where you will fully learn a marketable skill (Excel) that is usable in almost every field with a professor who knows what he's doing, take BA 240 with Ford. Ford is the GOAT.

Professor Ford's BA240 class is a breeze. Attend the lectures and use resources like Unstuck AI for easy prep, and you're set for an A. Engaging classes, no textbook needed - just an enjoyable learning experience overall.

He's a very active professor. Loves to include the students in on the lectures and requests proper feedback once in a while on what can be improved in the class. In some ways, he's strict with his grading policies and deadlines but if you stay on top of things and organize yourself, this class will go wonderfully. Overall, a really good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Erik Ford is easily the best professor I have ever had at UO. For those unfamiliar with the course, it is P/NP for everyone, so it does not affect your GPA. If you get a decent grade, you'll receive the P and can move on. Professor Ford cares about his students and goes above and beyond to help. I highly recommend him! Take it online if you can.

This man is knowledgeable and reasonable. Use your time wisely and have fun learning from him. I have heard some complain about his late work policy and what not but I think his policies are 100% reasonable. Easy class, a bit homework heavy but that is how you learn. I can't wait for the rest of the BA sequence with him.

Super chill professor and class materials. Make sure to attend class because he essentially prepares you how to do the homework/following weeks quiz, super easy and engaging lectures. The two midterms are a bit difficult but if you practice often you should be good

This was the best class Ive taken at UO. Erik provides engaging lectures and he's really passionate about the topics he teaches. 3 midterms worth 60% of your grade but he curves the end of the course. Midterms are fairly easy as long as you take notes in class and study. I would recommend everyone takes a class from Erik Ford at least once.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Seriously such a cool professor with so much passion for teaching and business. He explained every concept SO well and used lots of examples for each term. Best professor I've had so far. He also was super accepting when I was out sick for a week and a half and helped me out. 11/10 professor, def take his class if you need the credits.
Easy to follow class after the first week. Great professor and online class
Goat
Not much to say. Everybody knows Erik Ford is an elite level professor.

Literally the easiest class I've taken at UO. There's a few assignments each week but they all build on each other. Do it at your own pace type vibe. Just watch the videos on 2.0 speed and attend the labs. It's pass/fail so as long as you have an 81% you're chilling. Great professor too.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: As someone who is not a business major and just took this as an elective, although I did not really like the business world Erik is a great instructor who is very passionate and cares about what he teaches. Gives good lectures with good real-life examples.

Erik is super enthusiastic about business, amazing professor even if you're not very interested in business (like me). Includes a lot examples and good real-life explanations for much of the material which can help keep the lectures interesting. Exams are very term-heavy so I recommend making flashcards for each lecture.
Super enthusiastic and caring. I enjoyed being in his class a lot.

For him to have such a high rating on here makes a lot of sense to me. Erik LOVES teaching his students and dose a great job at it. With the textbook being online it made the assignments really easy. For getting information you can ether pay attention in class or read the textbook but you don't have to do both. I really enjoyed being in his class.

Mr. Ford was one of the kindest and most caring professors I have had at UO. His class is easy to follow, he is incredibly enthusiastic about the topics he teaches. This energy creates such a great learning environment and makes his lectures very unique and enjoyable. I would highly recommend taking one of his classes, he truly is one of the best.
goat.
Very helpful and cares about his students

It's a pass/no pass class and he will pass you as long as you have an 82% or only have 3 or less missing assignments. Erik is such an amazing teacher definitely the best I've had at UO so far. He is clearly very enthusiastic about the topic. Material is so easy and excel is super self explanatory, you do have to show up to class though.
Most enthusiastic and caring professor I've had.

Professor Ford is one of the best instructors I've ever had in my life. He's very kind, funny and empathetic. He just wants you to learn the content and have a good time while doing it. I would recommend BA101 to any students at UO if you can take it with professor Ford. 10/10 professor.

Everything people say about Erik Ford is true. He has been my favorite professor thus far. Taking BA240 online was an incredible choice since his lecture videos are in-depth and easy to follow from home. If you ever get the opportunity, please take his class.

I took BA 101 with Prof Ford and loved him so much, I took him again for BA 240. Super easy class if you just follow along in the demos. I found the material incredibly useful in classes, work, and life outside of BA 240. It's a pass or fail class. Ford makes it engaging and is always willing to help if you have any questions! Easy with a Mac or PC

I took Professor Ford for BA 101 and he is incredible! He is engaging in lectures, even in online classes. The work each week is very clear, and follows a similar pattern, so you can always know what to expect and balance your work load with other classes. The was little stress; if you study for midterms, you should easily pass this class.

Not the easiest class, especially for an intro class, but Ford makes this class enjoyable. He is well-respected amongst students for a good reason. He wants his students to do well and you can tell that. Sometimes we suspect he's on something because no one can truly be that excited about Business all the time. Great guy, can't wait to take BA240.

Professor Ford has such an amazing personality, and he shows that he has passion in teaching the material in the lecture videos. The lectures were never boring because his enthusiasm keeps the videos going. BA 240 is manageable, so you should be able to pass this class. It does be time consuming, but you would be able to ace the exams.
BA240 online is a cool class applicable right away. It's about 1.5 hours of work to do each classes work but the work is clear and concise and hes a pretty fun guy in his videos.

Erik Ford is a great teacher and has a bubbly personality that radiates throughout his class, I took online BA 101  and it was a good class but wouldn't recommend if you learn bad online. The tests were decently easy, at the end of the day it's BA101.

Erik Ford is literally the best! One of the most useful classes I've ever taken. Really loves teaching Excel and does whatever he can to help. The homework and tests are extremely easy. I genuinely looked forward to his class, and the career fundamental assignments were actually very helpful!
Kind of like the south park professor how he says mkay every sentence, but this guy is great. Easy class, if you pay attention in lecture you're guaranteed to pass.
Class is pass fail and you will pass if you just do the work, or most of it. Very easy to follow in lecture.

I absolutely love online business 240 with professor ford. His animation at the beginning of class gets me excited and I have really enjoyed the structure and content of the course. I also have enjoyed an online course, being able to speed up/ slow down lectures when I want is excellent. I would recommend to anyone.

The online class was well put together, but it was a bit of a pain to be restricted on how far ahead you could go. The video lectures were nice, because I could scan through them a little faster. 

VERY test heavy! The exams are something you need to know exact terms and what acronyms stand for rather than concepts. Memorize stuff. He emails back(:

I definitely recommend taking spreadsheet analysis with Professor Ford! He makes the course very easy to follow and almost impossible to fail. You'll be alright as long as you show up to the lectures and do your work on time.
Awesome professor who notably cares about his students. I found he was super easy to get in contact with outside of class and really showed commitment to helping his students.
Erik is the best. Easy class and he's a great teacher who is ready to help whenever needed. Very accessible outside of class and the material isn't hard at all. You got this !

Professor Ford has easily been the best teacher at UO! I have had him for both BA 240 and BA101 and he is truly a special teacher! He puts so much time and effort into teaching and he truly loves it! BA 240 was so fun, he was very energetic and made it super easy to follow and understand! I just want to say thank you for an amazing class!

I love Erik! He is super caring and passionate about what he is doing! If you ever have any questions, he is super easy to talk to, and I felt like I learned so much from his class. Would 10/10 recommend!
Mr. Ford is great. Only thing is his slides go a little fast sometimes but he posts them later for you to copy. Super nice and cool guy
Take a class with Erik Ford! He's amazing.

An absolute legend who cares a lot about excel. He is really good at teaching the skills needed to do well in his class. Weakly quizzes on the material from the week but they are very simple and easy.
Just a standout human being, we need more people like Erik Ford in our world.

Great teacher, very clear that he cares about you and loves teaching! Took the course online and it was a bit homework heavy but isn't too bad. Personally not my favorite subject but Mr. Ford makes it not too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This has been my absolute favorite professor at UO. If you go to classes and do all the homework you'll pass. He responds very quickly to any email questions and wants you to succeed.

ford exceeded all my expectations! I felt like I learned so many skills in this class and he made it so easy! the nicest and most enthusiastic guy you'll meet. class is not hard- just do the work, it doesn't even take that long. I don't know anyone who doesn't like erik ford. he is THE excel guy but I'm sure any class with him would be great.

Ed was a solid professor. The class wasn't my favorite class due to the topics and I didn't always feel engaged just because it was somewhat basic. But, Ed was a very good professor that has a very diverse work background that makes the class interesting. The assignments were very easy, excluding the final.

Honestly, he is my favorite professor in UO. He truly does care about the students and not a tough grader. And also his lecture was pretty interesting too. Just participate well and you will not have any problem.

Ed Madison was one of the best teachers I have ever had at the University of Oregon. He made a big impact on my life, and inspired me to do great work. This course is extremely easy, as long as you participate in class, and start the final project early.

Madison is well-versed in the industry which makes him a respected source, but as a teacher, I was not a fan. He's enthralled with AI in a way that isn't relevant to course content, so much so that we had to go to the dean about it to get him back on track. More importantly, the way he lectures is grating and disengaging. I'd avoid him if you can.

Ed is super respected & knowledgeable in the field of communication. He's very friendly and his lectures and assignments are not challenging. But this class is boring, repetitive, and leans way too heavily into AI. He 100% used AI to grade my final project because his submission comment referenced things that weren't even in it. Very disappointing.

Love this class! His assignments are very insightful and almost therapeutic. They get you thinking without being very challenging. He does talk about AI excessively, but I think it's an important discussion topic for our field of work. Very generous grading. This class is really what you make of it! Participation is key.
He was a great professor and the work was insightful but not super challenging.

I dread coming to this class. Ed regularly shows AI-generated content, and pushes our use of AI for in-class projects. I don't think SOJC faculty should be supporting AI-dependency for undergrad students who are just developing our skills. Even if not his intention, that is what is happening. If you are anti-ai and pro-critical thinking, avoid!

He was one of the coolest and most chill professors I've ever had. Lots of group work and tons of interaction with the class, asking them questions and expanding on their answers. Overall, a super laid-back dude, very friendly and approachable. I found the class (JCOM 202) to be super interesting.

Super awesome professor! He's very understanding and even let me take my final presentation early after I asked him due to being out of town on the original day of my presentation. He's always down to talk as well and help you with whatever! 10/10 professor.
Ed Madison is a good teacher, the class was not difficult and was interesting to participate in. It was a lot more hands on learning instead of lecturing.

GOAT! Super interesting class and lots of engaging conversations. This class is definitely what you make of it, so if you participate/engage you will like the class more. He is super laidback and kind. The weekly assignments were somewhat lengthy and tedious but if you do it ahead of time its ok.

While we didn't hear a lot from Professor Madison due to having guest speakers each class, I really enjoyed having Professor Madison for J100. He was supper approachable and would always give good feedback.

He wasn't ever involved in the class since it was guest lecture-based. My only complaint about Prof. Madison is that I wish he would've spoken up more about the level of noise from students while guests were presenting. It was very hard to pay attention. Nonetheless, it is a very easy class.

For J100, the professor isn't necessarily involved in the course. Every class was a different speaker, so Madison mainly talked about our reading for the course on occasion. The class was fun and easy, and the professor assigned a low amount of work with relatively clear instructions. Note that attendance is taken and counted towards your grade.

The instructor himself is okay but his classes are very easy and it's a good way to get some credit done without having to put in too much work. Unfortunately, it can get a little annoying asking him about grading material because him and his GE's don't seem too communicate too much about their criteria.

literally so easy. all you had to do was just show up to class and sit there. there were guest speakers in every class and we just listened to them. grades are based on attendance so you have to go but there is virtually no homework and they grade super easy on the very few assignments we had, basically just completion grades. 10/10 TAKE THE CLASS!

Ed Madison taught a great class and was a great professor. His class was interesting with a lot of guest speakers that were fun to listen to. You learn a lot about the media professions in his class, and I would highly recommend it if you are considering the SOJC. The class itself is pretty easy, with a couple book quizzes and research assignments.

Attendance was mandatory so keeping an A with the Omicron peak was hard. Dr.Ed is barely involved in anything but your GE's are. If they are harsh & ACTUALLY grade your daily reflections then make sure you PAY ATTENTION. The meaningless book is what the quiz's are on, but don't worry, the extra credit & digital research can get your grade up a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: such an easy class - each day its a new lecturer and then at the end of class you do a quiz that just asked what you took away from their lecture. I honestly used this class as a study hall and got so much work done. beware it gets so hot in that room and you live tweet so have your twitter fingers ready to go.
Really good science credit for non-scientists. Don't have to read graphs or do math. Uses popular articles to show how to read science.

I DONT recommend this course or teacher to anyone. Her lectures were so long and had absolutely zero information that ended up on the weekly quizzes. She goes over so much information, does not explain it clearly, and then tests you on completely different questions. Also has hidden AI detection on quizzes and makes you use a lockdown browser. 0/10
quizzes and worksheets - do everything to get all the points
Weekly quizzes are timed so be prepared
weekly quizzes are multiple choice
labs are important
Lectures are recorded and packed with information
Weekly worksheets are important and get good grades
lectures are online
weekly quizzes

This class isn't my favorite, but it's easy if you put the time in. If you're not interested in STEM, maybe don't take this class as a freshman. Expect to spend like 5-6 hours per week, however, I usually just get everything done in one day. The quizzes can be confusing at times, and I've caught many errors on the lecture slides.

reviews.comment: I do not recommend this class to anyone. The course Is based solely on how well you do on the quizzes and a little bit of your discussion. The quizzes had nothing to do with the 3 hour lecture videos which makes them impossible to get over a a C or a D on them. Definitely not a good class to take if your just looking for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: So time consuming, lectures are boring, quizzes and worksheets every week. Don't think you will get an easy A from this, if you want an A you have to watch the 3 hour lectures every week. Discussion sections are not mandatory, but easier if you go in person compared to online discussion. Terrible class if you have no interest.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you watch the lectures, take notes on them, and do the required and optional readings, you should do fine in this class. The one thing that was very irritating were the weekly quizzes. Your final grade is heavily affected by the quizzes, and they are very difficult. The questions are often not covered in any of the weekly material.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The material was fine, it was the tests that really got to me. In the quizzes, she will give questions based on the minute and tiniest information that she only mentioned by word for a couple seconds during the lecture. If you are not writing down every single word (not exaggerating) that she says in the lectures, you won't pass the quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Unnecessarily hard for a 100 level class. Lots of quizzes with unhelpful study guides. Lots of information for quiz questions weren't even talked about or discussed.

The lectures are online and 2-3 hours long at least. Incredibly boring. Never met the professor and she honest respond to emails, only the GE and she doesn't have office hours. It is essentially the GE completely in charge of the class, not the prof. You cant see the what questions you got wrong on the quizzes till WEEKS later if youre lucky

The quizzes usually have nothing to do with the lectures or readings. The lectures are hours long and there are always multiple each week. Also, some of the readings will be super long and unnecessary. She never responds to emails and most people struggle in the class. I do not recommend ever taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you cant sit through online lectures and then take a test everyweek I would not recomend this class. her lectures were long, it was hard to focus and then the quizzes had barely anything to do with the lectures. the questions on the quizzes were extremley confusing

Lectures were very interesting to me, but the course was about primates. We watched a lot of mating videos, which I found interesting. She is funny. Lectures are very chaotic, and her quizzes do not follow them. I personally took the notes I have ever taken and I did not do well on the quizzes. They will have the info we did not cover, or random.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I would not recommend this class for a gen ed requirement. The class barely talked about humans and the majority of the year was spent discussing primates. Additionally there were insensitive comments that were made in lecture because she failed to provide context for the statements. I would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Asides from making the class laugh once in a while, this class was not the best experience. Extremely rigorous for a 100 level gen ed. the test content had very little correlation to the study guides or weekly labs and her lecture slides were not big help either; also makes you buy a book that she wrote. Not a bad lady, just not a good professor

At the beginning of class she said that a 70% is a good test score which means she either makes her tests too hard or she does not do a good job teaching the material. Going to discussion made the biggest grade impact because her lectures are basically just her reading the slides and making partly funny jokes.

This class was so interesting and White is an amazing professor! She's really knowledgeable and fun. Tests are pretty hard but you'll get a good overall grade if you get 75%ish on them and go to discussions. Her notes can be hard to follow sometimes, but they're all on canvas and if you go to lecture and take detailed notes you'll get all the info
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I think that she is an amazing and smart woman, the class idea was amazing and I learned a lot of things BUT the tests were kinda crazy and there was a lot of stuff we never looked over on the tests.

Interesting class but very boring. Enjoyed the labs way more than the lectures. Spent 7 weeks learning about monkey mating systems and only 3 about humans. She goes through the slides very quickly but everything is on Canvas. White is very knowledgable and intelligent and respected in her field but the class was just mediocre.

Although she is a funny professor and knows her stuff her tests are ridiculously hard. They were all online and worded in a way nobody could understand. It's impossible to do well unless you invest hours outside of class reading and relistening to lectures. This class was much too hard for an intro class. Wouldn't recommend it to anyone!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Super interesting and hilarious professor. Subject matter and tests were pretty tough but I really loved her as a prof. She knows her stuff

I took Francis White's ANTH 173 Evolution of Human Sexuality course, and she made my class belly laugh at least once each lecture. She is a very credible professor as well as an enjoyable one.  Tests are very doable, given that you do all the readings, and attend all lectures and discussions. The tests are online which was very convenient.

This class is really boring, it's impossible to be interested in what she is talking about because it never makes sense. The slides are hard to follow and she rambles about the same things over and over. She is definitely a genius about monkeys having sex but I don't think she is meant to be a professor. The tests are REALLY hard.

Do not take this class, she is an awful professor who is not interesting at all and her midterms are ridiculously hard for being a 100 level course. One of the hardest classes I've taken in college thus far. Her lectures are boring and she is not clear. Her lecture notes are useless for studying.

She's funny & very passionate.  She has a LOT of valuable professional experience.  However, her lectures are hard to pay attention to.  She is very repetitive.  Sometimes her lecture notes make no sense so you really have to listen to her speak.  Course focused heavily on non-human primates bc that is her specialty.  It was annoying :(

Francis White is definitely a genius and passionate about her subject, but she goes through the lectures super fast and it is really hard to stay attentive throughout. She does her best to keep the class interesting with a sense of humor, but it is just boring. The way she words the lectures and tests makes things very difficult to learn.

absolutely the worst lecturer i have ever had. she speaks softly and wanders from her own notes... she is hard to follow and so boring. lecture slides make no sense and are irrelevant to her actual lectures.
Lectures are very interesting. On line tests are hard.  I am not a good test taker but these tests are set up to see how well you can take tests.  Study and review is a must to pass.

I love Francis. All of her lectures are invigorating and she makes learning about monkeys and apes very interesting. She has a lot of experience in this field and I feel lucky to have had her as a professor

I took 171 and 173 with her. I love taking classes with Frances White because she takes something she is passionate about and turns them into interesting lectures. Her tests are hard but she is always there to help you if you ask. Attending    lectures is extremeley helpful.
Love her! My favorite teacher by far! I would recommend taking one of her classes!

Dr. White is not much short of a genius. She made an awkward lecture (human sexuality) fun. By weeks 7 and 8, I was still going to class because I liked what she was teaching and how she taught it. The huge problems with the class were the exams. They were online, but impossibly written. Every answer could be right. Regardless, the prof is great.
very nice lady- lot's of fun to talk to and the class was very informative and enjoyable. Some of the lectures can get muddled but overall a good class
Amazing teacher! So knowledgeable and has made so many contributions to science worldwide. Take this class if you are truly interested in the subject and are willing to work for your grade.

she's a an expert in her field, which sometimes makes you feel overwhelmed. Her accent sometimes is difficult to understand and her tests are HARD even though they're online. If you are looking for a GE science class, this is not an easy take. Avoid if you can. Plus this class is about monkeys
Class is just alright. BIG emphasis on discussion attendance. Only other grades in the class are 2 Midterms and the Final. All of these are taken online which has it's advantages and disadvantages.

By far the worst class I have taken at the university. The tests are all online and the questions are worded in ridiculous ways. You spend most of the time trying to understand what the question is asking. The final is worth 40%!!! Prof. White is a good teacher but she makes it very hard to succeed. I would say avoid the class if you can.

She is an awful teacher that is very disconnected from her class. Her tests are all online, so that she doesn't have to do any work. They are worded in a manner that makes it impossible to comprehend. This class is very hard (Even for a 4.0 student) not because the content is hard, but because I have no idea what she wants on her test answers. SUCK

Prof. White did a good job and was very informative. The lectures COULD be boring at times, but for the most part they were pretty interesting. If you're taking the class just remeber it's a SCIENCE class and is taught like one with some biology aspects. It is about the Evolution of Human Sexuality, not human sexuality itself.

Francis White is absolutely boring. Her voice is monotone, her notes are not detailed, she isn't very helpful. She turns a fascinating subject into a dull and uninteresting subject. The class is hard, even for A students. All of the tests are online and the wording for the tests are difficult to comprehend.

All of the midterms for this class are online, thus allowing Dr. White to post questions even google can't comprehend. Dr. White asks "synthesis" questions which in a nutshell means none of the answers to the questions on midterms will be found in the notes. In-depth studying is definitely required and this class is not an "easy A".
nice lady, very enthusiastic about monkeys and pretty funny at times.

This class was actually somewhat interesting, but it can be very difficult at times.  The material itself is not difficult to understand but the tests are HARD.  In my opinion they are worded somewhat poorly and are hard to understand.  The good news is that Dr. White knows what she is talking about and is very willing to help you however she can.
pretty easy class, little work. Great professor!
Interesting class, but extremly hard. I thought she was a good teacher and defintly knew what she was talking about, but the information seemed a little rushed and the tests were difficult.

This class was a little misleading... you may think its about human sexuality, but in reality its about monkey sexuality. I think Dr. White is an extremely knowledgable person, and her class was somewhat interesting at times... but the tests were REALLY hard. Study up if you take this class

This class though sounded like it was going to be fun and educational was a crock. She was completly disconnected from her students and made the class very dull. I found out way more than I ever wanted to know about Monkeys and didn't learn what I initially thought the class was about...humans. Dont recommend this prof or class to anyone.

The class was very unorganized and unclear.  The lecture outlines are somewhat jumbled and hard to understand.  She is very passionate about what she teaches and tries to incorporate humor into her lectures but unfortunately she is still quite boring to listen to.

Dr. White is passionate about what she teaches. I found it very interesting, and I enjoyed her lectures. Her tests (multiple choice) are kinda hard, but if you follow the study guide really well, you'll be fine. No papers! Just easy labs and three tests (including final). Also, great sense of humor.
i liked this class, though there was a lot of reading involved. midterms required a lot of studying, but my gtf was really great and it made the class a bit easier.
Francis is a fantastic teacher, and very committed to her research!

A awesome class, but I think you need to have an actual interest in the subject to take the class and like it. Great professor though, funny, interesting, and packs alot of good matieral into her lectures. The book is great too, and everything is very neat and organized. Also she has good outlines and AWESOME study guides. I highly recommend this class.

you can definately tell that she is very serious about what she does. If you are serious about the material she is trying to present then she is a good professor. It's hard to get into though for a lot of people.
No Comments
No Comments
This is the most boring class at the University of Oregon.  Why does such an interesting subject have to be "taught" by this woman?
I found the lectures really helpful and must watch and take notes to get good quiz scores. Worksheets are easy and the GE helps you get the right answer in sections.
Discussion posts are significant and take time to research, but you learn a lot, including how to do research.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Important to watch lectures carefully as quizzes are based on these. Worksheets are straight forward and the GE tells you what to write in sections so must attend.
Must watch lectures to understand the quiz questions. Worksheets are easy if you go to sections.
Important to watch the lectures as the quizzes pull a lot from them. Worksheets are easy credit if you go to sections as the GE tells you how to fill in.
Must study recorded lectures to pass the quizzes.  Worksheets are separate and easier but must go to sections to get the GE to tell you how to complete.
Quizzes are hard but everything is int the lectures, so need to study. WOrksheets are easy and the GE helps.
Lots of reading original research. Make sure you are careful in discussion posts to do your research first.
Must watch the lectures as it is all on the quizzes. Don't listen to the moaners who complain its not an easy A and you have to learn stuff!
No easy, but definitely a science class for non-science students. Got to study for hte quizzes but everything is in the lectures
Course was lot of work, but everything was in Canvas site. Have to study from lectures but worksheets are easy with GE help in sections. Course is set up for us non-science literate types.
Not often you get a course taught by someone famous int hat field! There's even a NOVA special about the prof!

Quizzes are based on video lectures so you have to watch them all. Worksheets are easy and the GE walks you through them in sections, so must attend to get full points. Don't use AI as it is penalized.
Lots of reading but interesting stuff
Never thought I'd pass a science credit class, but finally found one truly intresting so it made studying possible. Not easy, but everything you need is there.
Needed an upper level online class. Lots of reading and library research but never knew this stuff about animal behavior. Explains evolution and models. Learned a lot!
Nice stats class with explanations and applications and not much math
Quizzes are based on lectures and study helps. Worksheets are easy if you attend the sections as the GE tells you the answers
Really good stats class with tons of explanations and very little math. Finally made stats make sense to me.
Lot of work reading studies and doing own library research.

Not an easy A class, but I learned a lot. Pay attention to lectures and this stuff is covered in the quizzes and they are not easy as you have a timer so study to be ready. Worksheets are easy and the GE tells you the answers in sections. Interesting subject.
Good if you are interested in primate or animal behavior, with lots of reading and review of studies. The discussions are important and take time to prepare for so that you make good contributions.

Important to watch the lectures carefully and take notes as these are covered in weekly quizzes. Readings are less important. Attending discussions are essential as the GE helps you through the weekly worksheet.
Took this statistics class as was having a hard time with ones in business. Gave great understanding without heavy math use. Very useful class.
Science credit class so needed to watch lectures carefully. Quizzes were hard but ok with studying.
Quizzes are not timed so you can look stuff up and the labs can be repeated for full credit
Important to watch all the lectures carefully as information is on quizzes
Course is straightforward for biology majors but will be more challenging for non-science majors, but it is taught as a how-to-understand write ups of scientific studies so very useful.
Really useful to have a course that gives how to really use and understand statistics in biology. No math needed.
Quizzes are tough but info is in lectures. Worksheets are easy.
Have to be really prepared for the quizzes as they are a lot of the points and taken timed. Don't use AI. Worksheets are easy and there is a lot of help from the GE for these.
Important to study hard for quizzes as they are timed so even though you can look stuff up, there is not time to do it and don't use AI
Lectures packed with info needed for the quizzes, hard but no trick questions. Everything is fact based. Weekly worksheets are the easiest and the sections go thorough how to get full points.

Lectures were interesting and effective, and the quizzes were tough but based mostly on lectures so take notes. Was a new subject for me but got my science credit for this so tried hard. Worksheets were easy for me as were writing based and everything needed was covered in sections.

A hard class if stats and programming is not your subject, so use the help from the prof and TA and lots of walk-through help for the R labs of the course. I used the "re-do" without penalty on the labs A LOT and got there in the end! Lot of work, but worth it!
Really good biological statistics class. Lectures are very clear and it goes for an understanding level of biological applications and not a math heavy approach. Covers R easily with lots of help.
Lot of work in this course with weekly quizzes, worksheets and posts, but everything is clear and all material is in the Canvas site. Listening carefully to lectures is a must for good quiz scores.

Lectures were long but very interesting and full of information that you use on the quizzes. Worksheets are on different material and are easy, but quizzes are hard. Important to not use AI or you get zero on assignment.

This is a science credit course and everything is explained and worksheets were good for showing writing but quizzes were multiple choice and tough but do-able if you study and pay attention to lectures and do the readings
Important to stay on schedule and complete all the work
Lectures are essential and recorded
Statistics course with lots of "how-to" help
Quizzes are open but timed so need to study
Not an easy course but really interesting and different. Can submit late work.
Has weekly target dates but all late work accepted without losing points
Tough subject in statistics but everything you need is in lectures or Canvas
Not an easy intro course but interesting and different
Quizzes are hard, but points on worksheets are easy to get
Lectures are recorded and dense - listen to them more than once!

This class was fascinating and is primarily an EVOLUTION course. Though listed as a 100, I'd only recommend it to anth majors, as it is challenging. Dr. White is hilarious and very knowledgeable. Definitely a professor that you should take full advantage of their office hours. Attend every discussion and learn ALL the material to succeed.

This class is an all online class and should be easy but the professor makes it as difficult as it can be. She uploads two to three hour long old video lectures and then creates quizzes that have topics not talked about in those lectures. All of the quizzes include very opinionated answers and do not always have one clear answer.

I wouldn't recommend this course AT ALL. Too much work for a 100 level class and the quizzes are so tricky and hard. The grades for this class are also not posted on Canvas so you won't know what grade you got overall until the last second. Moreover, the results for the quizzes are also not posted so you won't be able to reflect on your answers.

Overall, I enjoyed the course content and found it interesting, but that may differ for everybody. Professor White is very knowledgeable BUT this class is tough for a 100-level course. Quizzes are made to be very hard and I would get C's on them even though I felt confident and thought I understood the content. It was a humbling experience.

WOW! get a load of this. i would not recommend this class to ANYONE with a good desire to love themselves. While the professor does seem kind within her lectures, the tests fail to grasp material gone over within lecture and discussion. "Thou shall not pass this class" she thinks. Interesting subject, poorly executed. all love no hate.

reviews.comment: Prof Frances overall terrible class, I don't even know where to start. Extremely difficult weekly quizzes with an average of a C even when you heavily studied the 3.5 hour lectures and 3 hours of readings a week. VERY passive-aggressive emailing. Do not take this class unless you want a C for no reason.

reviews.comment: This class was difficult and confusing. I tried to reach out to her for help but had a difficult time receiving any, thankfully my GE was very helpful. I ended up having to make the class pass/no pass and did receive a pass, but it wasn't easy. There was quizzes once a week that were super confusing as well. Don't recommend!

Frances White is a very kind and knowledgable professor and her lectures are very interesting. However, the quizzes for this class are incredibly difficult and unrelated to the lecture and study guide. Some of the answers to the quiz are straight up just not true, outdated or a matter of opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took ANTH 173, for science credit. It was fine, but it is not an "automatic" A. Youll never meet White as dicussions are led by GE. Attendance for discussions optional.

DO NOT TAKE. you cannot see your overall grades until the class is over and the quizzes are so hard, I was averaging a 13/25 every time. each week the lectures are 2-4 hours long and the quizzes don't even match the lectures. so many questions could be opinion based but you have to choose a "correct" answer. I ended up switching to pass/no pass.

The online class watched most of the lectures and did most readings but the answers for the quizzes weren't in the lectures or online and the quiz questions were opinionated/ could be argued that most answers are correct. Overall horrible class Don't take this class save yourselves.

reviews.comment: The class itself was super intriguing, and I enjoyed the lectures, BUT the quizzes and assignments were pretty tricky. The lectures were also long, especially if you wanted to take notes.

I don't understand how I got an A. Your grade is based only on participation, weekly quizzes and worksheets, and the quizzes contain a lot of questions that are not covered in lectures or readings. I had to look stuff up on the internet to answer them and still couldn't find the answer. The content is kinda cool but just take a different gen ed.

I'd be interested to know if anyone got an A in her class. This class is awful do not take it. None of the questions on the quizzes are remotely related to what is on the notes I don't know how this qualifies as teaching.

The class is only graded on weekly worksheets and quizzes. The study guide does not prep you at all for the quiz and I was blindsided by a lot of the questions.

SIMPLY JUST DONT TAKE THIS CLASS! there is literally no way to pass this class. the quizzes do not align with anything that you learn from the lecture despite all the material covered. very challenging and difficult class. no way to get an A.

DO. NOT. TAKE. HER. CLASS. The only grades in the class are quiz grades which seems fine at first until you realize that nothing on the quiz is related to the lectures and reading at all. This course is a big waste of time because you spend hours reading just to fail the quizzes because the questions are completely random.

Some lectures were interesting, the rest are just confusing. Grades are based on weekly quizzes and worksheets. I took this class thinking it would be an easy A. It was not. The average on the exams were C's so yeah it is kind of hard. She makes yo buy a book that she wrote, so thats kind of messed up. reviews.comment: Professor White is an absolute expert in this field, which makes her a fantastic teacher! Lectures were full of content, but she made it interesting and easy to follow. I thought this class was a breeze. If you show up to half the lectures you're almost guaranteed a B. Just make sure you go to the weekly discussions.

reviews.comment: She speaks in more detail in lectures so I would recommend attending them, they aren't mandatory however so you do you. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Really wonderful lady, the class was clear, straight forward, and I felt that the grading was fair. No participation in lectures so if that bothers you, it may be hard for you to sit through them. Tests are all open book and online. I'm only checking attendance as mandatory because the although the lectures are on canvas, in class videos are not.

The lecture is hard to understand in a way because she doesn't make slides! She puts up a document with small font, touches on it quickly and expects you to gather  all of the information. Also, the tests are insanely hard. I do not understand why they would make the tests so hard. I would avoid this class at all costs.
Basically just rambles all class and has things on the test that are not in the readings or in the lecture slides. Is very disorganized and the tests are hard.

Frances White is a great Anthropologist but a horrible professor. Notes are like cracking the Da Vince Code, they are absolute chicken scratch. She is unclear and too broad and her lectures are astoundingly boring. Class is all about monkeys but not in a cool way. Pray that you get a good GTF to help you pass.

He is sarcastic, but kind of funny and overall seems like a nice guy. There are a lot of assignments, but I appreciated it because our grade had more of a cushion when the tests came around. He says the tests are multiple-choice, but they are more fill-in-the-blank, which makes a huge difference.

Avoid this class if you can. He's a nice guy... kind of, but the class is just an unorganized mess. Lectures are discombobulated. Homework is outdated and frustrating. The practice we do in class is nothing like the exams and the professors lectures are very boring and not informative in the slightest. All the stuff is taught online in pre-recorded lectures that often don't match the homework assignments.

Mr.Yin is nice but can be really frustrating. Lectures are repetitive and boring. Tests are open note, lockdown browser, 2 part (75% individual/ 25% group.) reviews.comment: Fang a nice guy deep down, but he's been teaching the same material for decades, and his lectures have grown incredibly stale. His lectures and course plan have no structure, and you can go weeks in this class without having really learned anything. Excel doesn't have to be miserable - BA 240 is genuinely a great class - but Fang makes it so.

Oh Fang where do I even start. He's a nice guy and seems like he has a good heart, but his class is an absolute hot mess. Lectures consist of him mumbling while aimlessly clicking around an excel spreadsheet with no instructions and expecting the students to miraculously follow along. I'd day about 95% of each class is a waste of time.

So freaking boring as a professor, but he was easy. He takes attendance but did not care if you got up and left class early. He has you take the midterm and final twice once in class alone, and again on your own where you can chat the whole thing. Homework was consistent every week and he offered a lot of extra credit that was doable.

Honestly he's tough but the guy's heart is in the right place. I like the way he tests on finals and midterms but OMG IS HIS HOMEWORK TORTURE. I don't think I've grown to hate excel more than when I'm doing this guy's HW. But you get unlimited attempts so it's hard to rant about how unfair it is when the dude gives you every chance to get credit.

I don't know why the reviews hate on this professor so much. I took him twice. While his lectures can be a bit boring and mundane, if you try to pay attention or at least read the slides its not too bad. He is a sweet guy who literally said "I'm aiming to be the nicest professor in the LCB."

Overall easy class, but the prof is so rude in his feedback and office hours. I've actually never had such an unkind professor it's amazes me. He's not accommodating at all and so boring. It's very difficult to actually keep focused during his lectures.
He would not update his canvas from years before and used that against us in tests. He had limited communication and was not kind in his feedback on assignments. Straight forward class tho.

Professor Yin's online OBA 335 class is very accommodating. Not much of a lift, and as long as you did the lectures and participated in the group simulations you'll be fine. Study for the exams, even if they are open note. He is a good teacher and understanding.

Lectures were hard to pay attention to at times. Many students drifted off into side conversations and internet usage. He is quite funny though. If there was a greater command over the classroom environment he would get a 5/5 from me. Maybe make the lectures more entertaining and about real-world stuff.

This class was the not the most entertaining, but if you do all the assignments and come to all the classes for participation, you will get an A. The exams are open book and done in two parts, once alone and once with your group, and then averaged together. The exams are also pretty similar to the practice tests.

This class had an interesting structure where he built his lecture each day around student needs/feedback. Make sure to participate and ask questions because he will always answer your questions. He has lots of homework and practice but backs it up with his education beliefs/data.

By far the most boring class online ever. So much unneeded homework and a group simulation that makes little sense. For the midterm and final, he does a singular portion then 20 minutes later you take the same test in a group, which saves your grade.

I took this class over the summer online, he was a caring person and made participation points and lecture points easy to obtain. The lectures had a clear layout and walked you through each section of the textbook which was easy to follow. The exams had an individual and group element which was beneficial
Take this online if you can. Overall not too bad but can be boring. Tests are designed for you to succeed.
The asynch class itself was super laid back, you can do everything at your own pace. Fang was really nice and understanding I would recommend taking him asynchronously.

He does not listen to student feedback. I would not take him again for any OBA course. Class was very unproductive and the structure of it made it disengaging. He also is not very accommodating and has very annoying attendance policies.
I stg this clas is the single most boring class I have been required to take. That being said, it was stupid easy. If you have to take this class, take it with Fang Yin.

So many stupid little busy work assignments. Makes you do the same assignment twice everyday. ADHD meds or not, this class is hard to pay attention in due to its dull and lengthy lectures. Do what you can to not take this class.

I will admit that he can be pretty monotone at times but he really tries to get everyone to talk and participate

People that are writing negative reviews about him those are just people that do not take for granted what a joke it is to get a decent grade in the class. With practice midterms and finals that are similar and the group midterm on top of extra credit how can you dislike that.

Fang isn't great, but it's pretty easy to get a B or A in this class by putting minimal/some effort into the coursework. I took his class online and he was not helpful. Lots of lectures and homework. When giving practice tests or reviews he never explains the answers he just states the answers. Fang is an alright professor. If he had added humor in his asych lectures, I would have enjoyed it more. I really like how he allows group work on the midterm and final because it helps with the overall score for the test. He doesn't curve but is there during office hours to help.

reviews.comment: Tests nothing like what he gives on practice tests. lectures are boring and not helpful. do not take his class.

Fang Yins classes were incredibly boring. I stopped going to them after a couple weeks because I wasn't learning anything new or useful that wasn't already being taught in the weekly CPA's. Yes, the class is boring and so are the lectures. But honestly I think Fang Yin is a great person. He was available to video call and help outside of class hours. doesn't explain well, expects you to teach yourself

possibly the worst teacher I have ever experienced. The entire course was taught using a series of slides with little to no explanation. the only time we ever interacted with the professor was for office hours. I would never take another course from him again.

Took two of his class and I want to drop out of school He never explain the content, reading off the slides makes no different than going to his class. He gives out great info and is really helpful when you ask questions,  but lectures can get monotone and pretty boring. On the tests, make sure you do the excel/word/access first and then the multiple choice after.

U will pull ur hair out everytime you go to class. He is a terrible teacher. Not likeable at all. It's easy to succeed in the course if you resign yourself to doing everything his way. I hated him and the course, put in virtually no effort, and got an A-. He sends out a couple dozen emails throughout the term and they are all useless.

Fairly easy class, this guy is not likeable though. Boring professor and boring class.

He is pretty good at teaching what needs to be teach. Nice guy, might be a little bit dull but all information system classes are like that if you are not interested in IT stuff. Test are not hard. Always participate in class will get you a good grade.
Not too difficult of a class, but the material is useless and the professor is a prick.

Its hard to concentrate in lectures because they are so boring. the class material doesnt correspond to labs/projects. the GE literally complains about his teaching and doesn't keep them in the loop with material. it's not necessarily the hardestttt but definitely take a Python class before this one so you actually understand base knowledge before.

This man gets so much hate for no reason, he is a damn good professor and an incredible human.

He's a really nice guy, but terrible professor. The labs always happened before we learned the material, so we had no idea what we were doing and then the GE would get frustrated. Awful cycle. I have never had a teacher who cares less about his students, he is rude and condescending, his lectures are long and terribly boring and supplemented by an obnoxious amount of outside videos and readings. Study all you want for the exams it doesn't matter because he chooses two things out of 4 weeks of material.

One of the worst professors Ive had at UO. Doesnt care about his students. Tests on arbitrary details. Is rude and condescending. Doesnt even grade the final exam, makes TAs do it. Dont take him if you have a choice.

worst prof i've had at UO. rude in office hours and tells students they just dont understand the material. tests are on random small details of a 200 page reading. ridiculous amount of info to know and give no direction on what to study for tests. doesnt care about students and wont let them leave the class to go to the bathroom or get water at all
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: He doesn't allow students to go to restroom. For any excuses

Farhad was really difficult, and he wasn't very clear on his grading criteria, but if you make an effort to go to him outside of class, and show him that you're working he's really willing to help you out. Expects participation in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Extremely knowledgable about global issues. Turns students off by his passionate stances, but if you're open-minded and thoughtful you will LOVE this professor - speaks a lot about global perspectives, which challenges many Eurocentric narratives. Heavy reading, but if you do it you'll get an A easily.

I'm fairly in the middle politically, but even for me this class had intense political bias (extreme left, borderline socialist) and some lectures felt like we were analyzing how terrible America is compared to other countries. Overall an extremely broad, boring and sometimes frustrating class. Also zero study guides for the 2 midterms and final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's very interested in the topic, and this is clear, but he fails to spread the interest to his students I feel. Lots of reading for every class and the readings are never discussed in class. The tests, all four of them, are the basis of the entirety of the grade and are based on materials from his lectures, the readings, and the films.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: The instructor really showed a lot of passion and knowledge on what he was teaching. He really taught the truth and a different perspective rather than the common perspective. He was determined, ambitious, and very intelligent on what he was teaching us. He was also very conversational, approachable, funny, and very helpful and conversational.

Farhad is an absolutely amazing professor and the UO will suffer greatly without his knowledge. Having a teacher from the region of the world in which you are discussing benefits the subject in a number of ways. Professor Farhad has a plethora of knowledge on the subject of ME politics and did a great job in explaining these complexities to us.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dr. M has without-a-doubt been the best professor I've had at the U of O. Every lecture is packed with interesting and important info, the readings compliment what is discussed during classes, and the assignments are challenging (but definitely fair). You'll learn a ton if you put in effort. I really can't say enough good things about PS399 & Dr.M!

Going to lectures is very important, as there are things on the test that come from in-class discussions. The test questions can be very specific, and it is challenging since your entire grade depends on the 4 tests given, so pay close attention to the readings. Overall, he is very passionate and his lectures are very informative
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Your entire grade is based off of tests (25% each) but they are not that hard if you do the reading. He will pull questions from the assigned articles and textbook chapters so be prepared for that. Tends to be more liberal but lectures are very interesting and he does a good job stopping if people have questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This is a difficult class and requires a good amount of reading and preparation for the exams; although, the knowledge gained from the class makes it worth it. The lectures are easy to pay attention to and he provides many opportunities for the class to participate and have a discussion.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I really enjoy having Farhad as a professor. His expectations for the exams are clear and come both from his lecture and textbook. Although he does share his views, he does it in a way that allows for discussion to either agree or disagree. He is one of my favorite professors at UO and I would take another class with him in the future.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The best professor I have had at the U of O by far. Extremely knowledgeable, genuinely cares about students' success, and an amazing lecturer. I wish he could teach all of my classes!!!

Professor Malekafzali strives to challenge students viewpoints on sensitive issues. Therefore he spends more time presenting what most students would consider an opposing viewpoint. Seeing middle eastern conflicts from a middle eastern viewpoint helped me to grow as a student. While I did not agree with all his views, he graded fair, would retake.

Most of the class time is spent discussing his political views (far left liberal) and very little time is spent on the course materials. He uses data and statistics that are skewed and from sources that are not trustworthy. The tests are on small details from the textbook. I recommend taking this course with any other professor.

I have never learned so much in a term about a subject. At first the teaching style was difficult to follow and kee up with. Eventually I understood how to take notes, pay attention to important details, and study formaterials. Overall the style made me a better studier, listener, and student. I don't have anything that I wouldchange about thecour

This professor is very opinionated. He started the first day stating that he only states views based on fact. This is completely untrue. Often Farhad will spew nonsense with clearly bias "sources" and you are expected to take this as fact. For the exams you need to know everything in the book,  lecture, articles, videos, etc from his viewpoint.

Professor Malekafzali is one of the most kind and informative professors I've ever had. He focuses on important, relevant issues and truly cares about each and every one of his students. Don't take his class unless you are hardworking and open minded. I will definitely be taking one of his classes again.
never post important things on bb, so many much stuff have to remember, not giving curve

Yes, if you are looking for grade handouts, or pad on the back for mediocracy, then you should look elsewhere.  I am working hard and getting good grades and learning more than ever. It is not the instructor's fault if you have taken more than your social schedule allows. Grow up. You are in College.

If you want to murder your GPA, take his class.3 midterms and 1 final. No study guide. No curve. You must memorize every single words from textbook, articles, and his lectures. He makes his students to pay most of their time to his class and forget their other classes. He is the worst teacher in UO

Professor Malekafzali is an excellent prof who clearly cares about his students' education. He was always approachable and forgiving. He encouraged questions, offered multiple points of view, and always had a witty comment to keep the class in good spirit.

Never wanted to miss class. Professor Malekafzali structured and taught the class very effectively. Every lecture was interesting as well as eye opening, delving into the deeper issues/events many people aren't aware of. I would highly, highly recommend taking a class of his.

Dr. Malekafzali is an engaging professor who's passionate about middle east conflict. I'm a Jewish student who identifies with both the Palestinian and Israeli side and I feel that he brought to the forefront many issues that are typically overlooked. He is not a Holocaust denier as he has been called online but an extremely enlightening teacher.

I enjoyed North African Politics a lot and that is due to Professor Malekafzali. He was very fair and unbiased in class and on sensitive issues, took all questions and lead great discussion. Seems like he genuinely wants students to do well. Professor Malekafzali clearly knows a lot about the subject, take the class if you can!

I learned a lot from this course and enjoyed it despite not getting a good grade. Professor Malekafzali was very fair in how he described previous events, and for sensitive issues and topics he was unbiased. This class opened my eyes to North African politics, and had a very respectable professor leading the class. All around great.
This class has lit a fire in me and these issues are definitely something I will continue to pursue.  Thanks for everything Professor Malekafzali

Thank you for a great term and one of the most honest and informative lectures I have had. At first it seemed to be overly critical but learning factually and critical of both sides changed a lot of my opinions. Take the class if you can.
Professor Malekafzali is extremely knowledgable and motivated. Unique perspective. Even though class started early in the morning I looked forward to his class.

The instructor was very knowledgeable. His biography online mentions that he believes that our current opinions must be challenged to learn. Knowing this, I am much more likely to take another class...before that I thought he was arrogant, but it makes sense now.
One of the best profs on campus. A brilliant lecturer. Clear, engaging, organized, funny.  I learned so much from his human rights class last Spring.

Nina is a very nice person, however her lectures often left me more confused than when I started. Most of the course material I had to teach myself and the quizzes are bazaar to say the least. If you have the option, take the class with another professor or be ready to self-teach.

The worst professor I have yet, do not take this class. There is zero communication with this professor, quiz average is a 67%, does't teach concepts needed to work with the current problems. No study guides, no recorded notes, nothing. Only thing you'll gain is teaching yourself everything. Never take ninas class.
Taken at OSU- kept giving out homework on things we never learned.
Do not take this class if you are looking to succeed in a math course.

The biggest two issues I had with this professor were that she didn't explain concepts/rules, and didn't give chances to check work. You essentially just copy her, and then see what you've guessed wrong after exams, hw keys aren't posted. The exam averege on is 67% on all 4 exams so far, most people have B luckily because she expects failed tests.

So far the hardest class I've taken here. Dont know if this is for OSU (Not UOO), but please avoid this professor at all cost. Her study material is not helpful at all with tests.
Be prepared to be graded over miniscule things, if an answer isnt accurate enough, she WILL mark it down. be prepped for problems not covered & worth 4 points each.

reviews.comment: I would take the other ratings seriously, however, in my experience Gyde was willing to be flexible for me when I was sick. She may not be the best professor, but she was kind. Be warned: LOTS OF HOMEWORK. Anywhere from 10-15 assignments a week
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: When you ask for help she basically laughs in your face then gives you an D on a quiz cause you forgot to label one thing. Avoid her at all costs.
The professor hands out quizzes with no study material or context provided. Made SEVERAL mistakes through our lectures. Please do not take a course with this professor.
She's not helpful, rude, made my time in class super difficult because of how unclear she is about directions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: the worst math class I've had so far. so many tests and you arent given practically anything to study. u can study the past assignments but u aren't given a key so you dont know if you're correct. forgets to release assignments on canvas. extremely passive-aggressive in class. grades extremely harsh on quizzes. if you can avoid this professor.
