For being a professor, he is very approachable. His lectures are interesting and funny. Over all the class is easy, if you show up for the lectures you dont have to do the readings and the quizzes arent hard.. its common sense if you pay attention.
He's a wonderful professor. Absolutely hilarious and has lectures that will keep you engaged and occupied. If you show up and take notes, you pretty much don't have to do the reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I looked forward to class every single day. You need to be there - but you'll want to be there. He's hilarious and really knows what he's talking about. He's one of the best professors I've ever had and opened up my mind to thinking more critically about the world around me.

Extremely funny person, really tries to engage with the students - even a class of almost 500! Pay attention to the lectures, the exams will be almost the exact stuff from the lecture. Very interesting topics discussed and opened my mind to a deeper level of thinking.
Obviously cares about his students success. 2 papers, 6 online quizzes, and very engaging lectures make this class one of my favorites.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: So funny and relatable, he knows his media even though he warns against it. 10/10 would take again it was a breather class for sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I was in his first FIG and I highly recommend it. He is really good at communicating with younger generations and knows how to engage his audience while making his lectures both interesting and funny. I learned so much because of the way he taught the class. I highly recommend to take this class if you watch tv or use your iPhone at all!!!!
Great professor, had a lot of fun and would totally take the class again.

AMAZING professor! Absolutely loved his J201 class, there were so many interesting topics and it was really easy to stay interested and engaged. He's super funny and really appeals to his audience. I would take any class he's teaching. GTF's grade a little hard and the midterms and finals are a little difficult

If you have the option to take Dr. Pete DO IT! I honestly have never met a professor that cares so deeply about his students, when you're in a class of 400+ and feel cared about that's pretty impressive. 201 was amazing, everyone showed up to class every day because the lectures are engaging and thought provoking. I learned a lot and laughed a ton.

Professor Alilunas was absolutely incredible. I was amazed at how much he cared about his students in a 200 person lecture. I went in to see him 5 times and everytime he gave me thoughtful advice and remembered me. He was amazing at turning material into hilarious jokes you could remember. Wish I could have failed just to take the class again

Alilunas made class so interesting and had relevant information every single day. Attendance was not required, but I went to every single class because I genuinely enjoyed the class. He made me interested in things that I would typically not be interested in, and he made all of the class information very engaging.
Just a great teacher.

I looked forward to this class every single day. I learned more about the world in the 10 weeks I had this class then I have in all my education. Professor Alilunas was captivating and made the most boring topics, interesting.

Peter is an amazing professor. He is extremely enthusiastic which makes the lectures really interesting and fun. His power points kept my attention throughout the whole term. He doesn't grade too tough theres just a few papers. Midterm was relatively hard but nothing too crazy. I'd definitely take a class from Peter again!

Dr. Pete is so amazing! His lectures are so well prepared and he makes them very engaging and interesting. He is extremely funny and you can tell he really cares about everyone in his class. He has made my freshman year so enjoyable and I will definitely take more of his classes in the future! I highly recommend taking one of his classes!
Great professor, I actually want to go to his class and love listening to his lectures. His powerpoints are hilarious. Would recommend to anyone
Very entertaining, easy to forget to study because there are no quizzes and assignments don't relate to the exams. Grading was on a point scale of 100, which means that 1 point  1%. Do the reading.
Amazing class. Great teacher.
Hands down the best teacher I have had in college so far. Just as funny as he is a fantastic professor. I want to take all his classes.
Awesome Professor! Really fun and made the topic interesting.
Absolutely an amazing instructor! I would absolutely recommend Dr. Alilunas to anyone and would absolutely recommend any course that he teaches.

Anna is the best!! I've had her for class before, and she never fails to be the best! She makes all her assignments really fun and creative, and classes are entertaining! She's got a great sense of humor, too. I also appreciate how understanding she is and wants her class to succeed. Overall, I have beef with whoever gives her less than 5 stars.

She's amazing! Very interactive with the students, kind, respectful, loving, yapper and inspirational. If you have her as your teacher, tell her i said hi and she gonna make sure you gonna be straight.

Anna is amazing. I still attend her office hours just to hang out and talk to her. She is so easy to talk to, and it's a relaxed class. Only a few major assignments that she'll help you with if you are stuck. She's super easy-going and understanding.

Anna is AMAZING! I was terrified going into college because I thought professors would be harsh. But not Anna. She's proof that you can learn while also having class flexibility and humor. Unlike in some of my other classes, her positive, motivating attitude made me look forward to class and to learning about poetry. Anna has always got your back!
Amazing class! Kept students engaged and minimal homework. Majority of the term was working on one research paper.

Anna has been one of my favorite instructors so far at the UO. I always looked forward to attending class because she made the lectures fun, engaging, and relevant. Our workload was easy and appreciated the flexibility with deadlines. Anna has a great personality and never fails to make you laugh.

Anna is one of the best teachers I've had at UO. I just took this class for core ed requirements but she made it such an interesting class and assignments were super applicable to the coursework. She's also super understanding and a good teacher overall. highly recommend taking her class if you have the opportunity.

Holy shhhhhh is this woman the most funny person ever? My class was a 10 am every Tuesday and Thursdays and I had no trouble going ever because she is generally so lit. I talk about her outside of my classes to my friends and her assignments are so easy and manageable. She assigns one real essay and then small assignments for the other stuff.

Very sweet, personable and I really enjoyed having her as my professor. She's very understanding and supportive. Very positive and her atmosphere is always welcoming, and she gives great feedback! Would definitely want her again as a professor!
If you have the chance to take one of Anna's classes, please do. She genuinely wants all of her students to succeed and is just such a warm, welcoming presence.

I got into the special  WR121z. Anna is crazy but the class is super easy. She rants about the random stuff and has hyper progressive, PC beliefs but practically hands you the A. Hard not to pass. Only 2 papers and tons of extra credit. Would highly recommend
Great Professor, Great Class, Def Take

Dr. Anna is a phenomenal professor who cares deeply about her students and creates a welcoming environment for everyone. I will definitely miss this class, I would highly recommend for first term students
Her class was super fun. I really enjoyed taking her class, I also loved how she would give us feedback. She definitely is one of the teachers I will remember forever.

Anna Carroll was an amazing WR 122 teacher, she was always down to earth and understanding but at the same time goofy and fun. Her class workload was easier than high school and definitey the easiest class I've taken. Only got worse off grade because I didn't turn in final and STILL PASSED. Definitely take this class

She's easily one of my favorite professors, you can tell she really cares about her classes and wants all her students to do well. She keeps class light but still is available to help when you need and does genuinely give good feedback.

I LOVE her she is so awesome and so kind. She genuinely cares about her students and her job, unlike some other professors. I always looked forward to her classes in the mornings. I definitely recommend taking this class if you want an easy A and a laid back teacher.
Really chill and makes WR122 easy and fun. Definitely wasn't coerced to write this review for extra credit. For real though, she's a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Anna is sure to make you laugh, and if you have her early in the morning your day is sure to be amazing. She is caring and awesome. Take her class if you need an enjoyable class in your schedule.

She's literally amazing, easily the best professor I've had this term. She's very understanding and lenient with deadlines and extensions as long as you talk with her about them. There weren't too many assignments, but they were all pretty easy or she gives you a lot of time to work on them. Can't recommend her enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Funny and nice. Also good at feedback
I love Anna, she is undoubtedly my favorite professor at UO. I consider her a friend as much as an instructor. If there is an option to take ANY of her classes, do it.

Quite literally the best writing teacher you will EVER have. She is thoughtful, always avaialable to talk in office hours. Not ony is she helpful but her class is super interesting. You are doing yourself a diservice if you don't have Anna as your professor. She is the best 11/10
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took Writing 122 with Anna and she is undoubtedly my favorite professor. Whenever I needed help she was accessible and she provided great tips and feedback for my essays. She was so personable and relatable and I felt like I had known her forever. Definitely take a class with her, you won't regret it!
I love Anna. She is so funny, caring, and truly amazing. She is always willing to give great feedback. I never felt like I couldn't ask her for help because she cares for students a lot.

Anna is truly amazing and her class was one of the best writing classes I have ever been apart of, she is super caring and honestly so funny. She should be one of the most cherished professors at the UO and is by far the best I could have had to end my Freshman year.
Show up sometimes and turn your work in on time and you will pass. This is the first review ive done on this site and its for a good reason. Shes great
Anna is the best. So caring and makes class enjoyable and fun. A lot of discussion but she makes it feel like you're just talking to a bunch of your friends. She's the best

Anna Carroll? LEGEND. Quite honestly the best professor at the University of Oregon. I said what I said and I said what I meant! If you have the option of taking a class taught by Anna please do it! Such a caring person who truly cares for her students. Shes iconic to say the least!!

Anna is actually the coolest person ever. I would go to her office hours for some great conversation and very helpful feedback. She's also super hilarious and very caring. The course is super easy, just make sure to actually get everything done on time. She's super chill with extensions too. We need more professors like her honestly.
I love her! Best writing teacher ever! 10/10 recommend!
I was not looking forward to taking writing 121 but by the first day I was incredibly relieved that my teacher was this amazing

I hate writing A LOT, but Anna made it a little less miserable. She was super funny and wanted her students to do well. Whenever I got help from her she genuinely cared and was willing to help with anything. Would highly recommend her for any writing class.

Anna was a really great teacher and person. She really cared about the class and wanted everyone to pass. She is super funny and makes a boring writing class fun. She's a good grader and is willing to help you with any questions you have.

Anna is so funny and made my 9am writing class less horrible. She wants everyone to succeed and is more than willing to give help. Her class had some reading in the beginning but towards the end, it was all essays. For each essay I went to her office hours and went over the rough draft with her before turning it in. She helped me so much!

Anna is amazing! I took this class with little interest - since it's just a gen ed for me - but she made it incredible. She's super funny and always get everybody in the class - even those who think they're a little too "cool" - to get engaged in discussion and participate. She's made a class people normally dislike really fun and informative.

I've had terrible instructors in the past for discussion classes, but Anna was the first GTF to actually make discussion worth going to! She's incredibly funny and knows the texts inside and out. Super approachable and everyone got engaged in discussion.  Definitely take a class with her if you get the chance! :)
Would definitely take her class again!!!!! Amazing GTF who made Milton, Rochester, and other poets loveable! She made discussion fun and exciting! Highly recommended!
Anna Carroll is such a fun teacher! She gives really good feedback, is super funny, and is really laid back. She really knows her stuff and wants to help you succeed in the class. Take her class!

asks for validation constantly. over ten times a class will ask "Is that ok with everyone?" Never got around to teaching the process of writing a paper, and showed 2 movies and a cartoon instead of 3 classes.
Extremely intelligent professor, clearly knows what he's teaching and teaches it well. Good lectures, fair homework, and tons of extra credit available on exams.

Not sure how this guy is still teaching. I took his class in 2022, and surprisingly I'm still seeing new reviews. Man was desperate to pass people, he continuously gave us opportunities to submit old work and curved the final crazy. Said final was also a joke, it only tested basic calc concepts and yet no one could do them because he never taught.

I you don't understand calculus you are going to fail. Everything you learn he will write on the board and doesn't explain anything he just goes through the problems.

1. the lecture is nothing like the homework 2. the steps for doing the homework is nowhere in the textbook 3. the study guide is nothing like the exam, so good luck passing!!! on top of that, you can't understand what he is saying in his lectures and his curve also brings your grade DOWN. like what?! avoid this class at all costs. waste of money!!!

Webwork did not relate to worksheets, quizzes, or tests. Learned from peers instead of professor. I usually do well in math but I cried almost every week doing the work. Go to your discussion sessions!!!! My GE would give us time to do our worksheet and then go through how to do it. Super helpful. He curves the heck out of the class.
Learned most of the content on my own. Join encore it really helps and watch YouTube videos. Class was really unorganized.
This professor is amazing. I learned so much from him! Fairest grader out there!
Dude is the worst teacher I have had he dropped my grade by 15 percent after the fact that we were done. I don't know if UO looks at this but they need to reevaluate him

He also couldn't figure out how to work Canvas so everyone thought their grade was 15% higher than it actually was for FOUR days after the final. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.

This by far the worst class I have ever been in. I have always passed my math class with either an A or a high B. I have never struggled so much trying to learn math from a professor that can explain math concepts. I had no other option, so professor Polishchuk was my only choice. Get ready to learn on your own. All I'm gonna say. Highly recommend you have some background of calculus before taking this class. Even then, you won't even use the previous calculus you learned in high school!

By far the worst teacher I've had in my life. The lectures are extremely unorganized and confusing. Following his train of thought is oftentimes harder than understanding the actual concepts. Lengthy lectures and hard to understand his examples sometimes
Hes a very good teacher loves questions is very funny 10/10

doesn't use textbook at all. it's hard to study for tests cause you don't know where to find the info. study guide questions are NOT at all on the exam. during the first midterm our discussion leader had to make corrections to the exam AFTER we already started taking it and after people already turned it in. homework also not on the exam. pointless

In general, Polishchuk should be your last resort. I was forced to take a class with him due to my pre-business requirements, and having done so I can confidently say you should definitely avoid him. Good teacher
Sasha is a very hard teacher to learn from. Very hard to understand his lectures.

Professor Polishchuk is a nice guy, and you can definitely tell you knows his stuff, but he his terrible at explaining and teaching. awful, just awful. he is not good at teaching. he also doesn't use textbook. do not listen to the good reviews. there is a reason he has a 3/5 rating. listen to the majority and avoid this class if possible lol

awful. his lectures make no sense and is very smart but was definitely not meant to be a teacher. if you have him i would really consider switching into a different class. not at all like a teacher and will belittle or publicly make fun of you for asking a simple question in class.
Absolute G of a teacher

Rude when responding to questions. Makes you feel dumb for not understanding his confusing unorganized lectures. The things he goes over in class are no where to be found in the hw or textbook. Impossible class to pass. He makes lots of errors while following a teaching guide but he expects you to do well on the tests without using any notes.

reviews.comment: He Doesn't teach, he relies on his discussion groups to learn. You just have to sit and listen to him
Nice guy loves questions pretty funny

This man is amazing, he has stayed to help me so many times. One time he came to campus on one of his busy days just to help me for 15 minutes because our exam was tomorrow. He was fun and dorky in class. Diff Eq was pretty hard but I think he taught it well. He has an accent but I got used to it. It wasn't easy but he really helped me pass.
Good teacher. Hard material. Good at explaining the material in different ways. I really enjoyed the small class with him.
Not bad, but not great either. Not hard to get a decent grade if you pay attention in class and make an effort on the assignments

Terrible teacher. I'm sad to say it but he alone made me want to reconsider getting a math degree. He hates questions and makes you feel stupid if you ask them. The homework is asinine and difficult to understand, with no help from him. He assumes you know a lot of notation without explaining it AT ALL. Worst teacher I've had and I'm a Junior.

I visited his office hour for the first time and I cannot believe how rude he was during the meeting.  He will do random activities while you're talking, most of the time I wasn't sure if he was actually listening.  My classmates say the same with the rudeness during OH.  Very difficult to understand in lecture, I would NOT recommend this professor

Very smart guy - he's the head of the graduate math department -but he cannot teach if his life depended on it.  Can't understand his accent. He grades so unfairly on tests but even though it looks like you'll never pass the class when the test average is a 30%, he curves your overall grade a ridiculous amount at the end of the term. So you'll pass

This was my second class from Polishchuk. In the upper-division setting, he was much, much better organized. He also seemed really passionate about the material, which showed itself in the class. The class was tested and graded perfectly fairly. He is fairly anti-social, so get yourself a good study group.
Smart guy, knows his material. Don't be intimidated learn the material show an effort and things will probably workout. Make it to the office hours if you can.

Polishchuk is okay. Difficult to understand and his grading curves are mysterious, but he is decent. Avoid his classes if you can and, if you can't, don't let it bother you that much. His office hours are always at the worst possible times, though

The other comments are exaggerated. I came into this class with less math experience than I should have and he helped me a lot. I went to his office hours and made a couple of appointments throughout the semester. I was nervous because of the curve which was a mystery but I ended up with a B. He's obviously smart and will help you if you ask.

Hard to understand during class cause he pauses and says "uh" hundred times thru class.His grading isnt very clear and hes not helpful on letting u know what to study for.He also likes to show up to class on the dot, a min or two late, than hold the class past the 50min mark.He acts like asking questions in class is a big chore and will be arogant.

I am a math major and this guy is horrible.  Does not answer questions, grading is pretty unclear, says he curves but you dont know what that is.  Only 1 office hour a week, only does book examples, did not even give practice problems for final, not very personable.  I will try not to take other classes with him!!!

She's very nice and genuinely cares about her students. Her feedback is very thorough, and the course material is actually helpful for "real world" application. However, attendance is somewhat mandatory (you can miss two days) and class can be somewhat boring. Overall, she's a great teacher for WR 122 and I'd recommend!

This professor and class were not the greatest. Nearly all of class time was used for going over assignments, and no real content was discussed. The way we were lectured felt as though we were in middle school. The professor was kind but extremely annoying and not a very enjoyable person to listen to.

Angela is such a passionate, welcoming professor. The class is structured very well, with an average amount of work. She does offer "extra labor" assignments to earn an A, but they are really not that bad. Also loved the feedback she'd give; you could tell she really cared. Would love to have her again.

I really enjoyed having her as a professor. It is clear she cares about her students and genuinely wants to see them improve. She provides extra assignments to do if you want to get an A, but they were pretty short and easy. I would recommend.

This class could be challenging, but she is a very clear grader and tells you exactly how to get the grade you want. She is also very understanding if you get sick or have external problems, and helps you succeed in her course.

You control your grade. She gives exact criteria for a B grade, and exact criteria for an A grade. She cares about your writing and answers the same questions over and over again because she's very patient with students. I like the ecological focus, and the coursework is helpful for learning how to write/communicate.

Angela is a very good teacher, the class is graded in a way that if ALL assignments are completed you only get a B, and extra assignments and more work needs to be done to get an A. However, all these extra labor assignments are very easy and low pressure, and very interesting. The class overall is very interesting and I would definitely take again
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: From the first day she made her classroom a safe space. Although I get nervous speaking in public, she made the classroom so comfortable and gave everyone confidence. Attendance isn't mandatory, but it's a small piece of your grade and you might miss something important. Readings are super light & help you when writing your 5-8 min speeches.

Angela is a great teacher. Her lectures are pretty boring sometimes but I went through all of Writing 122 without paying attention to a single lecture. We did a couple essays and she pretty much gives you the most understanding and easy to read feedback that allows you to write great essays. I got good grades on every assignment and barely tried.

One of the worst professors I have taken. If she does not like your idea she will make you change it even when you explain what your idea is. Talks a lot in class and has really nothing to do what you are doing. Essays were drug out and made no sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's a sweet professor. Really caring and understanding of circumstances as long as you communicate with her. Went to her office hours pretty often which made her even more understanding of my specific circumstances and absences. Quite a few readings, but none of them were ever that long. Not hard to get an A, it's just a little bit of extra work.

Although there are a lot of readings, I think she overall is a good professor. She gets a little too into topics and can be difficult to understand her instructions. Attendance is mandatory if you are sick for a week with covid and she has no forgiveness policy. Easy to talk to and will let you make up missing work if you can find her during o hrs
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Writing 123 can be a boring class for those who don't like writing, but Mrs. Waddell makes it a great class. She really cares about her students and is always there to help in or outside of class. She gives great feedback on essays and assignments and many opportunities to raise your grade.

Ms. Waddell is really kind and caring. She goes out of her way to talk to each student and clearly loves the content she is teaching about. I feel like she wants you to get better and learn, but the class is not challenging and she grades generally easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

The goat.


Best lecturer, actually cares about the material and the Music 360 class was awesome

Andre is very passionate, funny, and chill! He cares about his students and tries to make the class as low-stress as possible while still giving a valuable learning environment. He's just a fun guy to learn from!

Andre is one of the most enthusiastic and engaging professors I've ever had. He is incredibly passionate about what he teaches and it shows during his lectures. The weekly quizzes were relatively easy and based off of a mixture of the reading and the lecture. Get ready to print out your assignment for the discussion section, though.

Passionate about what is being taught, flexible office hours, late-work lenient, follows a clear path throughout the course, weekly notes due at the start of each week (no late deductions), rubrics for big ticket assignments, group project final.
I loved taking Mr. White's class! It was both engaging and entertaining. Just show up, do your discussion posts, and lean into the in class discussion and youll be golden.

One of my favorite teachers. Attendance was mandatory but 4 absences excused with alt assignment. Drew is  so smart and open-minded and talks about sensitive topics very diligently and is always mindful about students differing perspectives. Would take again. I felt like I truly learned so much. Only thing was he was hard to reach outside of class.
Amazing professor. Talked about important topics with the care they deserved. Had a lot of fun and learned quite a bit. He made the classroom feel like a safe space.

Drew is so fun, engaging, and makes every class interesting. Some assignments can be unclear, but he's accessible outside class and always ready to make changes and accept feedback. He's genuinely understanding and if you're behind or need help he's a great support. The class was overall easy but informative and overall just a really good time.

Great professor but he cancels class a lot. The classes he does teach only goes for 30 min when it's supposed to be a two hour class. I don't feel like I'm getting my moneys worth. Shan is very nice and knowledgable, but a lot of our classes were cancelled/moved to Zoom, which was sometimes annoying because it would be last min cancellations or switches and I missed being in the classroom getting what I'm paying tuition for with my major.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: You'll make a whole campaign on your own in this class. You will present regularly. Shan is super kind and pretty fun. Professor Anderson is one of the best professors in the SOJC. He is very open and listens very well to students. I would 100% recommend this professor and any course he offers.

Out of the entire term, we only met once for our lecture and one time for presentations. Otherwise, he canceled every single class due to a different ailment and instead met on zoom. Prof. Anderson is very knowledgeable and tech-savvy, and also easy to contact outside of class. I learned a lot about Adobe Suite and portfolio work.

Shan is one of the best instructors in the SOJC. He knows A LOT about Adobe programs, ad concepts, and has industry experience. Professor Haynes is incredibly rude to her students, talks down to them, assigns way too much work for an introductory level class, and all in all does not provide a welcoming environment to learn in.

reviews.comment: Interesting lectures but talks too fast, it's not going to be hard if you do the readings.

Truly enjoyed her class, Hist 121, Women in History. Her lectures have interesting content and I absolutely will be taking another class with her again. She loves what she does and it makes her class great.

Everything I learned in this class is incredibly useful. His teaching methods were really amazing. Everything stuck in my memory. I remember it even after the class is over, which is not what ends up happening with other classes. Thank you!
he's great. gives everyone a chance to express their thoughts. listens carefully. fun-loving. very engaging. very inclusive.

reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Takes some getting used to his personality. Overall a good teacher. I regret taking this class and wish that I had dropped it when I had the chance. Anthony Hornof is disrespectful, dismissive, and unhelpful. reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Professor Hornof is an excellent teacher. He wants lively discussions, not students staring off onto a screen (hence why he doesn't allow laptops). I believe he provides clear expectations of students. You will learn a lot from him if you put in the work.

Disrespectful to students. Also, pop quizzes, does not allow computer use in a CS class which is odd, assigned 2 chapters of the text to read on the first day.   I am a senior, my major GPA is 4.17, and I was legit excited about this class. Prof Hornof turned this excitement into frustration with his rudeness and seeming lack of care for students

If you are about to take CIS211, please beware that you will be spending a large portion of the first 3-4 weeks basically reviewing on what you should have know already. The core materials are not taught until very much into the term. Even so, you have weeks of time to digest new information.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Understands "computer science" very well. Passionate about teaching programming. Helps students learn what's going on in the background of a piece of code. Takes feedback from students to continually adjust and optimize how the material is being taught. Shows respect for students.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Totally unhelpful. Projects were unclear and not explained well at all. Look for somebody else for CIS 211

Professor Hornoff genuinely wants to help students, but he doesn't know how to cut to the heart of the issue and answer a student's questions. He does have a rude side to him and calls students out for yawning in class. Doesn't allow computer use in a computer science class.   Hope you get somebody else for CIS 211

The professor is brilliant, but a poor teacher. Project specifications are not written clearly and concisely. The TAs were more knowledgeable about Python than the professor.  Professor missed several office hours without giving advanced notice.  Does not allow the use of computers in a computer science class.

The instructor does a great job taking student's questions and listening to our feedback. He encourages self-learning and gives great sources for us to learn from. He pays a lot of attention to detail and is very knowledgable on the topics we are covering.

Clearly understands programming concepts and how to write good code. The projects do a good job at teaching us/making us apply new concepts. Cares about us students, and is always willing to take the time to go over a concept and make sure someone understands it. Its good how he asks the class what we want to go over before class starts.
best instructor ive had had at uo. challenges students. some studens seem to hate it. just want easy As i guess. answers questions in class super well. lively discussions.

Pretends to care but doesn't; evidenced by the fact that he will literally not answer questions during office hours. Expect a blank stare half the time you try to ask him for help.  Even the TAs say they don't know what he expects for assignments. Wastes time during lecture reviewing the rules on the syllabus instead of teaching actual material.

Gives quizzes every Monday. Takes top 10 scores for the assignment and makes that the new top grade for the assignment. Indeed, calls people out in class for yawning. Wastes a lot of time during lecture. Will ask students for questions, and will rarely answer them in class. Slow and incorrect grader.

Dr. Hornof is one of the best professors in the department. His lectures are extremely engaging and his assignments equally instructive. He makes you work hard, but his expectations are reasonable and is always willing to work with you if you ask for help.

The workload was quite heavy but doable. There was no defined criteria for how he grades your projects, making it difficult to get good grades. Very disrespectful of his students. I can understand no electronics in class, but to call out students for yawning or for sitting slouched is ridiculous. He was never at his office when he said would be.
hard but good.  lotz of energy.  demanding.  sort of funny and entertaning.  useful stuff for getting a job.  ther was a lot of discussion in the class.

It is a shame that the first thing I can say is that Hornof is disrespectful. This is rare among the professors I have seen. He does not clearly say what he wants, or gives unrealistic expectations, then grades you down when you do not meet impossible standards. Do not take a class from him. He needs to be fired, but he has tenure.
No Comments

I liked his class style (one very engaged hour) and the amount of work wasn't anything amazing if you're used to working.  I agree with previous posts about the clarity of graded assignments, which seemed a bit arbitrary.  ** newsflash ** like real job! ** newsflash **  He's a bit nuts, but a good class overall.

I agree with most of the ratings here. Hornof is arrogant, unorganized and rude.  He seems to take pleasure and telling people they are wrong and giving bad grades. He grades projects based on criteria that he doesn't even give you. He never gives positive comments to student, only demeans them.  He must have been beaten up a lot as a child.

At many times during this class I found myself very annoyed with Hornof's teaching style. He is vague in assignment requirement details yet grades them according to stringent undisclosed standards. The courseload was very heavy in comparison to most other CIS classes. He isn't a bad teacher but he could really improve his assignment specifications.
I totally agree!!!  He once told me not to use my cell phone in class.  What an ass!!!
Horrible teacher. Shows disrespect for his students in every way possible. Regardless of what he may know about user interfaces, it does not make up for his inability to be a decent human being.
i agree with previous statements. this prof has no clear plan of action and doesn't seem to understand the material. plus, he swamps you with busy work. avoid if at all possible
Agree with everything else the other people said.

If your a prospective student at U of O, DO NOT TAKE ANY CLASSES FROM THIS GUY!Unless you don't have a life and want 20 hours a week of programming.Unrealistic projects and and unclear specifications.Worst professor in the department. Unsure how he's a prof. Take a class from Andrej P or C Wilson.

I was interested in the classes before I got into them. Assignments became so tedious and detail oriented that it took all of the creativity out of it. Worst professor of the CIS department in U of O.  Biased with no knowledge of programming.  Incapable of writing well-defined assignments, changing specification on-the-fly.  A shame to be a professor, no wonder how he got his PH.D degree.
No Comments
April made every class interesting, every reading relevant to today's issues. She made me really like literature which I didn't think was possible.

April Anson has been a professor that I can really relate to. Writing is not my favorite thing to do, but April made the class very engaging. Going to her office hours really helped my grade and she thoroughly takes the time to help you improve. I would definitely take a class with April again, especially because she is passionate.

April was very engaging, and she is very passionate about what she teaches. She teaches on difficult topics, though, and requires for students to push themselves to topics that they haven't previously thought about. She is a hard grader, but if you go into office hours, she will edit your paper and help you to improve.

April is one of the best professors I've ever had. She cares a lot about what she's teaching and it's evident which makes the class enjoyable! She's available to talk to at her office hours and gives clear and helpful feedback. She is so personal and kind, seriously - one of the most kind and wonderful people I've ever even encountered.
Great!
This class helped me in my other classes too. I would take another class with april if i could.
April's feedback helped my writing a lot - I learned not to put off writing until the lat minute. It was hard but I learned a lot.
April has really terrible mood swings that make learning in her class impossible.
Anson is a tough grader but her feedback really helps you to get your writing up to a better grade. I learned a whole lot. and I wish I would have taken a class with her before my junior year.

April has high expectations but makes sure to give lots of time for breaking down the things we need to do in writing and practicing each thing. She likes to use bad metaphors, but somehow they make sense, and helped me to get my writing to work better. She also talks about her own writing process, which really helps!

April is a wonderful teacher! She pushes students to be the best possible writers that they can be and really gives helpful feedback. I went to many of her office hours and that helped me in the class tremendously. April is a great teacher and I plan to take more writing classes with her!
April was really interested in my ideas and made me think harder about them. The things I learned about writing in this class last year really REALLY has helped me write papers for other classes.
I learned a lot about writing in this class. She is a fun and passionate teacher.
April is passionate and extremely helpful. Attending office hours was the best decision I made, cuz she explained everything and was patient helping through my ideas.

April is a terrible teacher who I would only recommend to my worst enemy.Be prepared to skip classes to desperately attend her office hours, slave over her essay revisions, and make her assignments the only priority in your life, all in the name of a B minus.She contradicts herself in every step of the revision process and is outright mean about it
He is an absolutely phenomenal professor. I am having a wonderful time in his class. He is so lively and animated that he just makes learning the content truly fun and interesting.

Professore Applauso is simply wonderful. I had the pleasure of taking Italian 101-104 with him, and looked forward to going to his class all four semesters. He is a great guy, and an awesome teacher because he makes class fun and makes learning a foreign language manageable. He is always there for you if you need help, and is very understanding.

Prof. Applauso is not only a fantastic professor, but a dear friend. He will put the needs of his students before anything and will make himself available practically 24/7 to help. He keeps students involved & learning both inside and outside the classroom- setting up Italian classes for the local community and going above and beyond in general.
Nicolino made my freshmen year.  His classes were extremely entertaining and engaging.
You are guaranteed to have a great time in class with Nicolino.  He is always happy and ready to make you laugh!  I really recommend his classes.

Nicollino is a great professor.  He really tries to engage his students and makes sure that you understand the material.  He becomes impatient when people don't listen in class, so pay attention and you'll get the best result.

aw, we all love him. He is very patient and actually explains assignments, unlike the other head profs in the Italian department. He also understands if you're having a bad week and running a little behind. Nice guy overall.
No Comments
Nick is one of the best professors I've ever had. He can be a little bit scatterbrained but his classes are still enjoyable.
Great professor all around but at times she treats you like you are still in high school which can be mildly irritating.

Class project was difficult, but Aparna was very helpful with her feedback and is open to spending the extra time because she wants you to succeed. She even offered to call or email a company for me when we were choosing a company. One of the most caring teachers I've ever had!

Aparna was an awesome teacher who knows her subject extensively. She teaches you what you need to know and really "hammers" in the most important pieces. The tests were tough and the project was daunting, but I would definitely take this class with Aparna again.
The Project at the end of the term is kind of extensive. You won't know how to start it until half way through the term.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Aparna is tough, but if you apply yourself to her class you will be rewarded! I am consistently reading chapters and taking notes to keep up.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Good class, but instructions can be unclear. Make sure you know what the expectations are before you start anything. Cares a lot about her students and really helpful outside of class. Otherwise, read the textbook and go to class most of the time and you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Good class, daily homework, I learned a lot. Always encouraged us to come in for office hours. Make sure to participate.
Lots of homework. Helped me outside class and very friendly. I like my final project and she guided me well through the process. Makes class fun.

Aparna is very approachable and helpful when you go seek the help. Yes her class has two homework and quiz assignments a week that require students to read the book but this is college. She has clear grading guidelines and an in-depth Canvas site. I heard she adapted her course a lot since the previous term based off of student feedback.
She's a little strict on some things, but very fair with grading and the overall flow of the class. Follows the syllabus to a T, so you know exactly what to expect and when.

Aparna is one of the most organized and thorough teachers I have had at this school. I really enjoyed attending her class, and had a great time learning about marketing analytics and how it is used in the real world. She will definitely make you work for your grade, so if you put the effort in, you will succeed. Make sure to be prompt in your work.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I was a little hesitant to take Professor Sundar's class. However, that all changed when I attended class and talked to her in office hours. She knows the material and abides by the syllabus more than any other professor at UO. Group assignments are within reason and the daily quizzes keep you on track. Homework can sometimes be tedious.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Professor Sundar is a great teacher. You'll have to work hard to do well in her class but once you're done, you will go away with knowledge that will last a lifetime. She is extremely organized and knows what she's talking about. Her lectures are actually really enjoyable and you don't feel like your time is being wasted. I highly recommend her!

Dr. Sundar has been one of my favorite professors at UO. She is very organized, personable and overall an excellent resource for students. She wants to go above and beyond for her students, offering RAships and experience with research. She has a tough course, but it is very interesting and I definitely learned throughout the process.

Dr. Sundar is a great professor and a well respected researcher. She does not baby her students, not does she allow them to be anything but great students. She works hard and if you put in the same effort she does into the course, you'll get a lot out of it. Well worth the effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This professor helped me with advice on job search. She has a lot of experience that is helpful when graduating. A lot of homework-but it is open book. I like no final quiz. Class quizzes are tough.

Nice having no final but having a in class quiz almost every class is a lot of reading. She has great expertise in marketing research but lacks the knowledge on how to apply it to her students. Also, everyone has to give a group case study and sometimes she sits on her phone and gives you a grade that doesn't reflect since she wasn't even watching.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: No final loooooong quiz like I have to take in my other classes. One less thing to think about as I graduate. Was worth taking quizzes every class. My project client was awesome to work with. I can't wait to graduate and be done with school. Very structured course.
She is a delight *:-)

Aparna does a great job of making herself available for questions and help with assignments outside of class hours.  She is very easy to talk to one on one and has a genuine interest in Marketing Research.  Homework is a bit repetitive in comparison with in class quizzes and sometimes feels like excess busy work.  Be sure to keep up on due dates!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Aparna is a bit hot and cold. She's pretty militant about technology, but sits on her phone through student presentations. She has a good sense of humor, but can be intense and condescending. The daily quizzes are easy if you do the reading and there's no final. Term project criteria is ambiguous at first. Choose clients on campus for this project.

Aparna is a great Marketing Researcher, but she's not a great teacher.  Teaching requires empathy, leadership, and creativity--she lack all of those qualities.   However, Aparna is excited about her research, and this class clearly reflects how important marketing research truly is.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The group project expectations are sometimes difficult to understand.  There are lots of homework assignments, but they aren't graded extremely stringently.  The lectures are so-so as far as entertaining, but you will learn a lot and learn how to work with other students as you will work with two different groups throughout the term.
I thought I learned a lot from this course. Instruct has a lot of experience and is kind.
Enjoyed the course. Very structured-of you like structure, you'll love this course
Good course/instructor
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was a required elective. The class is very structured. If you are not used to structure, you may not want to take this class. Worked on a project that used course concepts.
The course structure was well thought out, and as I said, got better each week.
I like the set up on Canvas, how there is an example for each part of our projec
I felt like I learned a lot and you clearly know a lot about the subject. The class was very well organized and it was clear what they expectations were
Keith Appleby was my GTF for Research Methods. Very knowledgeable and very nice and funny.
Held our interest for a full hour on a Friday  morning when no one wanted to be there.
Good class.
Keith Appleby was probably the best teacher that I had the entire time I was at UO.

I took this class for Animals and Society. I really liked the teacher and how the course was set up. There are a lot of journals required, but it helps with the readings. It changed the way I think about animals.

It doesn't matter whether or not you go to class. Nothing from the lecture or the study guide is on the test. Reading the book and asking lots of questions in lecture is the best way to make a decent grade. Lectures are pretty dry and irrelevant if not, if you have questions DeLaurier always does her best to make sure you understand.

Knowledgeable and enthusastic. Expects you to keep up, but always takes questions. The material is tough but if you study early and hand in all the assignments you can get a C or a B. Go to tutoring, ask a lot of questions (go see her after class), and get her to read your lab reports before you hand them in and she will raise your final grade.
You will not receive an A if you take her class. Her notes and lectures do not reflect the tests. Grades extremely hard in lab and on tests. My class had a failing average of 60% each test.

Probably not a great idea to take her classes unless you have previous knowledge of the subject.  She sounds really nervous and unsure of herself while lecturing, and isn't all that helpful when trying to gain knowledge during lab section.  Tests don't reflect accurately info taught in class, but tests on fine details, not concepts or general info.
Really nice lady, and super helpful. Although she is really bad at badminton herself, she can explain techniques well. Lol
April is the sweetest! She isn't necessarily a badminton champion, but she teaches a great introductory class.
April is one of a kind
No Comments
She's easy, but cannot teach at all. You have to teach yourself at home. The tests are easy, but don't expect to learn from her.
A great teacher, and her tests are fair.  If you do the homework and study the practice exams you will be fine.. Only down side is she has one of the most annoying voices in the world! beware

I've taken courses at Linfield College, Wilamette University, Oregon State University, and Oregon.  By far the worst professor I have ever had, hands down.  Horribly unorganized lectures; if you weren't one of the kids who wanted to go in and hangout with her everyday in her office, don't plan on passing. she's a grad student on a power trip.
No Comments

He is a chill professor but very dedicated. The class is excellent; I got to learn a lot of new stuff about South Asia, which I didn't know before. He is respectful and accommodating toward his students. The readings are easy to moderate, but they are fun, providing a new lens to view things from a different cultural perspective.
He reads off of slides but adds important notes that aren't on them and assigns a lot of readings. Didn't have many assignments either. Overall he's pretty chill and grading isn't harsh.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: (HIST 186)This class involved 0 learning. The professor provides pre recorded lectures that never helped with the assignments and he always assigned readings that were well over 40+ pages. They took FOREVER to grade assignments & started putting grades in week 6. He also makes you do group projects which is nearly impossible being an online class.

This is the worst class I have ever taken. He teaches through online lectures where he doesn't show the slides and makes you follow them by yourself  He literally leads straight from the textbook or the slides on those lectures and never really explains anything in more detail than it already is in the textbook. Worst professor I have ever seen!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment:
This is literally the worst class I have ever taken. 
I wish I could go back in time and never register for this class, all because this professor is genuinely the worst I have ever had. 
The essays and exams are way too complicated and long for a course with almost zero instruction.

This course has five professors, and this section was not easy. The book was VERY difficult to read, therefore I barely read it but still got a good score on the essay. The lectures were difficult to follow and all over the place.

I made an account just to review this professor. This is the worst class I have ever taken. While presenting over zoom, he refuses to show his slides and wants you to follow along on his slides, which have at most 5 words on them. He does not help students, is rude, and says you will only get an A on an essay if it's "New York Times quality".

Professor Valiani put little effort into his course. Every class meeting he would stand in silence at every powerpoint slide, reading his notes to refresh himself on the course material because he clearly had not prepared himself to lecture. He would frequently assign unhelpful group work and play videos to fill up class time. Avoid.

Valiani is an outstanding instructor. His blending of sociology into a larger history course, and skill guiding discussions, makes for a very intellectually stimulating class. Highly recommended for anyone looking to go beyond a BA and into an MA or doctoral program; he prepares you very well to pursue your own historical areas of interest in an ac
good overall

I didn't like this class, she basically read off the lecture slides and pop quizzes seemed unnecessary as the topics covered in lecture were in the readings that were expected to be done before class. Lecture was just a reiteration of what I already knew from the readings. Not engaging but I loved my GE!

Very passionate and engaging. Grades consisted of 5 random pop quizzes (open note), 2 reflection papers, and a final project. Attendance is not mandatory, but don't miss the quizzes. She posts great study guides and thoroughly explains material while providing real-world examples. Discussion sections were helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Claims attendance isn't important but grades on it and gives you in class assignments, GE acts like we are in a ela class when grading papers and is chopped. If you aren't religious pick one and start praying now. ONLY take if you are fine writing a essay every week.

its an okay class felt like I didn't learn much and when it came to books in the library there were some that weren't available due to quantity she also walks around a lot and checks on you but will hover over you for a while if you don't know the answer to her question shes also not really broad on instructions or on the study guides for mid terms

Very eager and enthusiastic teacher! If you don't understand something, he is happy to go back over it for you. Super sweet and understanding. There are weekly quizzes, but he is a super easy grader and they're not weighted heavily.
Did not understand anything he taught us. Super confused throughout the whole course, my peers felt similar.

He talked so much but still no points get across. This is the first time I've struggled in math and it is because of this professor. I'm left confused after every class. So many quizzes/exams too! Super frustrating

Terrible lectures, the material presented by him is almost impossible to understand. Extremely inarticulate. However, grading is quite lax and allows many extensions. I would highly recommend supplementing what he teaches from somewhere like Khan Academy (or a tutor) in order to understand the material.
Great lectures and very thorough with trig explanations. I had lots of questions outside of class and he'd always get back to me quickly.

Fun and easy class. Attendance is taken by google doc and is mandatory. Classes can feel long, especially on movie watching days. Final and midterm is online. Only thing thats difficult is the project and very research heavy.

He was definitely my favorite professor I've had for my first year at school. He was engaging, funny, charismatic, and I always looked forward to that class. He set my expectations very high for my other cinema courses. His teaching helped me reach an A in that class.

I've taken Dr.A for two classes in the past (260 and 265), and both have been really interesting. He's a great prof and cares about his research/experience and teaching about film. He can be a bit quirky in smaller lectures, but he always has energy and is willing to help. No assignments in his 200 classes are super difficult as long as you try.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The mandatory $70 DRM textbook is annoying but Prof. Aronson is pretty knowledgeable about silent film history and manages to structure a class that is both accessible for beginners but also valuable to people coming in with more prior knowledge.
Super nice but very boring lectures that are not formatted well but little homework and easy final and midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a film major, it was refreshing to see someone who actually seemed like they were passionate about their field. The lectures may have felt a little stretched out, but the film choices were amazing and I felt like he has taught me about what I love more than most professors could. For future filmmakers, this class is a must-take.

Was expecting cine 265 to be really boring esp since I'm not a film major/minor but Aronson made lectures fun and engaging! You can tell he really likes what he's teaching which made the class even more enjoyable for me. Exams are a bit hard but manageable

Best CINE teacher there is. Wish I could have Dr. A for each and every one of my classes. Teaches class in a way where you learn all the needed material, but also end up laughing your ass off. Just a genuinely cool guy. Do the reading assignments on time, and pay attention to the films in class.
Dr. A is a really personable guy who has a great knowledge for cinema. He always has something to add and encourages critical thinking for ourselves. Very funny guy too.
Very nice and hilarious. The class is lecture heavy, but the exams are easy if you keep up with the readings which shouldn't be too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class with Dr. A, especially as a first-year Cinema major this class had a lot of fundamental ideas that are very useful. The class is pretty lecture heavy, and one of the days was set aside for a film screening. He is a very nice professor and is very knowledgable and funny. I would recommend taking a class from him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Respected

reviews.comment: Overall, not a bad professor, just very boring. His voice is very monotoned and his lecture slides contain to useful information. However, the exams are easy as long as you remember all the titles, dates and directors of the films. Not a hard class, just very boring. The films we watched though were somewhat interesting.

He has a very welcoming presence that creates a positive atmosphere. Sometimes he goes through slides a little fast but he posts them online so it's not a problem. I would not at all be disappointed if I took another class by him.

Aronson is a great teacher. Yeah the class is sort of boring, I mean what do you expect from a silent film class. But he made it very enjoyable. He's always cracking jokes and doesn't care if you skip (although don't walk out during a movie). If you pay even a tiny bit of attention in the class, you'll definitely pass.

I went into this class with people telling me that Aronson is the best professor in cinema studies, and they were right. He is hilariously relatable and assigns fun projects that enhance your motion picture understanding. By the end of the class, your favorite films will probably include a few silent ones. He's great and thinks you are too!

Prof Aronson has very descriptive lectures that I would recommend going to, because then you actually don't have to do the reading. His midterm was easy as long as you know the dates and look over your notes, and he's very helpful and friendly if you go to office hours . Overall, a pretty interesting class and not very stressful class.

This was a great class. He is a wonderful teacher. I personally struggled with writing the film analysis for the class but the exams are easy if you study. Chelsea was my GTF and i really liked her as well. I think 266 or 267 would have been more interesting because you watch more modern films but i still really enjoyed the class and learned a lot.

Overall good teacher. Positives: has pretty interesting lectures. Negatives: Will sometime over explain things and take forever to go over one concept, which i guess is a good and bad thing. I would recommend.

BORING. He lectures about film history and then we watch silent films. Take 267 because that is 1960's-Present so the movies will be better.  The class is a breeze, midterm was simple, and there is only 3 papers.  Aronson is a pretty out there guy and really knows his stuff.
Cool class. Half history, half films. Aronson picks interesting films for the most part which makes the class a little more fun.

He is very enthusiastic. There are a few papers that are easy for the most part. You DO have to study for his tests; it isnt an "easy A." He moves through his lectures pretty fast so if youre slow at taking notes, the lectures are online. Some of the films we watch are better than others.
Great Professor, knew his stuff, and really loves the subject.  I would recommend him to anyone!
Awesome class. You have to really like old movies though.  Great professor who seems to love his subject.
Great guy- his lectures are engaging and cover the material that you'll be tested on.  Fun, easy to understand, and very helpful.  Online notes are a lifesaver.  Highly recommended.
Best prof. at UO. This guy rocks and knows what he's talking about!

Literally the nicest guy ever. Cares so much about his students. Mostly just group presentations and then mostly lecture, and guest speaker heavy. Would reccomend to take any of his classes if you have the chance.
TAKE CAMPAIGNS WITH ATTILA. He is such a genuine and caring professor. He is there to work with you and gives incredibly helpful feedback. His classes are very interactive and he is so funny.

AMAZING Professor. Truly cares about each and every one of his students. Uses real world examples and creates opportunities and learning for students' professional development. Is very hands on, work is engaging and challenging, and he is extremely helpful. Wants the best for his students.

Professor Attila was exceptional. He was genuinely caring, made every student feel seen, and ensured we understood the material. He was a truly supportive and effective educator, leaving a lasting positive impact on me and undergraduate journey.

Dr. Julian Atanassov is the best professor I have ever had! He cares about the success of his students. Lectures are riveting, full of humor. Some of the comments are dumb- the university sets grading policy. He gives generous participation points. Show up to office hours if you want to do better. Can't understand him? That's a you thing.
Good sense of humor. LOTS of dry readings assigned and therefore a large workload. You won't get any graded papers back till the end. Somewhat easy content.
Nice guy, tries to keep the class entertaining. only complaint is that there is only one midterm and a final, but homework is easy and my grade was curved up higher than what I expected
This class wasn't as bad as I thought. Although it is a bit of a bore, Julian tried to lighten the mood which helped a lot. Take this class with him.

Professor Atanassov took his teaching very seriously. He has a strong understanding of the material and adequately illustrates it in class. His tests are difficult, so i'd recommend studying hard. If you have questions before the tests he is very prompt when returning e-mails
Julian is awesome!
It was hard understanding him.

I've never had a more considerate teacher. He was extremely easy to work with and I wish more teachers were like him. It's true the class is easy, since he lets students use notes on the tests, but my class was actually curved up a little bit. It all depends on how everyone else does, but if you do well enough throughout the term you'll be fine.

The best teacher I've had. He was very clear, always had time for students. Clearly explained all the difficult concepts. In the end, the class average was high and he had to curve down but these are the requirements of the university. Overall the letter grade average was still is higher than comparable classes in the College of Business. Great job
The worst teacher ever! He had to curve down and it messed up my GPA and I know a girl who lost a scholarship! He sucks and you cannot even understand him.
horrible teacher, class average way too high so everyone got curved down
No Comments
He is very knowledgelable on subjects. He is friendly and always there to help his students. A very nice professor at the department.

He is a very good professor. Assignments are time consuming but you learn something. He always help you with assignments during office hours and even some times he spends his personal time to help a student. He is so nice and kind to students. His tests are not very hard. Try to do extra assignments for a better grade.

Very helpful professor. The class is difficult so it's important to pay attention and do the assignments. Atkins is very helpful and will answer any questions you might have, as well as quickly respond to any emails. I highly recommend doing the extra credit and make up assignments in this class if you want an A.
Great professor, always helpful in office hours. Lectures get a little monotonous at times, but as long as you slept well or have coffee, it's no problem.

Atkins is awesome. The class becomes challenging around week 4, but his lectures and slides were clear and organized. His assignments were well-designed and reasonable. My TA (Dan Keith) was also very helpful. Does grade hard on assignments, but you'll learn a lot from  your mistakes. Certainly raised my interest toward computer science.

Atkins is very helpful, the lectures are not as helpful as they could be. I'd like to see more lab time than lecture time in CS classes. Power point presentations make me sleepy. Lots of office hours and ultimately a friendly curve. I probably bombed the final and ended up with a B.
The content is hard (Computation Theory), but Atkins is pretty easy. A harmless, nice guy, who explains stuff well (most of the time).

didnt like this class. i wouldnt recommend it unless its mandatory. tough grading system. labs were more difficult than the actual exams which were just memorization of material. Exam format (midterm/final):50 questions multiple choice, a few short answer and extra credit questions.

from my experiences GTFs dont really help..... at all. Mine was didi shes nice and all but basically all they do is explain the lab and ur dismissed jane's alright but as mentioned she doesnt reply to emails which is pretty annoying! i would not recommend this class to anyone unless ur extremley interested in geography.

At first I was excited to see the labs were 40% of our grade, I thought that was great until I realized how random they were. Also the lab rules are extremely annoying and harsh! Professor never replies to emails and GTF's aren't that helpful.

My problem with the course is how vague the labs were. An example would be "guess the elevation of this hill". I'd put something like 117m but the answer would be "110-120". Never said give a range. Because the class punishes more than rewards, it makes it sour. I'm 15 minutes away from taking this class's final. God help me...
Wish I did not take this class. It's not necessarily difficult but it's a lot of work and material for a 100 level class thats for sure!
Boring class. Jane made the boring subject slightly less boring but she never replie to emails. Lab policies are annoying. overall not bad class but I wouldn't recommend it.

Professor Atha is not a bad professor, but the class is very boring. She basically reads off of slides. Unnecessary time consuming use of the document cam. I didn't touch the textbook and still got good grades. Do your labs, and study for the tests. BORING but not extremely hard. Not the easiest but it could have been way worse.
Very helpful- GTF for Geog 141.  Would highly recommend.
GTF for GEOG 141.  Nice helpful.  Tries to go over harder concepts in the section so labs are easier to understand.

He is genuinely such a good teacher; he is very understanding, and as long as you try on the assignment, he sees that and will grade you accordingly. I've taken many of his other classes that are in-person too (this one is online), and he's such a good teacher, literally will only take Spanish classes if he's teaching them.

I literally do not have enough kind words to say about him. He is so nice and makes learning Spanish fun!! He really only cares if you try and do the work. Rafael is very organized and makes sure you know exactly when tests and quizzes are and what they will be on. I couldn't recommend him more!!!

There is homework every night, but like 30 mins of work, in class it is mostly in spanish and he is understanding about it and speaks very slowly but it would take time to adapt. I really appreciate how chill the class is that I spend more time worrying about actual spanish than my grade

I've had him for 2 terms and he is just so great! My first term I took SPAN 201 and I really forgot to turn in an entire project. I had finished it and presented it in class, didnt add the slides online. He let me turn them in late with NO penalty and I got full credit for it. He is a super easy grader but makes sure you have the skills to succeed!

Very easy grader, which was nice since it was SPAN 201. Also super nice. He cares more about the fact that you tried more than it being "correct," if that makes sense. Also he never really cold calls on anyone, like he does but not an absurd amount.

nice guy but an insane of amount of work.... and I am a premed student saying this. this class took more time out of day than doing my ochem homework. do not take this class online unless you are FLUENT.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you can, please take a Spanish class with him!! Or any class for that matter. He is an incredible teacher with a lot of passion for what he does and it's obvious he cares about his students and wants them to succeed. His lectures are helpful so definitely show up. The tests can be study-heavy, but he gives students the tools they need!! Love him

Been taking Spanish classes since middle school, and have never had someone as incredible as him! Great person, so kind and helpful. He gives amazing feedback and will not judge you if you do not pronounce something correctly. Looking forward to being in his 305 class!

You are in serious luck if you get this Prof. He's the sweetest most laid-back teacher I had out of my six terms of Spanish. He is not a hard grader and wants to see you succeed which was really refreshing. If you can get him as your teacher more than once, do it!! God bless Rafael u da bomb
one of my fav spanish teachers just so laidback and cares about students learning a lot. lots of discussion practice in class and encourages participation. rly wants his students to succeed :)

Really kind and understanding professor. If you are anxious at all about language courses and presenting/talking in front of the class etc. he makes it a less stressful environment and is encouraging with pronunciation and vocabulary. I feel like I learned a decent amount from this class and the assignments were straightforward and easy.

The class is very well structured so you know what is expected of you. His communication on assignments can be a bit confusing but he is very flexible and will let you turn stuff in many times. If you follow the rubric on assignments getting an A is not hard and although there is a good amount of work the class is not that hard.
if you are good with talking/reading/writing(not necessarily grammar and spelling) you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Take this class!!! I took the web asynchronous (I work better online) option. I recommend if you're the same way. I feel like I learned a lot! The homework is a bit daunting at first. Still, if you manage time well (especially with the Actividad Cooperativas and Resumen assignments) and engage in the readings, you will get used to it by Week 3.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Rafael was one of the most caring profs I have ever had. Fair/easy grader, but he rarely gives 100%. Very responsive outside of class, regularly sent us encouraging messages through Canvas, and truly wants you to learn and succeed. This class was difficult, but he makes you want to do your best and is very gracious if you're sick. 10/10 professor!

Prof Arias was so caring and knowledgeable. I learned a lot about Latin American history, and his lectures were very interesting and featured many videos. The homework takes a long time, but it is very useful for language improvement, and his expectations are clear.  My Spanish has undoubtedly improved and I would highly recommend his class.

I took Spanish 312 (not an option to select), this is my second class with Prof. Arias and he is the best teacher I have had at UO. He is extremely knowledgeable and has clear expectations. He is accommodating to students' needs and truly wants you to succeed in his course. The class consists of weekly readings and 2 essays. Very manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class activities are repetitive which can either be comforting or boring, but hes passionate about it and is really down to earth and helpful! Responds quickly to emails as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Arias Anrango is by far the best Spanish instructor I've had at UO (I've done all 100 and 200 levels). He truly cares and inspires. He was very understanding when I expressed how I felt I was a bit behind in my Spanish skills. His assignments are fun and I really learned a lot from this course. Thank you so much, Rafael.

I took SPAN 201 with Rafael and I like him so much that I took 202 with him. He's very caring and understanding and genuinely wants you to do well. He gives you a very good idea of what are on the tests (they're pretty much the same structure every time). He's laid back and overall a super nice guy.

This was my second time having Rafael for a class. He's super chill, really nice, and very understanding. He is an easy grader, but doesn't give 100%s so make sure to put in effort. His lectures are insightful and made me feel really prepared for tests. I always enjoy his classes
Great professor, he is very helpful and the assignments are not difficult but he never gave anyone a perfect score so do your best.
Very chill guy, lenient on grading and will accept late work despite saying he won't. He's not a tough grader on assignments, exams, or on the oral exams/presentation. Best Spanish teacher EVER!

Rafael is super chill and loves to help students outside of class in office hours or email. He wants everyone to succeed and makes sure we are prepared for exams by providing in depth study guides. You must go to class to get the powerpoint notes and do the readings to understand class, but everything is discussed if things are confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Arias-Anrango was always nice and understanding. He lets you turn in late work for full credit and wants to work with you. You can tell he really cares about working with you to further your Spanish abilities and gain confidence speaking. He wants you to excel.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Authentic, genuine, and inspiring professor. He really wants you to excel in your language performance.

Really nice guy who genuinely cares how the students do in his class. He walks throughout the class and is available for questions and to help. Also prepares the class well for the tests and speaks slowly so that everyone in the class understands.

Rafaels class was honestly really fun. Hes a native speaker which helps you learn but he speaks slowly and clarifies if needed whenever he can tell were lost.
