Nothing remotely close to that. 12 hrs of homework at least a week, does she not understand that this is not the only class that we are taking, I work a full time job
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The amount of work she assigns for a 100-level class is simply unrealistic. In my college career I haven't taken a 100-level class that has had so much work. I don't think 11 hours of work, compared to the normal 6-8 hours of most classes, is reasonable for a class called "intro to political science."

For an intro to political science class she gave us a RELENTLESS amount of work. I was doing 12 hours a week for this class. So much seemed like busy work but shes also such a harsh grader. On her reading quizzes her questions BARELY match with the text and they leave a lot of grey area which is super confusing. Seriously dont take this class

The grading is very harsh and what she expects is unclear. Assigns work as if people have no other classes and are unemployed. She seems to throw in a lot of filler work that takes up so much time and is not relevant. Would NEVER take any class of hers again. It wouldnt be over stepping to say that she thinks the world revolves around her.
Avoid unless you absolutely have no other options available
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved PS330 with Dr. Beck- I seriously learned so much about Latin America. This was a 4 week condensed summer session, so it was definitely a lot of work (20-30 hrs per week), but everything was really well laid-out on Canvas, and there were TONS of opportunities to earn credit. Take thorough notes of her lectures!! Hope to take from her again.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Never choose her class, very hard class with so many assignments. A LOT OF HOMEWORK!!! BE CAREFUL !!

One of the best teachers at UO. Go into office hours or email her questions if you can't make those -- she notices. Crucial to talk to her about your written assignment. Gives great, interesting, engaging lectures. Has pop quizzes but she'll tell you when those will be. She gives students the tools for success if they put in the work. Tons of EC!

Professor Beck is very knowledgable in her field and well respected. Lectures were difficult to follow, readings were difficult to understand especially because the class is centered around the political economy of a different country. Ample opportunities for extra credit, and office hours are not very accessible. Appreciated but would not do again
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Erin Beck gives thoughtful and exciting lectures as well as the fact that she provides you with ample material for tests. Although I highly recommend Professor Beck and this course as she is very well versed in her work, she is often very cold to students and ultimately, doesn't seem to be very sympathetic to her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her class taught me a lot. She's a very good professor and I look forward to taking her other classes. She is very intelligent in her field and challenges her students to be critical thinkers. The readings for her class are dense but definitely worth every read. More so, the readings in her class are very interesting.

She is super thorough in her lectures. She provides so much helpful information during class that you wouldn't be able to get without going. She challenges you, but by the end of it, you really feel that you learned a lot.

Erin has been one of my all time favorite professors at UO. I took both her PS 330 & PS 380 classes and they both were engaging and interesting. They are not easy classes a lot of reading is involved so be prepared to work hard.  Her tests are a lot of work but are very clear, they say exactly what she wants from the assignment.

Incredibly intelligent lectures. Fair in terms of grades. This class did not require a text book, instead weekly readings were posted online, still definitely a heavy reading course! Participation & engagement is weighted fairly heavily. Beck has a wealth of knowledge & assigns material thoughtfully. Not easy, but highly recommended.

Erin is one of the best professors I've ever had. She knows her material and gives so much to her teaching. She put as much into writing for each class session as we did. She is also compassionate, caring and driven. She doesn't budge on her rules.
Think of the worst teacher you have ever had and then times that by seven. There you go, that is exactly her. Don't waste your time in this class, its not worth the tears.

This class was a drag. Each week I dreaded the class. Mainly she goes on and on without being clear about the material or even what's expected to pass, and you get the feeling she doesn't want to be there either.
Terrible teacher. She does not explain topics that are on the tests well and grades very harshly. She is not very nice either.

Prof. Shahir's lectures are hard to follow. He writes out problems on the chalkboard in an unorganized way, and it's hard to see what he's doing if you're sitting in the wrong spot. I learned more from Khan Academy and just reading the textbook than from being in class. The homework platform is frustrating but I don't blame him for that.
Don't touch this class with a 20 foot pole unless you're a math genius

He spends the whole class lecturing and whenever he asks a question, he expects answers within 30s. Refuses to answer questions and insults those who ask. Publicly humiliated a student with a learning disability. Homework is very heavy. I switched to an 8am to avoid him. DO NOT TAKE!

If you want a math class where no matter how much work you put in theres still a 50/50 chance you pass because the teacher is so bad and the stuff he teaches isnt even on the test this is the class for you. His lecture format is back turned to the class and going over a textbook where almost every other question has an error. Pick another teacher!

This class was simultaneously the best and worst decision I've ever made. Bijan Shahir is literally one of the worst professors ever, but boy do I know how to do calculus now. His class is extremely hard to follow and he picks difficult problems for homework, but he does that to prepare you and help you succeed. He's a funny guy.

It is not worth your time. Take this class at a community college over the summer. Genuinely save yourself. I took this class in my senior year of high school and got an A. Took this class my freshman year and just about failed. He couldn't teach my class something if his life depended on it.

His class is entirely lecture based, and there are few resources you can access outside of class. All you have is a copy of the textbook on Canvas, which he's said he doesn't trust for answers, due to consistent typos in it. He spends his lectures solving problems on the chalkboard (and erases them right after). He's nice, but not the best prof.

He really based his classes off his current mood, so if he was annoyed he'd take it out a little extra on students. Judged students for their questions and would often answer in jokes and drag it on before the actual answer. Everyone in class wasn't doing too well on quizzes so he started adding extra credit which is nice i guess. still bad teacher

For the entirety of the lecture, he had his back to the class, writing equations straight from the textbook and not explaining any of it. He barely showed any examples because he didn't want to run out of time. He acted surprised when our class did poorly on the first midterm, but he didn't teach us at all.
Pick anybody but this guy. Redo your entire schedule if you have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I'd recommend selecting another prof

He is the worst grader, not everything he grades is the same. He doesn't teach only goes through problems so quickly and hand written. Doesn't give you any resources and expects you to basically learn not from him but the textbook. Even if you put down correct answers and show work taught that's not his, he will give you a 0%.

Horrible way to learn. Unless you want to teach yourself the whole class do not take this teacher. Simply solves a worksheet at his own pace expecting us to pick up on how he solves it. Teaches you a way to solve a problem then says you aren't allowed to use that method on test, if you use the method he taught you, you will get a 0. DO NOT TAKE.

Bijan is not the best lecturer, he provides lots of practice and example questions which help a lot but other than that the lectures were not great. His mood really dictates how well his lecture will be, for example, if he's in a good mood, he'll joke around and make coming to class fun, but when he's in a bad mood, lectures are virtually useless

When I was a kid I went to the only dentist my insurance could afford, during that time he would drill new cavities in my teeth and leave air bubbles under the fillings so they would fall out and I would have to come back and pay more money. Bijan Shahir is that dentist.

I got an A+ in the first 2 classes of calculus, I barely achieved a C+ in this course with Bijan Shahir. His lectures are impossible to understand, the homework is completely unrelated to tests. Exams are incredibly difficult and designed to confuse you, a professor that enjoys to see his class fail. I have never tried so hard only to barely pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He doesn't post notes on Canvas, and he doesn't review anytime we have a midterm. Our class average is 60%, and he doesn't provide extra credit when multiple students struggle to even have a PASSING grade. His midterms are worded very badly, and you will be left confused. Anytime you ask him a question, he does a deep sigh. Not a good teacher.

Calc 2 is a hard class, no matter what way you look at it, but for me, Bijan did not help me get through the class. I would not recommend taking this if you don't have a strong base of calculus and trigonometry. The first midterm class average was below 50 and the high was like a 70. Only homework is webwork, so tests and finals are graded heavily.

Whatever you think will be on the test (from study guide), is not. He takes a 2 hour long lecture to work through 5 problems, then the test will be an hour for the same amount. The tests were so incredibly hard and rushed that most people in my class had a failing grade before the curve. He cannot teach
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He has fast and intense lectures where he simply repeats the same exact process multiple times and expects all the students to understand. When he does example problems, he gives about 30 seconds to solve and thinks those who can't do it in that time aren't trying. He often brushes off questions or answers by repeating the same process again.

Reasonable, smart, and funny. Very accessible (I emailed him around 2AM a couple times and he responds within minutes). He explains the material thoroughly, and adjusts the difficulty/speed of his class based on students. I don't know why he gets such a low rating. Maybe he's different for other classes but for calculus 2, go with Bijan.

Class started with around 25 students, 6 of us showed up for the final. Lectures were all but useless, full of mistakes he expected students to catch, and many new topics introduced in this class were skipped because "you should know this already." If you take one of his classes, be prepared to teach yourself most things out of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Took him over COVID 2020. How come the first class had 60 students and by the end final exam had 9? He told students off because they asked a question that "they should know", ignored the question, and proceeded on. Incredibly unprofessional and rude. Maybe it was a zoom thing but he made sure students were not going to pass. Huge curve at the end.

Lots of negative reviews on here, but if you just pay attention you'll be fine. First midterm made my cry, but second midterm and final were relatively easy. You need to come to class though, otherwise you're screwed. Also, he makes funny jokes sometimes! Granted, this class is difficult, but that's what you're signing up for.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bijan is a great teacher but has very high expectations and moves through the content really quickly. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you miss a bunch of lectures it's hard to catch up.  As long as you put in effort on the homework you'll do fine on the tests.

Professor Shahir was not a good teacher at all. Lectures went way too fast and he made MANY mistakes and then expects us to understand what on earth he was doing. He gave us practice problems during class and gave us 30 seconds to get the answer. He is funny but that doesn't get you a long way if you're a teacher.

This professor simply does not care if you understand the material. Unhelpful in explaining things in class, unwilling to provide lecture slides, and aloof to the fact that he needs to actually explain concepts instead of assuming we have taught the class multiple times like he has.

Bijan goes very fast during lecture and can make a lot of mistakes which he expects the class to catch. He is very funny, willing to adapt to students' concerns, and responds to emails almost instantly. Will sometimes make fun of you if you try to ask questions but he's mostly just joking around

There's definitely an adjustment period with Bijan-- he's very blunt and can be quite intimidating at first, but he's really nice, funny, and supportive. 
He wants you to succeed and will help you do so, but if you don't pay attention to lecture, make sure you understand the homework, ask him questions, etc., you won't pass.
he is strict to the point of rudeness and like most math professors, he tends to over explain things to the point where he ends up convoluting subjects.

Really funny and nice, as well as forgiving. I got a 30 on my first exam and then thought I was going to fail however he averaged the two midterm grades and replaced the lowest. I tried way harder and ended up with a good grade. One bad thing is he isnt as clear as other math teachers but if you just read the textbook on what you are confused on

I've taken a couple of Bijan's classes, and the one thing I have to say is that he is incredibly disorganized. I need a clear layout (preferably visually) of how to solve a problem and the steps to take. Bijan jumps all over the place when lecturing. His handwriting is difficult to read and he doesn't lay anything out clearly. Go to office hours!!

If you are a "Math person" I would recommend Bijan. He sometimes teaches like a stereotypical math teacher, which can be rough. He is very funny. My suggestion to pass the class is do the homework. Pirate the textbook. Do as many problems from the textbook as you can. Practice your integration.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I encourage anybody who reads this to not take this professor. Besides the lack of clarity and mistakes in nearly all of his lectures, he is unaccommodating to students and generally rude. It is fair to say that taking part in his class was quite genuinely, the worst experience I have had in my educational career.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Profesor Shahir was a difficult and often confusing teacher. classes lacked learning objectives or peer interaction, and his bad handwriting did not help. If you take his class you will likely end up spending way too much time on khan academy or youtube trying to understand topics he should have taught you.

Took Calc II online, and not a great experience. The first midterm was 5 questions in 50 minutes. I made a tiny mistake on one problem while doing everything else correctly and received a 0 for that question, which dropped my grade by two letters. There is also a HUGE amount of homework every week along with the 5 hours of lecture. Do not recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Others will give Bijan a 3 because they're comparing him to even worse professors. However he really doesn't deserve it. Genuinely the only good thing I can say about him is that if you have a question he will stop lecture and try to answer it and he checks to make sure everyone is understanding. That aside, he's awful at teaching and otherwise.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bijan was funny, and also super helpful if you went to his office hours. But his tests are HARD. I'm a pretty good student (average A's/B's) and I was never able to get a test grade higher than a D in his class, and I spent entire weekends studying for his tests. Don't take his class if you're a full time student, you won't pass.

Bijan's class was a challenge, but if you attend, take notes, and do the homework regularly, and ask questions during lecture, you will do fine. You have to attend to do well. The excel assignments suck, because he asks you to do things he hasn't shown you how to do before. Also, he made everyone buy the textbook, and then did not use it whatsoever
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: You have to work for you grade, but if you show up to the lectures, do the homework, and show up to his office when you need help, he'll like you and you will like him . When he helps you on the homework, he is blunt (maybe a bit too much), but if you can handle it, you'll learn a lot.

Bijan is the a teacher that will go on the whole class lecturing unless you stop him, which he highly encourages if you are confused. He has no problem trying to understand your confusion and explaining in a new way. He also has a great sense of humor and gets a laugh from the whole class often.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He does not really explain how to use excel, but when he did it was always posted on canvas. He doesn't post his slides, but if you go to his office hours he will let you take pictures of his notes. Attending lecture helps a lot
Worst teacher I have ever had in my life. Do not ask him for help unless you want to feel stupid and have your head bitten off in the process. If i could ban anyone from teaching it would be Bijan.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I like Bijan, he is pretty much by the book and I like his style because that is how I learn best, being familiar in terminology and so forth. This is a stats class, so be prepared to use excel. Excel is the program that we use to perform statistic tests, so this should not come as a surprise. Be prepared to be challenged, but it's doable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Bijan is an accommodating professor who really cares about his student's success. If you are unsure of a concept he teaches in lecture, ask for helping he is likely to explain it in a different way. As long as you pay attention during lecture and put effort into the homework, you should be fine.

He really tries in his lectures, and you can tell he tries his best, but honestly he is a bit incompetent. Doesn't know how to run the document camera very well but relies completely on it. Constantly asking if his mic is too loud and is distracted by every noise in a class of 500+. Sometimes it is a bit difficult to understand him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This prof stayed 1.5 hours extra to help me catch up. I've never had anyone care so much. He is kinda funny once you get past the policies.

Horrible teacher. Took his online class for stats and his lack of technological know-how really makes it difficult to learn as he fumbles papers across the monitor-doesnt know how to split screen. Gets angry when people asks questions, and just a poor job explaining. I learned better watching youtube videos, says a lot about his teaching skills.

he is ridiculous. class is intro yet you must be a master of excel for his class. Honestly every person i talked to in the discussion section agrees his lectures suck because he gets distracted, gets mad at students for either asking questions or for suggesting it be done with a calculator instead (which is easier and multiple stats approve of) RUN
He never gives us the source for the excel and let us to find it ourselves.

Gets distracted/irritated easily. Almost no tech knowledge but the class is web-based so the lectures are pretty bad. Doesn't know how to use double monitors so he can't read questions and do lectures simultaneously. Attempting to answer questions other students have in chat will make him angry, I like the guy, but he needs to get tech-savvy first.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Bijan is not the best teacher, but he definitely cares about his students doing well. Definitely go into office hours a lot, and you should do fine in any class of his.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: A lot of the stuff people say about him is true, but overall a nice guy who does seem to want his students to do well and has a sense of humor. I believe he does know stats but forgets some stuff and will get confused or make things harder than they have to be in lecture. Definitely recommend taking the encore class and studying.

Bijan doesn't know how to do Stats, he would ask the class "How do you do this" constantly, and not to reinforce it; he literally had no idea how to do it. Class was a complete waste of time, if you haven't taken Stat before or can teach yourself find a different professor.

Terrible class. On the first day of class, we were told to "google" the answer to an example problem. Assignments and grading are unclear, and never gone over, so read the syllabus! Professor spends a long time on easy topics, and never once goes over the Excel assignments (the hardest part of the class IMHO). You won't miss anything by skipping.

Not the best professor, that's for sure. His lectures were very confusing. He was unsure on his own answers throughout the whole course, and his handwriting is horrid. The class was continuously being interrupted due to him getting easily distracted. Make sure you get 100% on your homework because it will save your butt with bad exam grades.

Terrible teacher, be ready to teach yourself everything. Lectures are boring and half of the time he does problems wrong and has to be corrected. Assigns excel sheets with out explaining how to do any of it. Waste of time and money for him to a professor at this school. Class isn't too hard if you are fine just teaching everything to yourself.

This class seems like it could be easy but the way he teaches makes it impossible. He is distracted easily, repeats himself too many times, his notes are so horribly written, and he never writes down the full way to do a problem. I understand the need for the excel sheets but he never explains how to do them. Do not recommend.

If I wasn't in a tutoring class, I would have failed. He is very scattered in lecture and will teach something a certain way, but then will go back on it mid-lecture when he realizes he is wrong. His notes confuse more on the lecture, and he doesn't explain things well for someone who is not good at math/has never taken stats before.

He's a smart guy, but a horrible professor. He rambles on with meaningless examples and really simple math examples, but he doesn't make any sense. He just repeats himself over and over while just scrambling his words up. You're literally wasting your money just taking the course with him

Cannot for the life of him efficiently utilize a document camera yet is inexplicably committed to them. He doesn't explain anything and he himself doesn't seem to know how to do everything very well because he makes constant mistakes. However, he's funny, available, the Web work isn't bad and the tests aren't grueling.

This professor has not been the best, my class was 520 people and he got distracted by noise easily.  He didn't always explain things clearly, but for notes we had print outs, which I found helpful (you have to print them yourself). Be ready for homework using Excel spreadsheets!

This is an Intro to Stats class. INTRO. And he expected that every single person in the class already knew exactly how to use Excel and all the ins and outs. He barely showed us. At some points he told us just to watch a youtube tutorial for problems bc he was too lazy to show us. I pay so much money to go to school here & I'm told to just watch YT
Lots of work, but he's available for questions.

Overall a pretty good experience. This class is extremely easy to succeed in if you are willing to go to class and read the book. I never took notes in class and with a decent amount of studying I got an A!

Best Prof I've ever had.  Stayed in his office for 2 hours to help me pass.  He CARES!   I never asked a prof for so much help, nor received so much help.  He transformed my idea of my education... and even wrote me a letter of recommendation for a scholarship   Prof Shahir is firm, so  some students don't like him, but he rocks!

Gives online homework, written homework, and quizzes every week. Gets impatient very easily and doesn't give the student a chance to talk when asking a question. Strays off topic during lecture and doesn't speak TO the class; speaks AT the class. Not helpful at all, would not recommend at all.

I knew going into this class, that it would be difficult. However, Bijan makes sure you feel the burn. I spent 30+ hrs a week and I got a 45% on the midterm. The class average was 50% and there was never a curve. Started with 35 students, ended up with less than half of that. I had to also drop.

Dr. Bijan works really hard to help us students.  He answered my email at 1:30am! I like science, but this guy loves it.  If you need help visit his office hours because he stays late if you need it.  And he always has snacks too!

Professor Shahir has so much patience. I went to his office for help almost weekly and he stayed late to help me get a better grade than I thought I could.  I wish he was my prof in all these science and math classes.

If you can avoid this prof for physics, I highly recommend it. He uses the slides directly from the book, has his GTFs do all of the grading, messes up all of his demos, and then complains when he has to do any work. One of my least favorite teachers at Oregon.

He isn't helpful at all. Physic is not my thing. I got a B+ in the first midterm and suddenly failed the second mid term. I was studying hard for each mid term. It seems to me only math and science people can handle this course.
This guy may be smart but he should NOT be a teacher!

I'm stunned that people gave this teacher the "good quality mark." The Physics 101 class he's teaching right now is a mess. He's not clear when describing key concepts, doesn't explain things from multiple perspectives and last class he somewhat yelled at a kid that asked a question. Maybe Math is the better subject for him to teach, not physics!
excellent

Best math teacher at the university. Calculus in general is just awful but he makes it as clear and easy as possible. He is very understanding and works with the class'questions. All the exam & quiz questions are from the book or webwork. Early morning and Friday is not ideal but one of the best Calculus classes if its a requirement he is your man.

Best professor I've ever had. Show up in class, because he notices.  Provides ample resources, always stays as late as needed to help students, and really tries to help you out.  Clearly outlined course.  I was failing until 3 weeks before the final and he stayed late to help me every day.  I got a 93% on the final and a B in the class.

The class was difficult, but if you go to his office he'll always make time to help you.  On webwork, i'd email him questions at 11pm or later, & he'd respond in time for me to submit my HW at 12. The quizzes & tests are pretty easy if you get the homework. Just sometimes its hard to get the homework(cause it's math)

I had prof birdie for my psychology of trauma class and she was not helpful outside of class and would often be passive aggressive. she has no empathy and will not care about any circumstances you'll have to miss class/exams. avoid avoid avoid not worth it

Birdie is a a wonderful professor and person to get to know. This class is very lecture-focused, so be prepared to show up to class every meeting and pay attention, because the tests revolve closely around the lecture content. She has lots of interactive lectures to help remember important concepts. Be prepared to ask questions, and you'll do great

Shes a wonderful person who has potential to be the best prof ever, but her organization skills are her downfall. Nobody knew what we were supposed to be doing, she forgot about our final exam and had to write the questions last minute (it came out days late). 0 instructions for final project and arbitrary grading. Ask a million q's and youll be ok

Such a sweet person but her teaching leaves much to be desired. Very poorly structured classes, and exams that she seems less prepared for than the class is. The 2-page syllabus is no help, lecture slides are of very little use. The final project was an absolute mess through and through, she has potential to be great, but needs alot of work.
Lectures were super interesting and informative.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: boring lectures, mandatory attendance because of pop quizzes/discussions. Easy-ish tests but like 90 questions for some reason.
You will enjoy his class. Not a lot in the grade book, so if you ace the pop quizzes, you will do great.
The absolute best teacher ive ever had. Not just a teacher, a friend, a mentor, and a life coach. He is a legend

The lectures were extremely boring and long, and then the midterm and final had 80 multiple choice questions that were very specific based on the lectures. Wouldn't really recommend unless you take notes in class.

HILARIOUS guy! Bish is totally in his element while presenting, and he'll often engage with the students by asking questions/using examples. I thought a majority of the lectures were engaging, you just have to pay attention. The content is very heavy on media history, which was interesting (to me). Would for sure take again.

he's a great person and has a lot of valuable information but don't take unless you're very interested in media. this is not the kind of class to take for a credit, though it's a pretty easy pass. two essays and some pop quizzes. get ready to hear the word "etcetera" a billion times a lecture. lectures for 2 hours straight. hard to follow at times.
The goat. Thats all I have to say

One of my favorite classes I've taken, such a great professor full of endless knowledge about reality television. Genuinely cares about each and every student's opinion, which feels so rare as a business student. Wish I could take this class every term.

Sen did an amazing job of teaching this course, he truly cares about his students minds and opinions which made the classroom environment really engaging and enjoyable. He highlights his favorite parts of your notes and has everyone share them out, which was sweet. Would highly recommend this class, I wish I could take his classes every term

Bish is the best professor I've had. He had the unique ability to keep me engaged for two hours and make me want the class to go longer. Although the subject itself is not the most engaging, he made it engaging. If you attend the lectures and take notes, you will pass. There are two 80-question exams, two mini-essays, + weekly assignments.

Bish does his best to entertain the class during his lectures! The information covered is mundane but the way he explains it is much more engaging. Info is easier to learn if you attend lectures but don't stress too much if you have to miss one. GEs are incredibly helpful if you run into issues. Tests are 80 multi-choice, and at least skim readings
Lectures are a little too long and Prof Sen knows— he
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I cannot describe how much I regret taking this course. Although valuable, The course itself just feels like a jumble of other academes into a so-called class. Sen himself although nice has outdated teaching methods and has heavy weighted assignments. The study guide provided did not reflect the test at all. Do not recommend.

I hated being in this class, Bish is very nice, but he doesn't give extra credit and majority of the course is graded on tests. We spent 4 weeks on the telegraph and genuinely this isn't how a JCOM class should be taught. His midterm was riddled with as he said “trick questions”. Do. NOT. Take. This class.

Lectures can be a bit dry, but stay engaged and you'll get a lot out of this class. Utilize resources like unstuck study alongside the materials to prep for quizzes. Discussion boards are graded strictly, so put in the effort. Overall, an interesting subject worth taking.

Professor Sen was easily one of my favorite professors I have had at UO. JCOM 419 is a super fun class that analyzes reality television and the majority of the class is watching shows and having open discussions about them. There were a couple essays and a group round table presentation that were fun and engaging.

YOU HAVE TO PAY ATTENTION IN HIS CLASS!! Lectures are not hard to follow; the content is very well selected and engaging. There's a lot of readings, but you only need to get the main points. Like others said, he pushes the class to challenge and expand perspectives, which is great for students looking for classes to ACTUALLY learn/grow from.

I thought he was great, Just very heavy on lectures and if you are not there it will affect how you do on the test. He took up the full time every class and really knew what he was talking about. Just make sure to pay attention.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Sen is great. His lectures are sometimes a bit drab, but are interjected with comedic outbursts. The class had two multiple choice exams, one paper (and another completion-graded paper), and weekly quizzes. The weekly quizzes are almost entirely based on the lectures. His GEs did all of the grading and were very accessible.

Im a first year college student. Prof Sen is genuinely nice but his class was 2 hours long for no reason. The first 5 weeks, we only talked about the telegraph. He said that dogs and cats don't have souls. He said Albert Einstein didn't have a soul because he was a mathematician. Im pretty sure he's a Marxist. 20 minute tangents about nonsense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Sen is clearly very passionate about the material he teaches and offers a lot of wisdom in his lectures. I found him to be super nice, funny, and a very organized lecturer. He utilizes his GEs well and incorporates guest lectures into his course. The few papers assigned are generously graded with very clear expectations outlined. Great class!

Mixed feelings about this professor. Amazing person, really interesting lectures I learned SO MUCH. Was a great teacher for J429. He is really chill about attendance, assignments: just one presentation, one paper and one essay. Really interesting class, just know he YAPS. do what you wish with this info, I say easy A, but theres no structure
Lecture heavy but are easy to understand and easy to apply when doing homework

The weekly readings are so long for no reason and it's a gamble on whether or not they show up in the weekly quiz. For the weekly discussion, I learned halfway through that in order to get full points you have to tell your life's story to the GE. The lectures were interesting after the first 4 weeks of the course, but don't take it as an elective.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I felt cheated by taking this course because he recorded the lectures several years ago and didn't update the material. His GEs accused me of cheating and that this class was not worth taking in any fashion. wish I never took this class. If you don't need to take this class don't do it It is a waste of time in my opinion
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bish is an absolute delight. He's so funny and caring about the students. Gives great feedback and is a fair grader. He wants to push your thoughts to the max to get those great ideas out of you. The class itself is super fun, you watch really funny reality tv shows and it's fun when the class laughs along.

I took an asynch class, so it was all lecture videos and slides, weekly quizzes and discussion boards. Had to put video speed at 1.5x because he talks kinda slow. Lots of required reading that isn't really referenced much (aka i didn't realize there was any until week 4). Good GEs. Only one essay. I would suggest taking this in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I wouldn't recommend J201 online because it's a lot of work, but if you do take it you can get the gist from the lecture slides and don't have to watch lecture videos. It's very tedious though.

This professor is probably the most boring person I have ever heard speak in my entire life. I would almost fall asleep listening to his asynchronous lectures. Eventually, I just would pause on his slides and take notes, because he didn't really contribute any good information. All the info was on the slides themselves. Too much content a week too.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I feel like Bish is a good guy and you can really tell that he is passionate about the subjects he is teaching. Aside from the lectures being lengthy, my biggest concern was the fact that the discussion boards were graded harshly (I never got full credit) and there was no rubric or feedback given.

I loved this class and the way Prof Sen had it set up as an online class made a lot of sense and was made it easy to complete. There is a moderate amount of reading each week but nothing too bad. Test questions are from the lecture slides so take detailed notes! The final 4 page essay wasn't bad at all and could be finished in one night. 9/10

If the word boring was represented by a person, it would be this guy. The lectures were so long, and oh my god was it agonizing. Not only is the material boring, learning about code and old TVs, but hes boring too. The tests pull from random things he says super quickly, so you have to pay attention. But wow is it hard.

If you are going to take it online, make sure to screenshot his slides, it doesnt worth the time to write them down. Also read the slides before quizzes and exams, most stuff are from the slides(couple from the reading)! I never got full credit for discussion post, the feedback arent helpful bcuz different topic each week.

I actually really liked him! The class is fairly easy - just 2 50 question exams and 1 four page (double spaced) essay - so overall it was pretty easy. Everything made sense and he was super organized. Grading was done by the TA's and sometimes grading was a little weird but it wasn't bad at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Bish is a great teacher! The class itself is pretty easy: 3 tests and one paper. Attendance is not mandatory which is nice but dont take advantage of that. If you dont go to the class you will miss alot of material and not do well on the test. But Bish is fantastic!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, a great and caring professor!
This class is pretty easy work wise there are three tests and one paper. The tests have specific names and dates so you will have to study. Lectures are pretty boring but Bish is a funny guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he's funny without trying to be, but also says some out of pocket things. The material is pretty boring. It should honestly be called "History of Journalism." Memorize random facts and you'll pass
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bish is a interesting character but a sucky professer. His lectures are rushed most of the time an the exams have such random and specific questions for things he barely covered. You have to do good on all of the exams because there's nothing to do if you want your grade raised.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bish is a nice and funny character, but the lectures can be a lot. He enjoys talking and using students in examples to get his points across, but often uses up his time and has to RUSH through the slides. He posts them online but sometimes the slides are vague and you can't tell which part will be on the test. I liked this class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The only graded things in class are exams and one research paper. He was not easy to get in contact with and will not allow you to see your test after being graded, so you do not know what areas you need to work on. There is no feedback or room for improvement. The GEs werent very helpful either.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This guy is a beast. You can tell he is very intelligent by the way he speaks. He gets side tracked easily but that is the beauty of Professor Sen and how his mind works. He is also very witty and a very helpful teacher. One of the best professors at the UO. 10/10 would recommend. Hes dope af

Bish makes you feel bad for answering questions... If you don't answer exactly what he wants he WILL roast your answer. Bish goes off topic often and mumbles so its hard to understand what the necessary information is. If you give a good answer he will interrupt you and talk over you. Green slides are not posted to canvas so you should go
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Bish was awful at staying on topics. His lectures are very heavy and the exams are full of multiple choice questions that are oddly specific and hard to get a decent grade on unless you memorize all the names and dates of random things. His GE gave me a C on the paper which made it hard for me to get more than a C in the class

Bish was great for Media and Society. He tried to make dull material interesting by joking or using metaphors. The test questions are oddly specific, so you have to study the lecture and do the readings to do well on them. It's hard to tell what he'll ask about it, so study everything. The one essay was also enjoyable to research and write.

Bish is really funny. But his lectures are so long and boring. Everyone ends up falling asleep or leaving. Attendance is not mandatory. You are only graded based off 3 exams plus a paper that's worth 35% of your grade. Unless you have to take J201 for your major or you're just really interested in the history of journalism, don't take this class

This class honestly sucks. Bish mumbles a lot during lecture and his slides are extremely boring. Moreover, his GEs are of no help. Everyone either falls alseep in his lecture or has realized that they might as well sleep in their bed and skip class because if they go to class they will just fall asleep in their seat. Don't take this class.
Very boring class and graded only by a few things. He curves the tests a lot so you don't really need to show up all that often. He is very funny and nice. I recommend taking this class.

This class should be called "History of Journalism". The content is very boring but Sen makes it fun (or as fun as it can get at 8:30 on a Monday). He's quirky and funny. If you go to class and take notes/do a quizlet you'll be fine for the tests, but the 35% paper is rough and my GTF was unforgiving. J100 is a much better intro class to Journalism

Okay, J 201 is such an interesting course but Bish makes it a snooze fest. His lectures are not very engaging, slides always look like it was designed to lack creativity, moves through slides like he is racing in NASCAR, and the green slides become the cherry on top of this mess of a course. I would highly suggest not taking a course under his nam
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He is realistic

Bish is super cool and clearly very intelligent. He always has funny things to say about every slide. However, I had him at 8:30 am and he constantly went off on tangents, which made it hard to pay attention sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: This is a very interesting class! I learned a lot in it, but the lectures had a LOT of content and I always left with my hands hurt from taking notes and writing the green slides. Get ready, it's a lot every class and he explains it fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Bish is a really nice and caring professor. J201, on the other hand, was super boring. I would not recommend the class unless it's required or unless you are really fascinated by the history of media. On tests, study names and dates carefully. Pretty average class overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: You dont need to get the textbook, but youre graded off of only 4 things in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Would definitely recommend Bish for J201. He is a funny guy and interesting. Only 3 tests and one essay.

I took Bish's Reality TV class. There are 4 assignments that go into your grade: "screening notes" (aka attendance), midterm, group presentation, and final paper. Really easy and super clear grading criteria. Bish is a wise, engaging, & funny guy - but his lectures are tough. He uses no visual aids so you listen to 1-1.5 hours of just him talking.
J412 was easily the most entertaining class I have taken, especially with this professor! He was super funny and laid back. You watch Reality Tv Shows about 70% of this class!

Professor Sen is a really nice, super helpful and informative professor. His lectures are interesting and its definitely a good job to attend class because he specifically tells you what you are going to need to know for exams. He is a professor that will do whatever it takes to help you out with the material.
Bish makes class fun to go to. Best class In J school. Tests are easy if you go to class and pay attention.

Professor Biswarup Sen is amazing! He has a really witty sense of humor which makes his lectures interesting. The GTF's were annoying, except one I think his name was Thomas the other two were kind of immature and seemed to mock the professor at times, not cool. I don't know why I mentioned that but yeah take this class you wont regret it.
bish is fabulous
best teacher i ever had and so witty and kinda hot
Pretty interesting class. The GTF's are annoying but the tests are rather easy. The final is a combination of questions from past midterms.
Really funny guy, tests aren't too hard if you study a bit. I hardly used the book and got a good grade in the class. I would recommend him.
Awesome professor. Wish I could take his class again. He really knows what he is talking about and is funny.
best class in j-school
Interesting and easy class. I went to class about half the time and still got a B. His lectures were interesting and very philosophical, but he posts them online. GTF's were rude and unhelpful.

Very interesting class. The teacher is pretty funny but goes off topic a lot. This is class that can be missed because he puts all of his lectures on line. Just read the book and then study his notes before the tests and it should be an easy B. Only 3 tests and 1 paper. Not too bad
Really good teacher, has an accent but it's easy to understand he is really interesting, and i loved taking his class.

Most boring professor of my life.  His indian accent makes him impossible to understand, and  coupled with his lack of knowledge and offensive, tangental quips, he makes 8 am on monday a terrible time to be awake. Never take this class, unless you enjoy powerpoint slides with paragraphs as bullet points.

Really easy class.  If you memorize the answers to the study guide he provides, you can guarantee yourself at least a B on the test.  On the other hand most of the time during the lecture he goes off on random topics that make you wonder, "why am I at this class right now?" it's even worse when you have class with him at 8am. dont take 8am class.
god awful, boring, and only teaches for the test!

Bish was a great teacher. He was extremely funny, witty, and I learned a lot of interesting things in his class. We spent the whole term watching television episodes and analyzing them, which was quite interesting. I wrote my final paper on Sex in the City and got a B on it and a B+ in the class. Fun class that s also a GPA booster.
Bish Sen was a cool, funny, intersting, little man. Enjoyed the class, bit boring a times...the test are easy as long as you read the lectures on line
hes funny... when you can understand him. his indian accents pretty strong.

Bish is the man. I took Mass Media and Society from him my first term at UO and loved it. His lectures are always interesting, and he is extremely funny as well. Plus his accent makes everything funnier
Prof Sen is a pretty funny professor. He can actually keep people awake at 830am with his humor. Worth it. Totally fun.

Professor Sen is awesome. He made reality tv into an upper-division English class, which is no light feat. I liked how the class discussions were real class-wide discussions. It felt like we were really working with him so that as a group we could discover things about reality television. Too bad is is just going to teach Journalism form now on. :(
I hate big lecture classes, but this one was by far the best I took. This guy is hilarious.

I enjoy going to class...at 8:00 AM.  That right there should tell you something.  Bish is hilarious, passionate (both about journalism and teaching) and just a good guy to listen to.  He could make it as a stand up comic playing B level clubs just by lecturing. I seriously live this class.
very good, funny, clear
I loved this class....Bish Sen did a great job to making our having to be in class at 8:30 in the morning worth our while. He always made us laugh and was VERY easy to connect to what he was saying
great class. brilliant professor. fabulous sense of humor.
I highly recommend Bish's class! I took 3 classes with him and loved them all. his sense of humor is great and helps you engage with the material provided.

i ADORE him. he is absolutely brilliant and hilarious. makes really boring things pop. says the smartest things ever. my roommate and i are talking about him and his ideas all the time. i made all my friends take his class and they thanked me.
like really smart guy -- funny and brilliant and kind of sexy. i will take any and every class he teaches

One of the funniest professors I have ever had. He's really witty and very entertaining. His class is pretty interesting but he posts all his lectures online so you dont really have to go to class. The midterms are hard but not impossible. But Bish is hilarious and I'm glad he was my professor.
Awesome teacher, really easy class, read the book and take notes and its an easy A! Funny guy, really interesting stuff!
interesting guy- somewhat funny in his own way, smart guy, wise guy, somewhat full of himself and the world in general, can be intimidating, but none the less an interesting guy.

I took both eng 399 and j 201 from Bish.  He is definitely one of the best professors I have ever had. His wit and intelligence propel the class into really stimulating class discussions.  The analysis we learned to make has helped me in other classes too. I would take another class from him in a heartbeat.

This professor confused me and my friends everyday with his ridiculous statements and annoying ways of teaching. The only time I learned/understood anything in this class was when we had guest speakers.
This my most favorite professor in the world. Bish is totally brilliant and his wit is far out. far far out.

Bish is an absolute riot. He is a really cool guy and makes "Mass Media & Culture" into something you can stand. He is a  very funny guy who is a good professor. He is on the easy side, and his tests were very easy. He used the textbook little, which made me regret buying it. If you're a J major and have to take 201, trust me, take it with Bish Sen
very funny and loves what he does!
i loved the detective fiction class so as you are deciding, make sure you ask around. bish really made us think - i recommend this class highly
Went to the class 7 times, total. 2 for midterms and only twice to turn in papers. the other 3 were pointless because we did literally nothing. Still can pass the class!
He's a good professor

I have taken a LOT of classes in the English department and Bish's class was by far the best! He really makes it clear why cultural studies matters - his mind works at lightning speed and it is a pleasure to hear him think! And he is witty - witty - witty!!!

Bish is a professor that will force you to think outside of the box.  ENG 399 (TV Genres) was an intensely interesting course and Bish's knowledge of the material is great.  If you're looking for a professor that allows you to think and doesn't believe in one right answer, register for one of his classes.
He makes a dull subject very interesting and keeps class exciting. If you have to take J201, take it with SEN - you will learn something and be entertained.
i really enjoy his class lectures and think they are incredibly useful. he is also very funny!!!

The lectures are useless but there is an attendence sheet so be sure to show up. Don't even bother trying to take notes during the class or reading the book because he posts summaries of his lectures on blackboard that are relevant to the tests. Overall it's an easy course and Bish is a very interesting little man.
Sen is an amazing professor - intellectually demanding, verbally dazzling. I would take a class with him just for the experience!
I really loved this class.. and I do not agree that he gos off topic - he really makes us think in new ways.
Very entertaining but gets off topic...best class I had all term!
Bish is pretty funny, his lectures aren't very good but he has some interesting thoughts on the world and the media
gets off topic A LOT but still keeps the class interesting.  he knows a lot about pop culture which is something you wouldn't expect from him.
Gets off topic, very philosophical, very boring
Pretty funny, makes class interesting. Gets off topic really easily and hard to study off of the study guide.
Professor Sen is an amazing teacher. He really opened my eyes as to how popular culture can be intelligently analyzed. Take as many classes with him as you can!!!
Really great teacher. Knowledgeable and fun on the topics
I LOVE this professor - he is the best! Really taught me to look at media in a new way. Take a class with him - you will not be disappointed.
sen rocks. cool. funny. interesting
One of my favorite GEs ever, super amazing and has such a passion and care for the class and students involved it makes things feel a lot less scary. Would recommend him always!

So far, he is my favorite GE at UO. He was so funny and encouraging in class, super helpful during office hours, and got the class engaged in discussions. If you have him as your GE, you'll end up loving discussion section.
Terrible GE. Avoid having him as a discussion leader at all costs. Doesn't know how to teach and is a harsh grader for an introductory class.
Very engaging teaching style, involved the class a lot in lectures.

This class was for my science requirement, I have not taken any geology classes before, grading was  rather harsh. Labs are hard but on diverse topics. iClicker quizzes were given every lecture and then used for attendance. Teaching assistants were late in turning in grades.

DO NOT take this class if you can avoid it I would suggest doing so. The labs were confusing and near impossible. The lectures are painfully boring and monotoned. The tests are super difficult and the class never averaged above a 50-60% on both the final and midterm. He curves which is nice but not good enough. Seriously do not take this class!

Learning mineralogy is a part of being a Geology-major. Prof Bindeman can tell you about 100+ minerals and why these are interesting and important. I also want to find employment in mineral industries and this is why I took this course. I wish we had more time using microscope!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Bindeman is funny and taught me basics of Mineralogy. I enjoyed microscopes!

A funny guy, he is super knowledgeable and smart.  Cleary cares about student success and wants you to understand the concepts.  The class is tough but that's because the material is hard, Ilya communicates concepts well and is more than willing to stop and answer questions. He uses plenty of visuals to illustrate the main points.  Rewarding class.

I have taken three classes with him at this point, and I like him more as a professor now than I did after the first class. He's funny, and though his classes are challenging, I do think I learned a lot, particularly in mineralogy and petrology.
I am a Geology major and for people who are passionate about Geology, Ilya is great!
I learned a lot about isotopes in this class, although I am not a Geology major

He changed the final presentation rubric three days before the presentations were supposed to start, the whole term it said the presentations were 5 minutes, but Friday before the presentation week he emailed us saying the presentations were 15-20 minutes and changed the Canvas rubric as well. Bad communication and unclear expectations.
How does this guy still have his job?! He can barely communicate with another human in English let alone teach an entire class of students. He is very rude if you try to contact him outside of class.

The most disorganized instructor I have ever seen. There's like 2-3 put files with different names for 1 lecture and they are so sloppy and thrown together. Bad English and bad explanation of simple equations and concepts. Does not like to answer questions. Worst professor ever. Should also be a grad course, undergrads all dropped.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had to take this Geological Hazards Class during pandemic in an online format, it was a challenge. Professor bindeman allowed us to use extra time and his lectures were very engaging with a few technical glitches in the beginning.

This class was way easier and more interesting than GEOL331. Tests were average for a 300-level college class, and curved. Labs weren't bad and didn't require much time, if any at all, outside of the scheduled lab times. It really helps to skim the textbook and go through any study guides given before exams.

awful professor. went in to class passionate about geology and left with a hole in my heart. unclear expectations, unorganized lectures, confusing and often unrelated labs, doesn't ask for questions. tests were given without a study guide and we were told to study from his lecture slides which were mostly photos. very disappointed.

He curves a lot which is great. The class is somewhat interesting but the labs we did every class were extremely confusing, he did not go over the labs at all and they usually were not hard but he made it hard by not telling you how to do it. He is a cool guy though. Also hard to understand, if you don't do well with accents.. good luck...

I really liked the class a lot. The only people who got poor grades were the ones that were on the phone the whole class. Pay attention in class, do your labs, and study for the exams and you'll  be just fine.
Great  Prof with good sense of humor, I like the way  he presents material from simple to difficult in the same lecture making you think why this is the way it is!
Great class ad clarity. Very enthusiastic professor, he took us on a fieldtrip to the Crater Lake, I liked it a lot. I am not a science major but his lectures and labs engaged me a lot
Passable class if u do the work. Labs twice a week, but he gives you a week to finish and turn them in. Lectures are boring but are on bb. Has a russian accent, sometimes hard to understand.

Exam problems closely resemble what you see in the textbook so there aren't any surprises come test day. His hand writing is usually clear and easy to read. He'll go over a lot of problems to make sure everyone gets it. Overall a great math teacher.

He is the best. Definitely take him if you can. Super straight forward class, super sweet and understanding teacher. Flexible deadlines and very reasonable grader. Overall great guy and very passionate teacher!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor takes up almost the entire class time taking about culinary history bashing political beliefs he disagrees with, and talking about how cultural identity of certain groups is being erased by Americans to this day. He also cusses way too much and hates "traditional" and "oppressive" forms of professional writing, so he doesn't teach it
Super chill guy, WR 121 is without a doubt the easiest class I have taken my freshman year. You just need to go to class the attendance points make up for a lot of the grade.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! Super understanding, especially if you need an extension or extra help. Always willing to talk after class or over email. The focus is on developing your own writing style and voice without the pressure of proper or correct writing. A small amount of outside reading is required.

EC311-So awesome. Material isn't necessarily easy but is great at explaining and slides are very useful and posted. Midterm and final heavy but it's fine because there's nothing on either that you 100% wouldn't expect to be there; not just content, actual questions you've seen multiple times and have been told will be on there. No curve balls.

class was rather difficult. was graded by 3 midterms(lowest dropped)-25% each or 50% total, and a comprehensive final-40%. minor points for participation and 1 assignment. I enjoyed his teaching style but it is difficult material. basically no homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing Grad Teacher, get ready to be assaulted by 2000s slang but amazing lectures, easy to follow and you will have a great opportunity to learn.
Hand writes lecture notes, super lenient, gives opportunity for extra credit, grades fairly, less stressful class.
Took this as an intro course and he went out of his way to try and get internship opportunities for me in Eugene and elsewhere even though I'm not in the major.
Thankful for the guidance and help for helping me pursue my academic goals!
Showed he cared. Tried to bring our own personal interests into class. Would take again.

He makes inappropriate jokes in the class. He told us that we could ask him for recommendation letters and he would be supportive of us but he declined my request which was really rude. I cannot believe this professor!

Although the class was extremely easy, I learned nothing. He cares about his students but some things about him really annoyed me. He said that one thing he cares about is the power of women, but made jokes and offensive comments about any woman he talked about. The class is a waste of time for the PPPM major. He cares but can just be insensitive.
A wonderful instructor, and an even better person.

Dr. T's passion, dedication, and genuine concern for students' success make him a role model and an invaluable asset to the U of O. I consider myself fortunate to have had the privilege of being his student and wholeheartedly recommend him to anyone seeking a wonderful educational experience!

PPPM 460: Health Policy
He makes insensitive jokes about medical situations and vulnerable situations. We have not talked about a single health policy, but slides are full of videos from tv shows and jokes. Slides are text dense and he often talks about how unimportant the information he is sharing is. This class is a waste of time.

One of the only professors I've encountered that truly cares about his students. Dr. Thomas' lectures usually last around the allotted hour and twenty minutes but often feel like less time due to how he lesson-plans and his excitement/knowledge over the material. I rarely feel the need to write a review but I almost feel obligated to in this case.

One of the easiest classes I have taken at the University of Oregon. Dr. T cares about his students and the class is set up so that anyone could get an A if they literally just paid attention. 4 "tests", but you are only tested on underlined materials in slides that are very straightforward. Reading is optional and does not affect class performance

Dr. Thomas is one of the absolute BEST instructors I have EVER had.

He makes the lectures fun and engaging.  His tests are not open-book, so you will need to memorize key points.  I am taking him for Spring Term for another class, he is that excellent.  He even bakes homemade cookies on test day!  Highly recommend.

Every day I get more annoyed by this class and this prof. It's an easy class, but the prof is hard to work under. The way she speaks to her students sometimes is almost like we are children. I do not recommend this professor.

She's great, she's a very personal teacher and gives great, educational, and easy-to-follow lectures. There's no midterm, and the project you need to do for the class is simple and applicable outside of school. Plus, the most commonly graded thing which are her weekly tests, are super easy if you go to lecture and read.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really do not like how this prof organizes her class. She doesn't take attendance, but if you miss class you will not have access to course materials on canvas. everything is password protected, so if you miss a day for being sick theres no way to prepare for the following class. Seems counterproductive and not in the best interest of students.

The class is called Culture and Mental Health, but someone tell me why I've only learned about Latin culture and it's all statistics. Like I know 60% of Latinos deal with depression, but I can't tell you why or how they deal with it. She's super boring and bland and out of 150 people only 20 people show up to lecture. Do not recommend this class.

this class was not at all what i thought it would be. literally all we talk about is Latinx experiences with mental health. her lectures are so incredibly boring but attendance is not mandatory and you get extra credit for showing up. weekly quizzes worth 50% of your grade but the answers are easy to find online.

Review pt. 1: Wright is a good professor and very passionate but her classes aren't super engaging. With that being said, this class was not what is was expecting at all. I came in thinking it was going to be about therapy and mental health psychopathology but its not. This class is more based on Latinx individuals mental health statistics.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Blaine is someone you can tell is passionate and cares about the classes he teaches. This was a new class, so he and the other prof were still working things out, but they always tried to make things best for everyone

It is very difficult to meet his expectations. He has a very clear vision of what he wants but doesn't articulate them in class or on assignment descriptions whatsoever. It is extremely rare to receive full credit on any assignment and he will reduce you points for unexpected things. He is the most frustrating teacher or professor I have ever had.

Mark is a super nice guy and is very passionate about journalism. However J212 is an utterly pointless class, full of busy work and bs assignments. Mark yaps about god knows what through his lectures and is super friendly.  It's not Mark's fault but the class is kind of a joke.

Mark is a cool professor. He is very passionate about journalism and wants the best for his students. He is always available to meet outside of class and communicates clearly. Typically, half of the class time is left for independent work and time to ask questions which I found more beneficial than a 2hr lecture.

Mark is a funny professor. For this class, we had two 50 minute lectures a week. Mark lectures about information only a high schooler would need to know. I stopped going to lectures after a few weeks. Whole class is pointless. Assignments are boring and even more pointless than the lectures. Didn't learn anything. Horrible class.

Mark was a great professor for the intro science communication class. He was funny, made the topics relatable, and gave good criteria for what he was looking for in the different projects. A lot of small projects but no tests or midterms. I'm looking forward to taking another class with him in the future. Easy A as long as you participate.

The lectures are interesting with multiple guest speakers throughout the term. He is approachable and tries to make lecture engaging. His jokes are quite dad-like but I would take a class with him again (responds to emails late). Seems to give good feedback, but the only feedback students should listen to is their GTFs for the Gateway sequence.

Mark was an amazing professor and I truly enjoyed attending class. The skills we learn in lecture are incredibly important for our lives beyond the university, and Mark does an excellent job getting students pumped about their careers in journalism. I strongly recommend choosing mark for your early journalism and pre-j classes.

He was a very entertaining lecturer who was much more helpful than my GTF in Info Hell, and he really helped everyone relax. In Flux, he really lets the students do their own thing, but he's always there for guidance. The only downside to his teaching is really no downside at all: I start blushing every time he talks to me!

Mark is a great teacher who inspires our class to become the best journalists we can be. Isn't always available to speak to outside of class, but GTFs are well-informed of his wishes. I would highly recommend taking Gateway with this professor over the others.

Mark has been one of the best professors I've had to date. He is knowledgeable, helpful, interesting, and funny. He made me realize again why I am a journalism major.I would highly recommend any class that he teaches.

This class is useless and the professor is a hack. Lecture was rarely anything more than a convoluted way of explaining how to do a Google search. The prof wasn't available outside of class and didn't respond to emails. If the J school wants to churn out a new wave of amateur bloggers with this "revolutionary" program, it will be successful.

The girls don't mind that he treats you like he's superior because they enjoy looking at him (although he's got a funny face) but he is not very easy to understand and is not often available to help outside of class.  He has a way of explaining things that makes them seem even more confusing.  Two thumbs down.

Blaine will give you all the encouragement and big ideas you will need to get through Info Hell. He even brought cookies for everyone on the first day. He is interesting in lecture, and I kind of enjoyed going to them. His only fault is a lack of emphasis on the small details. He tends to focus on the big idea too much.
Baller.  Made info hell bearable.
Info Hell is one of the most hated classes in the SOJC. However Mark made this class bearable.He is one of the best Prof I have had thus far.

Mark is hands-down one of the best professors I've ever had; I couldn't have asked for a better instructor.  He made Information Gathering - one of the most infamously difficult classes on campus - a bearable and almost fun experience; I actually looked forward to his lectures.  I HIGHLY recommend him.
Mark Blaine is extremely passionate about Journalism and he makes all his classes fun by expressing his great sense of humor! I would definitely reccomend him as a teacher.

This man is sooooo hard to work with.  He never responds to emails, and when he does, is VERY unhelpful.  He hardly answers questions like "which chapters will the test cover?" and I've been trying for weeks to get him to look up the Scantron reading for my first quiz since there was a discrepancy and he still hasn't done it!
I had Blaine for both Info Hell and Grammar and really liked him. I'll definitely look to take another class from him.  He is sorta hot in a strange, unexplainable way haha!
Info Hell sucks, as every Journalism student knows!  But Blaine is fun and entertaining and makes it as enjoyable as I think anyone could.  Definitely would take another class from Blaine.

he knows what he is talking about and is very helpful.  the only down side is that the LSDT is writen by Duncan McDonald.  but other than that he is good and somewhat entertaining for an 8:30 am class.

I'll Admit it: I used to schedule meetings just so I could look at him.
No Comments
When I took these classes from him, it was his first time teaching them, and so his delivery was a little rusty.  But he's a good and helpful professor!

Mark made this class bearable.  He was very direct and clear on what we had to do.  He did his best to ensure that we all succeeded in what is otherwise a very difficult course--even if that meant doing a little ass-kicking every once in awhile.  I wouldn't take Infohell from anyone else.

Info Hell is a horrible class.  He is a funny and approachable guy, but this class is poorly taught.  He totally fails to use Blackboard effectively and ends up confusing everyone.  Take Info Hell from a more experienced teacher.
he's gorgeous.

Honestly I was worried about the ANTH 361 course load at first, but once I actually did all the assignments I thought I would fail I realized it was not bad at all. Granted, this class is tough and the lectures can be long and not very engaging, but professor Blumenthal gives you everything you need to succeed as long as you stay on top of stuff.

I'm in two of Scott's classes, ANTH 361 and ANTH 467, and I've never had a more frustrating professor. I'm a strong student, attend every lecture and office hour, and actively participate, and he forgot who I was. He teaches just to hear himself talk, belittle students, fund his research, and give dull, uninspiring lectures. Avoid avoid AVOID.

GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS. I went weekly, and each time he gave thorough answers to all my questions and tips for success. Obviously there is a lot to learn because it's a science class, but all the information in the lectures is what's on the exams, so take detailed notes. Fascinating concept and I retained a lot of information.

Prof Blumenthal really wasn't that bad, but I took an online course with him so it really helped to put him on 2x speed. He didn't tell us what was going to be on any of the midterms or lab exams so you have to study everything, but other than that it was an ok class.

I took anth 361 with him. The content is very interesting but his lectures are dense and he is soboring. The labs are challenging but I had a great GE so I enjoyed them. The tests are difficult and the group project was a bit miserable. This class had 4 FINALS- a lab practical, a final exam, a presentation, and a paper. Interesting content tho

I literally got a better grade in my elementary statistics class than this bs... Its so hard for no reason and so many unnecessary things for us to do for an intro anth class, so much memorization (bones). it was really hard for people to grasp a lot of weird concepts and language. There is hardly outside of class help which is worse. DONT TAKE
