reviews.comment: If youre looking for an easy science class this is not it. Mind you, this was harder than my STATS class and that class is already pretty hard. A lot of reading and long lectures and A LOT to memorize. would never take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: As a 170 class, it couldn't be much harder, this class is split into in-person labs and practical exams based on the labs and then a set of online lectures that are three-hours long each week. I just came off of taking a 330 level anth class and this was five-times harder. Do not take this class to satisfy a gen-ed, it's a grind.

The lectures are very long (3 hours per week) and the slides are extremely boring. The information itself is so simple but presented poorly. His voice is unbearable. It is monotone and robotic sounding. They don't post the slides, and the required labs are overly complex and boring.

Avoid this class unless you enjoy the subject. The workload is more than 300/400 classes I have taken. There is little help for labs and weekly quizzes, and nothing for the larger tests, other than reviewing lectures. Without lectures you stand little chance of passing, and even with them it is difficult. Don't take if you are looking for credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Class info is not comprehensive. His tests are incompatible with class material. His lecture style is droning and pedantic. There is no clear outline of class material to help prep for quizzes and exams. This felt like a weed-out class. Simple information that could be easily delivered is scrambled into a giant mess of uncertainty.
I enjoyed this class overall. He's long-winded, but the lectures were generally interesting.

I took this class to satisfy a GenEd. This was a mistake. I would not recommend this class if you are simply looking to fulfill your general requirements. Attendance is mandatory in lab & Iclicker questions in every lecture. Blumenthal is so incredibly boring and does not seem to have an interest in students actually retaining his lectures.

reviews.comment: Took spring term online. Two 2 hour long "lectures" per week, basically just narrated slideshows. Monotonous and uninteresting. Tests are highly specific and expects you to know a wide range of material as well as background biology info etc. Didn't put out a study guide or study material. Do not take his class you will regret it.

reviews.comment: Took his class over spring term online. His recorded lectures went up to 2 hrs and 15 min per class sometimes, while the class is only supposed to be 1hr 20 minutes. Tests and quizzes are extremely specific, hard to get a good grade. wouldn't recommend.

If you're someone who is looking for a science satisfying credit for your general requirements, and not intending to major in STEM, I do not recommend this class. The lectures are monotonous. The professor is uncaring. The only silver lining was my GE, she was a godsend. I ended up pass failing this class because I was so scared for my GPA.

For a 100 level class, this course is difficult. You are expected to know A LOT of very complicated material in both the lab tests and the lecture tests. This professor is also somewhat boring and the lectures are uninteresting if you're not interested in the material. Many other GE classes are available, but would not recommend this one.

(actually took PPPM 470 but it wasn't on here)
Doug is so amazing! He is super flexible and understanding, I never felt worried about my grade in his class. He has many different assignment types that are engaging and fun to do, I always enjoyed them! I understood class content regardless if I was caught up w/ readings or not. One of my fave profs!

Doug has a unique approach to teaching that heavily focuses on engagement with him and other students. He uses class time to partially lecture, but mostly encourages discussion and development of our own ideas about the course content. Most class material learning is done through reading on your own from his textbook. Helpful with late assignments.

After taking PPPM 410 Art in Society, I have broadened my horizons. Not being particularly fluid in the arts, Prof Blandy is exceptional in helping and facilitating growth in the arts through engaging lectures and papers. Term consists of attendance, 8 forums, one 1500 word paper, and 5 750-1000 word papers. Grades all or nothing. Easy A.

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable professor on the subject he's teaching. Funny jokes and stories for examples of topics being discussed. Not a fan of the final group project, but come to expect it in college. Not strict on attendance, but be prepared to catch-up if you skip. Not a fan of the Inquizative software, but graded on participation so it seems to be OK.

reviews.comment: I'm not sure that it's the best criteria for rating a professor, but Blazak would undoubtedly be a FANTASTIC dinner guest. Every lecture, he has new stories and so much energy that makes borderline boring content thrilling. Most of the class is based on a group research project that allows us to apply what we are learning to real life.

Dr. Blazak is without a doubt one of the best teachers I've ever had. He's incredibly knowledgable on every topic he teaches us and gets his points across in an easy to digest and personable way. One of those rare professors that makes a real difference in your life. I wish I could have him for every sociology class I take.

Blazak is hilarious! He'll go on tangents that at first seem random but then somehow connect to what he was originally talking about. He's a chill guy who sets clear expectations at the beginning of class so you're not confused or surprised half way through the term. He also has really interesting stories about his field research.

Dr. Blazak is one of those rare professors who has both an insane amount of knowledge and a genuine sense of humility. He clearly derives joy from teaching, he keeps his classroom in raptures, and he reminds me every day why I am studying sociology. I cannot recommend taking a class with him enough.

Professor Blazak is incredible. His lecture style is engaging, honest, and full of funny stories, anecdotes, and asides, so paying attention is essential because missing out on his commentary would be tragic. Not only does he have a sense of humor, he knows his stuff and is passionate about it. I wish I had him sooner!

I have loved taking SOC311 with Randy, his lectures are super engaging and he's quite the comedian. There are few assignments but the assignments we do have aren't too grueling, they're all leading up to a final project that I'm actually excited for. My favorite class this year.

Undisputed the worst teacher I have had at UO. He constantly makes inappropriate jokes and is the most unknowledgeable professor I have ever seen. Listening to this guy is like having needles poke me in the ear. I have never had so little respect for another person in my life.

Blazak is one of my favorite professors at UO. He brings so much energy to every lecture and really makes every day interesting, even if the content itself isn't thrilling. I would reccomend any course he teaches!

Cant tell if Randy is high on meth 24/7 or drinks WAY too much caffeine, but this professor is the best! So energetic and excited to teach everyday, which makes learning more enjoyable. Hes very knowledgeable and his life experiences give him a lot of credential. Hes also super funny!

Professor Blazak is definitely one of my favorite professors ive had during my time at UO. One of the things that makes his class unique is the way he conceptualizes the topics; allowing student to easily absorb information. In terms of the course load, IMO it completely do able, and not too labor intensive. 5 out of 5 stars would recommend.

Dr. Blazak is an outstanding professor. He makes a consistent (and successful!) effort to keep lectures interesting and dynamic, even though SOC 311 material can be dry at times. If you have the chance to take a class with him, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Blaazak is an amazing professor. Lectures are engaging and interesting. He is clear about his expectation of assignments and also provides reminders about due dates. A group research project was a requirement for this class and he built time into class once a week to check in with our groups and ask questions. Overall great class!

Best teacher I have had at uo as he is very engaging and funny but explains the material well and in a easy way to understand. I never wanted to miss a class because he made learning sociology fun as I wanted to pay attention. Light homework, one midterm and a final group project we have worked on all term. Highly suggest this professor!!

Professor Blazak is an amazing professor and has the perfect balance between teaching and comedy. The way he explains more complex material is easy to understand, his slideshows and lectures are great, and he's very understanding. He has a great sense of humor that helps engage the class and the homework is overall pretty easy.

Dr. Blazak's years of experience and expertise are visible in the classroom. His lectures are engaging and compelling, and he employs humor to ease the class into serious and informative conversations. He helps us internalize the information by connecting current events to the material. Highly recommend this prof!

You can tell Blazak knows his stuff. There is no way around this. Combining historical knowledge with accurate contextual representations of real-life events is a common method he uses to deliver material. He also is relaxed, at ease in front of a room & certainly is not boring. Sometimes his tangents are long but they ARE informational if you care
Randy is the best professor Ive had a UO. Even though his classes are over an hour, they are very engaging and I learned a lot!! Hes very charismatic and Id take this class again in a heartbeat

P. Blazak is the best professor I have ever had. The class is not about him or his accomplishments. It can get very real. This is a must take for all SOC or ES majors. Assignments were relatively easy and textbook reading really was not required. You got 100% on all the chapter quizzes as long as you attempted them.

Dr. Blazak is an absolute must-take for anyone interested in sociology. His lectures are entertaining for their entirety while still being highly informative. He does a great job of making what could be very mundane, difficult material much more digestible.

Dr. B is a great professor who really invests his life into this course, and he realizes that the class isn't about him. He lets the students speak up and provides a safe space for that to occur. He doesn't put slides up onto canvas, but if you're in the room/listening/taking notes, you'll be just fine! There's extra credit for both the exams!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very well-versed in his subjects. Good at dumbing down ideas for people new to topics but still going in-depth enough to be interesting. Light work, just take notes and get A.

reviews.comment: Mr. Blazak is an amazing teacher. His class and lectures are always interesting, making you laugh. He has guest speakers, or sometimes will do whole class actives. If you don't go to class, it will be hard to get a good grade but his classes are fun! I would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. Blazak is an amazing teacher!! He keeps lectures very engaging and interesting while still staying relevant to the course. As long as you go to class and take notes, you will do good. Attendance is not mandatory but the majority of the midterm and final questions are based on information from the lectures.

Dr. B is passionate, knowledgeable, and an engaging lecturer. His real-world experience and activist work set him apart from other professors. Be prepared to laugh while also thinking critically about race (and challenging long held assumptions). Homework is light and the materials engaging. Show up, take notes, do the work and you'll do well.

I am taking SOC345 with Professor Blazak. Overall, I have REALLY enjoyed his class! He is informative, can answer your questions if you have them and the lectures are actually very funny and entertaining which makes it fun to learn. He is VERY knowledge about race and ethnicity and clearly cares about the subject. Would recommend him for sure!

Professor Blazak is great! He is extremely knowledgeable and is not afraid to get real, even when the topic is uncomfortable. He integrates a lot of stories into his lectures, which makes the topics more memorable. I would absolutely take another class from him.

Blazak's class has been my favorite I've ever taken. 3 short writing assignments, midterm, final, and a short paper that seemed intimidating but were all open-note and super easy as long as you go to class and pay attention, which is not hard, he's the best. Never read the textbook and only skimmed the assigned novel/book. Content and lectures!! A+
He is super understanding and really funny. He also is a pretty fair guy and easy grader. Very happy to have him as one of my professors.

He is a really cool professor, his class got very real. Forcing us to acknowledge concept we try to ignore or rarely think about! I loved this class it didnt feel like a chore it felt empowering learning about these concepts. I would take this class again!

Professor Blazak is my new top favorite professor at UO! Hes super passionate about what he teaches and very knowledgeable about the subject. Engaging lectures, you can tell he cares about his students. Down to earth and super funny. Take Race & Ethnicity SOC345 with him or any other class he teaches!!!
This class was amazing.  We were able to learn first hand experience from him, and his overall knowledge

I absolutely loved this class. The topic was "Prisons and Prison Cultures." Blazak made the subject interesting, had fun stories to share, and made the topic relevant for all students. It was lecture-based, with some time for discussion and questions. The test was short essay format, completed online, on your own time.

Randy obviously cared for what he did. He would share personal experiences which helped  us to understand on a deeper level. He was very peppy and ready to start another fun day of class. I would highly recommend taking one of his classes!

It's  clear Randy is very knowledgable on the topics he teaches,  but he is not good about concealing his personal opinions from his teaching especially when it's not needed. He knocks religion and makes inappropriate comments. It's a pet peeve of mine when teachers talk repeatedly about their political opinions. Students don't pay to hear that.
Tests were very similar to study guides which helped a lot. Office hours also very helpful. It was a bit hard to follow and homework was kinda repetitive, but it was easy to do well in the class.
His lectures are a bit hard to follow but he's super helpful during office hours and always stops to see if people have questions. He's a pretty easy grader. Average amount of homework.

history's not really my area, but prof. black was one of the best teachers i have had at oregon

Black has been one of my favorites. Tough grader but exceedingly helpful. He has a dry sense of humor which made class more entertaining. Lectures with no powerpoint, can be tough to keep up but overall interesting class and well worth the effort.

Professor Black is great. If you're interested in the topic (I took classes about law from him), you will love it. His lectures can be a bit dry and hard to understand but he's a genuinely nice guy and really cares about you understanding the material. And he throws in ridiculous jokes and tangents. Highly recommended!!

Professor Black is not an easy professor, but that is not such a bad thing. He is interested in the subject-matter and in teaching. He doesn't treat us like we are incapable of understanding theoretical concepts, which is good.

Black is very unhelpful and is an ambiguous grader. He is resistant to helping you improve your papers (responded to my asking for advise by saying that I should ask him later in the term if I keep writing poorly) or your writing style and grades you subjectively. Give explicit answers to his essay prompts! "The main theme of this essay is..."

This has to be the worst class I have ever taken in my life. He throws out terms without giving so much as a definition. In a 200 level class, you should assume most of your students are coming in with little to no knowledge on the subject. Don't expect to take notes in class. Homework takes genuinely eons, with 30-40 readings per homework. 0/10.

Very nice guy but just not realistic with his expectations.  If you don't go to class, you'll fail.  40% of grade is the in-class work and the homework. reviews.comment: Don't get me wrong, Dave is SUPER sweet. HOWEVER, the exams are absolutely diabolical. 70% of your grade comes down to the midterm and final. Be prepared to get no study guides, 4 pages of random diagrams, and 5 pages of 5-6 option multiple-choice questions. DO NOT TAKE.

ERTH 308: You can tell he cares about the content but seriously hardest exams I've taken in my entire college career. No actual study guides, random additions to diagrams on exams, insane grade % breakdown. Honestly just pray to pass this class because even if you show up and do extra credit homework the exams are so hard you may not pass.

TELL ALL YOUR OPPS TO TAKE PACIFIC NORTH WEST GEOLOGY 308. Don't get me wrong he is a really really sweet guy but this class is IMPOSABLE. This class is 10000% rage bate. I had 100% perfect attendance went to office hours and STILL FAILED THE CLASS. you have to be smarter then google to pass this class.

EARTH 103 He is such a sweet guy that really loves what he does, it's clear he's very passionate about rocks and the earth. That being said, the multiple choice on the tests were always so hard. The diagrams are easy to learn overtime but I studied for days and still couldn't get over 90% on the multiple choice. Lots of opportunity for extra credit

The midterms are graded so unequally. For example, the first midterm was 25% of our grade, second was 20%, and the third was 10%. So unfair and doesn't make sense. Way too much material on the midterms and if you don't do well on the first one it's nearly impossible to get your grade up. Do not recommend.

This was for ERTH 103, I expected the class to be much easier than what it has been. The midterms are incredibly hard for someone with no interest in geology. It is an insane amount of material that is covered and he posts no study guides. It gets extremely confusing trying to figure out what happened at a certain epoch/era since there are so many.
earth 103, LOTS of class content that isnt paced or organized very well but super nice teacher and class assignments do really help. i recommend doing optional hw

DO NOT take this class if you just need science credit. This class is unreasonably difficult considering it is 100 level. I wish I had dropped the class earlier.

I took ERTH 103 as my last science credit and having this professor was literally one of the worst things that I could've ended up with. EARTH 103

Dont take this class, hes not understanding, i have to spend extensive amounts of time to finish work from this class, you have to finish in class assignments where you have to stay till the end of class where he makes changes to the assignment to make sure you stayed till the end, on top of that you have to do a pre lab and homework. Waste of time

Weekly homework and readings, in-class assignments every class. All paper/print, which is inconvenient, but in-class assignments are most of your notes and you get them back within a week. Blackwell was extremely passionate and his class was joy. The readings were extensive and the content confusing for me many times but I felt I could get through it thanks to how well organized the texts in Canvas are. Would love to take him again. reviews.comment: Shares his own experiences in the national parks, very engaging and shows he's passionate about the subject. The course is interesting, highly recommended for science credits.

Professor Blackwell is incredibly kind and clearly passionate about geology, He offers fun and low-effort weekly movie nights for extra credit. However, the workload for this class is immense. He assigns 5-6 hours of work beyond lectures, and the material is incredibly difficult for anyone who has little to no prior understanding of geology.

reviews.comment: Super caring professor, and very knowledgeable about the class topics. There were also extra credit films that were really interesting, and he brought in a lot of samples that were very cool to look at. Loved this class!

Dave is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about this class. A lot of assignments had to be printed or written on paper. Large amounts of reading for weekly homework assignments, but skimming for answers was usually sufficient.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Blackwell is such a nice guy. He is really personable, he even learns his student's names! His lectures are fun, interesting, and engaging. There are a lot of little assignments that make boosting your grade very easy. I learned so much about geology and would definitely recommend this class.

Lots of assignments but they are all fairly easy and help boost your grade. Great mix between lecture material and current events so you can apply what you learn. Dave is also extremely nice! Attendance isn't a must because he posts slides which are very clear but his class is very enjoyable.

Dave is a really nice guy. I've never taken geology before and found his lectures to be informative and easy to follow. His tests and homeworks were also really easy since he usually gives the answer in his readings word for word. So you have to do this readings and pay attn in lecture and if you do, he gives practically gives you the answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Blackwell is a very pleasant teacher who knows his stuff and is willing to joke with his students. He gives a heavy workload, but if you attend class and do the homework you will get a strong passing grade. Do not take this class if you expect rocks for jocks.

I dont understand how the majority of this class was teaching yourself material. As if we are geology majors. Lectures were boring and then youd be given a lab and hours of hw just to research on your own and be stressed out. Majority of the stuff used is from his (fossils, drawings and pictures), do you cannot try to look stuff up for help.

Dont take this class, its a mess. I cant express how badly it affected my mental health. Its so hard to keep up, and Ive been an honor student my whole life. I worked so hard in this class and managed to get an A. Horrible class though, way too much work expected if you, and too much material in one term.

Such a stressful class. You have to pour all of your time into it. It is also so much material and incredibly overwhelming. No consideration for how difficult the class is, and the piles of work you have to do each week.

reviews.comment: Awful.

Everyone I know regrets taking this class. It was unnecessarily hard, too much work expected of you each week. Labs that take 8-15 hours to complete. The material is challenging, and the pace of the class is very fast. I worked so hard to manage a B, by far the hardest class I've taken. Very heavy workload and incredibly stressful class.

This is the hardest class I've ever taken. The tests are insane. He expects you to remember tiny details about the most intricate of geological processes. He says his tests are fair. I'm a hardworking student. I have a 4.0. I had to work harder than I have in any other class before to scrape by with a B. Don't take this class. Please.
