reviews.comment: boring, dry lectures. made occasional microaggression racial comments. you get 6 absences. never once responded to my emails, only communicates through your ge. has a weird relationship with colin rowe, frank lloyd wright, and le corbusier.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not helpful at reviews and doesn't seem to understand that students have lives outside of class. Bad vibes and slightly offensive.

He seems and is respected during his lectures. However, one-on-one reviews are a different story. In the past, he has given bad reviews to students just because he, personally, doesn't understand their work. When the student tries to explain it so he could understand better, he shuts them up.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Just go to Rome with Jimmy,..it will change how you see the world of architecture.  You rock Jim Tice!
Put Latin on the final and had a match the quote to the author for readings that were from weeks before. Accused people of cheating with no basis and overall not a good professor.

Most of the time his lectures were boring with a focus on FLW and Le Corbusier. There are several required readings a week that were long and confusing particularly by Colin Rowe. The exam was equally about the lectures as it was the readings if not more on the lectures with dumb questions as quotes and who said them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Class and teaching staff is incredibly pretentious. Lectures are incredibly dull and boring while the grading done is unbelievably harsh.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you want a good grade in this class do ALL your reading responses, ALL projects, and before final test, STUDY. Got good grades on projects & reading responses which put me at 95 in the class and when the test came around, I got dropped to a 75. The test was max 15 questions and it was detailed on readings that NOBODY read. POINTLESS CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Cool dude once you get to know him. Gives boring lectures but great feedback on studio work. The key to passing his classes and studios is to adopt his approach and don't explore personal ideas. Imitate FLW and Le Corb and you will be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took Tice for my terminal studio. I had him previously in spatial composition. He is the least helpful professor I have ever had which is very problematic for studio. He gave the worst advice and to add insult to injury he gave everyone in our class the same advice. To make things worse he invited terrible reviewers. Worst term ever!

This dude does not know how to lecture and puts everyone to sleep. I slept in almost every class because his obsession with Italy was just too much to handle.  Beware of his annoying tendencies of going on tangents about how great Italy is and how much America sucks.
The least helpful prof i have ever had. His comments have no helpful side to them. I often imagine that in his spare time he chokes puppies for fun. Good luck
He's friendly and quietly witty. I really enjoyed JT. He comes off as scary, but give him a chance because he knows his stuff.
somewhat pompous; sadly insecure; as friendly as the sidewalk; very, very, very set in his ways and paradigm
He seems nice, but I swear I won't be surprised if he goes postal one day. The man is wound up too tight.
No Comments

Jim is smart and nice enough.  But he suffers from a Boomer teaching style - he seems unable to solidly profess anything.  His best "opinions" are couched in qualifiers.  "I dont know, but I think..." He does know, and he is right. If you can get past this, you will learn alot.

The class is graded very objectively, so if you know the material and study it, you will do well. I enjoy her lectures, and the tests aren't too hard if you do the practice exams; it couldn't be any harder, otherwise it would be ACTG 350, they would say. She is also a fun person to talk to at office hours, so show up!

Jenn is such a kind and inspiring professor who has genuinely sparked my interest in accounting. She is so kind and funny, and does her best to help you learn the content by making her lectures accessible and engaging. Homework can be time-consuming but not hard, and exams are challenging, but she provides so many resources to help you do well.

She's lowkey really nice and cares a lot about students, her exams are a bit hard though. Make sure to do really well on these exams, as most of the grade is based on them. She's really understanding thought during post-exam meetings as well.

She cares a lot about the students and encourages us to do well in exams. Although her exams aren't easy, the resources she gives for preparation are more than enough for you to succeed in the class as long as you put enough time and effort into studying. She even has exam reviews where you go over what you had gotten wrong in your exam.

Jen is one of the nicest and most caring professors on campus. She's always ready to give a helping hand. The grade is made up of 3 exams, no cumulative final, but the tests are really hard. It's half multiple choice, a portion for short answer, and one long answer. She puts tricky and very difficult questions on there as a heads up.

Loved Jen, wish I could take another class with her. There are 3 midterms, and the homework is very time-consuming but very helpful for understanding the concepts. She provides so many resources for exam preparation. Your final grade is representative of the effort you put in. I definitely could have done better if I had studied more.
Jen is the GOAT and is the reason I wanted to become an accounting major. She was so helpful and was an amazing teacher. She explains topics very well and is willing to help out in any way.

This is one of the best professors I have ever had! She is very patient, understanding, very clear on what she is teaching. Provides many real world examples, it is homework heavy but it is all for repetition for the exams. I would take her again, but she is retiring next year, she deserves her rest.
Awesome professor. Teaches like she is teaching her own kids.

Seriously not sure why people say she's the best accounting teacher here. She's super nice and caring but half of the test is trivia about random examples. She also words test questions very poorly and puts things on tests we've never gone over. I think she's a great advisor and there are FAR worse teachers here. But there are also far far better.

Jenn is a great professor. I learned a lot from her this term. Her lectures are easy to follow and she has useful practice problems in the class. There are 3 midterms and 6 quizzes (with 2 drops) that are all manageable if you study and pay attention in class. She is very helpful in office hours and worth getting to know.

Awesome! I really like Jennifer, she's very personable and you can tell she teaches because she enjoys it! Class itself is really hard, I struggled, 1 midterm, 2 quizzes and a final. Homework can take HOURS so prepare for that. Really focus and get a grasp on the material its hard to catch up if you fall behind.

Jenn is the GOAT. Tough class, need to grind, study, and review material. But Jenn really cares and tries to make it easier to understand. She is so friendly, personable, and helpful during office hours.

Welander is kind and easy to work with. Class has a lot of content but she does her best to fit it in with a good flow. Homework often takes a while but really helps with class. She feels warm and is positive to be around even if the class is not your strength. Would recommend her for any class she teaches as she is amazing.

Jenn is an amazing professor who genuinely cares about the success of her students. Her lectures are very engaging and well-organized but the content of the class itself is very difficult. She does a great job of articulating and explaining basic accounting principles, but the curriculum is still very rigorous. Exams require a lot of studying.

Jennifer is a brilliant professor! She has great knowledge in accounting and her lectures are easy to understand and help us comprehend the material better. She is genuinely interested in our academic careers and she is an easy person to access outside of class. I was glad to have her this semester for a course that is considered to be difficult.

Jenn is one of the best professors I've had. She was extremely helpful with material and is willing to go over material with you if you had a hard time understanding it. It is heavily based off exams and quizzes but Jenn made everything click. She is also one of the nicest people you'll meet. I would suggest taking Accounting with Jenn.

Jen is a really good professor, the class is just really difficult. The homework was McGraw hill and I found it to be really time consuming. She goes through slides really quickly, but she posts them afterwords. Her study materials are super helpful, but tests are really hard. I think the class average was around 65 on the midterm.

Jenn is probably one of the nicest Professors I've had, but people who aren't the best at memorization and math will severely struggle in this class. I found the TA's to be ineffective as well as the other resources. Youtube explanation videos will be your friend as lectures are fast and presume you know exactly what you're doing so be aware.

Very good professor, she made learning accounting very enjoyable and the class is easy to take notes to and understand the topics easily through the way she teaches. Accounting can be a difficult subject but she definitely helped make it easier to understand and learn. Highly recommend.

Jenn is one of the best professors I have ever had. She is not only incredibly kind, she is a wonderful educator. I am taking her again next term and am thrilled. I would recommend her to pretty much anyone.

Jen is so nice and her lectures are easy to follow. You don't technically have to go to class, it's not graded, but I did find it very helpful in understanding the material. You do have to go to discussions tho. If you do the homeworks and readings and pay attention, you will be fine.

Jenn was such a fantastic teacher. Accounting doesn't come easy to many people, but Jenn helps explain topics well. Also, I think labs and encore are the best resources for success in this course. Jenn goes through slides quickly, but that was my only con for her. Take this class with Jenn!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jenn is very nice, I just struggled with this class a lot and just couldn't seem to make things click, even with all the resources given

She is one of the best teachers I ever had. The class content is difficult, but Welander makes sure we have lots of study materials and practice problems. The lectures are very clear and easy to follow. She makes me enjoy actg and want to do my best in her class. She also is a very nice grader and will give lots of partial credit.

Jen is the best accounting professor out there. She's super kind and gives lots of study material for midterms and the final. Always willing to help and is an amazing support system in and outside the classroom

She is the best! She wants to see you succeed and provides great tools to do so. If you ask her questions she helps out, she is willing to create new tools to help the class succeed and overall is a fantastic teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Welander was a good teacher, but often times I still found lectures confusing. She is super helpful and receptive with questions. However, your grade for this class is very test heavy, midterms and finals make up 75% of your grade. I struggled but she was very helpful when I had questions.
She's the best professor I've had at this school. Phenomenal

She clearly explains tough concepts and is very straightforward, really cares about her students. The workload is heavy - smartbook chapter reviews due before every class, homework due every Saturday, and two midterms + a final. If you're interested in the ACTG major, she is a good person to know - a great mentor and guide.

Jen is an amazing professor! I really struggled in this class but she helped me so much and never gave up on me. She really knows her stuff and gives you so many good resources to help you study and succeed in her class. I would 100% recommend her and would take the class again despite the difficult course work.

She was super chill and a great professor. class is super hard though, she is definitely the best prof for 211! curves final grades, it brought me up a full letter. attendance is optional but you have to go if you want an okay grade i skipped a few and fell behind so fast. hw due every saturday is very time consuming but not that bad

Jen is truly one of the best. She makes big lectures feel incredibly personal. There is no doubt she cares about the success of every single student. This class takes work, but there was never a time I felt unsupported. Love her!

Jenn is a great teacher who actually teaches the material in an understanding way. I never dread going to her class and am always interested when I am there. The homework can be tricky, but there's not a ton of it. She also provides A LOT of study materials which is extremely helpful. 10/10 professor, maybe even the best I've had at UO
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Such a great professor always willing to help and understands that this can be a more difficult class. While no extra credit is provided she is always willing to help and provides everyone with so many great resources. Best professor I have had at UO so far.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you don't have the mind for accounting, you're going to suffer regardless of the instructor. Jennifer just makes the suffering a little more bearable. Lectures are long, but informative. She provides amazing study resources, and amazing feedback. Overall, a great instructor teaching an awfully hard subject.

Accounting is not a fun subject for most people. However, Jen is sort of a rarity within the business school as she is very inclusive and energetic and simply wants all of her students to succeed. Although classes were very boring at times and that is to be expected with accounting, but Jen was great at making accounting 211 as engaging as possible

Jenn is definitely one of the best professors I've ever had at this University. That's coming from a senior who's a term away from finishing undergrad. She seriously cares about her students and is super friendly and helpful. Ask around about Jenn and you'll hear the same thing, everyone loves Jenn.

Jenn is the best teacher I've had the pleasure of learning from and deserves every single good review written about her. She's always down to meet outside of classroom hours and will do literally everything in her power to help you succeed, you just have to be open to it. If you have to take ACTG211, take it with her, you won't regret it!

Best teacher ever. So, so, so nice and helpful. Having a smaller class rather than a lecture is amazing when you're learning accounting. There aren't many assignments and Jen gives so many resources when it's exam time (3 exams through the term). Accounting is a difficult subject, but if you have to take it, TAKE JEN!

ACTG211 is a difficult class and you have to work really hard to get a good grade in this class, but Jen wants nothing but success for her students. Always available outside of class to help you, brings snacks to class, and explains everything very well. Such a positive person. SOO many study resources, and the best canvas page I've ever used.
Best Professor I've ever had

WOW! Jen is absolutely amazing. Accounting is a difficult subject but she genuinely wants everyone to succeed. She is very friendly and personable. Her lectures are super engaging and she even provides a bunch of resources on Canvas that you can study to prepare for the exam
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ms. Welander is absolutely fantastic! She makes the material applicable and gives a lot of opportunities to practice it. She's incredibly friendly and truly wants all of her students to succeed. She made this class make sense to me and everyone who has had her loves her!
She was so great. Make accounting bearable.

Very energetic and welcoming individual. She is an amazing professor that cares about every students success. A difficult course, but a pleasure to learn from. She makes herself available all the time, and even changed her teaching style and content provided immediately after student feedback.

Ms. Welander is such an amazing kind soul in this cruel Accounting world. She wants to see everyone succeed and it feels like she genuinely cares about you and your passing. Actg 211 is hard - but she keeps it engaging and lighthearted and has lectures that actually make sense to what were learning about. Overall I really recommend her!

Mrs. Welander is very knowledgeable in the field of accounting, and combined with her experience in the professional sector, makes her an extremely well-rounded instructor. The curriculum in this class can be difficult to understand as accounting may seem counter-intuitive at first, but she presents the materials in a straightforward manner.

Jen was such a great professor who you could tell truly cared about her job and her students. She is also really understanding and wants all her students to exceed. Would definitely recommend her over the other accounting professors.

The course is very test heavy, and you can't pass the class based off homework alone. She is a very easy to approach and gives her students as many opportunities to get better at her course subject. One of the best professors I've had so far but a very challenging course as of now I have a B- but it might drop when I take the final

For it being accounting class Jenn does an amazing job on making sure you are learning the material. She is very understanding of her students and works with you! The material is easy to grasp because of her, she prepares you for exams. Take her, she makes accounting less scary. Go to her office hours!! JENN IS AMAZING

We love Jen! She is the first professor ive taken to actually present the feedback we give and offer a change in the course based on the feedback. Makes herself available to students at any time and makes sure to offer supplemental help if you are needing it.

Professor Welander is my favorite professor that I've ever had. Accounting 211 is a tough course overall, but Professor Welander is a very caring and respected teacher. She will always make time outside of class to help her students. I was even able to reach out to her for help in my next accounting class and she offered as much help as she could

Awesome class! The course content was challenging but doing the homework, attending lectures, and asking questions make it completely manageable and rewarding for those willing to put in the effort. Jenn is a great instructor and I genuinely learned so much.

Jenn really cares about her students and is a really good professor. Class is hard but she will take the time to help you understand the material and has very open office hours. Wants students to do well.

Professor Shiao is great. I had the online version of this class and it was just lecture videos with assignments to do. And maybe about 4 bigger assignments. But as long as you watch the videos and actually pay attention then you should do good. Just follow the directions and you'll be chill. Hes also pretty helpful during office hours.

I'm redoing this review after more thinking about the Professor, and honestly he was a good prof that was held back by students being so afraid to step out of their comfort zone. I'd take him again at higher level courses where people actually somewhat care about discussions. However, there were still rather rambling lectures.

reviews.comment: Honestly, I would go to say the UO should fire him. The fact that I paid this man to be the worst teacher ever. He gives weekly assignments that do not help you learn the material at all. He would never give feedback so you could never do better. He is not someone who is a teacher or cares about you learning the concepts. Worse lectures ever.

I had some doubts about taking this course based on the review but it wasn't bad. Lectures were long, but professor gave three extra credit options throughout the term. There is a group project but it is not bad at all. The grading can be on the tougher side and some of the concepts can be confusing, but the professor was nice and straight forward!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Don't take this class! Most confusing class I have ever taken! It is not clear what is graded or tested on.

This is the most disorganized, dysfunctional professor (and class) I've ever had. All of the content is very surface level, so you would guess that it is a fairly straightforward class, but the second he opens his mouth he confuses everyone. The guidelines are unclear&rubrics are inaccurate. I have gone to his office hours and I'm still lost.

He's not a bad guy at all, just talks a  l o t  in lectures. He didn't have a very good organization of the class either, which is unfortunate because it all starts to feel messy and confusing very quick. Otherwise a very smart guy, but didn't enjoy the class and felt the organization and layout could have been much better.

Most lecture heavy online class I've ever taken! Nice prof, but he stumbles on his words and isn't a good teacher- I don't feel like I learned much from this class at all. Assignments are confusing and seldom explained. There is an impossible group project!!!!! He could be a good prof in person, but not online. Grade book does balance out though!
group projects are worth almost ~85% of the grade. professor hardly ever responds, takes weeks to respond if anything, waited until week 7 to grade any of our assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please take this class with another professor. The lectures are insanely long and there are so many of them that its confusing. Really tough grading and doesn't provide even a word of feedback for how you can improve, making every assignment pointless as you'll still fail.

Insanely Lecture heavy for a ASYNC course, with a group project that's impossible to coordinate cause we dont see each other ever. Assignment directions and questions are way to difficult for what your supposed to be learning. No leniency on late work, and no extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really messy and confusing class, The weekly reading was not horrible, but his lectures are so long and make you lose interest. The group project and other assignments are difficult and impossible to prepare for. Dont take this course unless it's clearly organized.

Overall easy but engaging teacher. 1-3 chapters per week, 1 reading response (100-200 words) and the occasional assignment, so not a ton to do. However, it's just not very engaging. This online class includes a group project, which is a dumb idea because no one wants to do it.
This class isn't too bad. It's easy. All the lectures are pre-recorded, but they are really boring and long to listen to. However, you don't necessarily need to watch them to do well in the class.
Assignment expectations were unclear. The lectures were long and not engaging at all. He had lots of readings assigned.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is a confusing mess. Group work is assigned but no assignment is ever clearly presented. No clear answers were given, no clear directions and lectures that go on and on and on and dont have anything to do with the assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Shiao's teaching style. His online course was well organized with lectures to watch every week, clear grading criteria for all assignments, and gives practice assignments worth participation points to get you ready for the graded ones. He does not overload work, but focuses on the important concepts in fewer assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: He's nice and seems like he cares deeply about his work and subject, however, this class is incredibly boring, difficult, and disorganized. For an online class, the due dates are incredibly inconvenient, often in the middle of the week. This is a subject I like, but he turns simple concepts complex, often confusing me on concepts I already know.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Nice guy, plenty knowledgeable but his class is so tedious there are tons of little things he adds into assignments that are tedious and pointless, it's hard to explain but all his assignments ar convoluted and overly complicated they'd be fine otherwise but they all have a bunch of little parts to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: What seems like an interesting class is actually the most boring and irrelevant class I have ever taken. This class never once talks about current racial issues and the discussions feel like high school. He relies completely on the readings and there is nothing new that we learn during lecture. Attendance is mandatory and the grading is strict.

Shiao is incredibly nice and very approachable but an absolutely terrible professor, one of the worst I've had. He's too research - minded and too smart for his own good, which means he doesn't know how to clearly explain anything. His tests are ridiculously hard, and his explanations of topics are vague at best. Take this class w/ someone else.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Professor Shiao is a nice enough guy but his lecture slides are extremely wordy. He goes into too much detail which often left many people in the class overly confused by the excessive amount of words he uses in his slides. He randomly will call on people and if you don't know the answer to his question he will make you publically figure it out.

Professor Shiao is a passionate and respectable professor, however, I found his class to be quite difficult. His lectures are extremely dense in the material making it difficult to take notes. He often strays on tangents that are not part of his lecture that also make it difficult to take notes. This class has a lot of definitions so be prepared.
Very helpful to students and always made himself available to help. He is clearly passionate about helping you maximize your potential. Second best instructor I have had at the U of O.

I heard this class was hard .. i think he might have made it even more so !! Wayyyy to many readings assigned and content to look over in lecture slides (and whats with having the same slide five times?!!) to be able to even get half of what he is trying to teach.. i basically had to teach myself what I thought was going to be important ..

Very kind, always available to help. Material is very difficult, especially if haven't done readings before class. Complexities of developing & testing studies for quality/relevance all crammed into 10 weeks-that SUCKS. I <3 logic puzzles & found that helped a lot; must be willing 2 work hard, think in new ways. Did 12 credit term & survived.
Classes always ended late because he has such poor time management skills, and his expectations for students are a little ridiculous.

The amount of reading was outrageous. It doesn't mean it was all bad or irrelevant, but there was just so MUCH of it; I could only do some of it (like the readings we had to write about). The subject of the class was very intriguing and had the potential for some rousing discussions, but I thought he was too objective and wooden. Nice guy, though

Professor Shiao has outrageous expectations for his students. Guidelines are not clear, lectures are boring and rushed through. Could be an interesting topic, and while clearly knowledgeable about the topic does not do a good job of actually TEACHING it.

Why does this guy always look like hes smiling?  Class sucked but got a B- though and completely ****ed it and missed an entire week's worth of points, so if you do all his assignments and kind of pay attention in class and attend class you'll be fine.
Agree with all prior comments. Very bad teacher.

In my time at UofO this is by far the worst professor i have had. he is an ****. he is the guy that makes you call him prof. Has mandatory attendance, which it hell to get through. lectures are very boring, power points have too much informations on them that don't make sense. Don't take a class from him you will regret it.
terrible lecturure....boring, bad powerpoints, and kinda hard, not reccomended.....

Really interesting and insightful class at first. However, he grades "on a curve" that seems to be wildly unbalanced. I got As on quizzes and Bs on the exams, my grade is counted as a C+. I gave up trying after awhile because if an 88 is worth a C, then what are all of the 90 and above kids getting?

Incredibly knowledgeable. Able to make complex topics easily digestible. Uses just the right amount of humor to keep things down to earth (no pun intended). Three short quizzes a week and three exams, that's it. Later exams only cover material that was learned since the last one, so no surprise topics coming back to haunt you.
Not a fan. Fell asleep in almost every class and almost failed every quiz with cheating.

This course only consisted of quizzes and exams. WAY too HARD for an entry-level course, if you don't recall this type of content from high school or arent majoring in something related this is very difficult. If you're looking to just get the science requirement I wouldn't recommend this course. Communication is a little unprofessional.
patronizing, arrogant, and off-base. doesn't seem to grasp the reality that he is teaching a lower-division course that requires no prior knowledge. most condescending prof i've ever had

This is by far the worst class I've ever taken. The professor is egotistical and doesn't care at all about his students. If you ask for help you get told to just be smarter. His lecture slides make no sense and he doesn't teach the material you're supposed to know. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. It was a huge mistake to sign up for this joke of a class.

reviews.comment: WORST CLASS I'VE EVER TAKEN. Professor is arrogant and does not care about his students. Whatever you do, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!!
NEVER TAKE THIS CLASS
Tests are HARD.
This Professor is extremely egocentric and just loves to see his students struggle and fail because he has to be the most intellectually superior person in the whole universe. AVOID AT ALL COST!

He's brilliant but difficult to follow. His lecture format is not only confusing but incredibly boring. He's not interested in helping his students, in fact I'd say he's quite condescending. Least favorite professor I've ever had, hands down.

This guy is incredibly interesting. At a certain point, I stopped taking notes and just sat back and listened to his lectures, which I think made the class a little easier. The only hw he gave us was pretty easy and the exams are heavily curved. If you are even the slightest bit interested in space and aliens, then this guy is the teacher for you.

He's a really smart guy, clearly knows his stuff about astronomy. But I think the class should be renamed "Astronomical Physics". Seriously. It was the first class I'd ever encountered where I legitimately could not figure out the material. If math is not your thing, stay away.

Schombert was amazing! I took the course to complete a Gen Ed, but I ended up really enjoying the class. For some, it may be difficult to wrap your head around the complex information that is presented, but if you go to his office hours he'll help you with anything and might even give you some advice on college life. The textbook can help you too!
BEWARE. this man made me cry. he doesnt even reference the book whatsoever and he is entirely unapproachable .STAY AWAY
DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS, or better yet if you do decide to take this class don't have him as your professor. He's not helpful in anyway whether or not you attend his class or go to office hours.
He is VERY condescending and wont give you the time of day. He knows his stuff thats for sure but dont expect him to explain it to you at all
Class was interesting, but he was not a good teacher. Kept mixing information up, which confused most the class. Extremely condescending and unapproachable. Don't take this class
He is very condescending, and made me lose interest in astronomy. Not worth it.
The tests are hard but the class is graded on a curve so that doesn't matter so much. The only homework is weekly online quizzes which are usually fairly easy. He's a smart guy and I recommend him.

EXTREMELY hard class.  He grades on a curve though (I failed nearly all quizzes/exams, still got a C in the class- don't ask me how).  Lots and lots and lots of physics involved.  If physics and/or difficult math aren't your strong suit(s), DO NOT even consider taking this class.
Treats as if your dumb, doesn't help you that much and is very rude.

Unless you directly ask him questions about the quizzes in class, the lectures he gives/the notes he provides are mostly useless. Frustrating. Was an okay class. I've taken astronomy before, and was unimpressed.
it's a hard class because of the math but an easy class to pass one 10 point quiz on each lecture (2-3 a week) and 3 exams over the term. Easy class, great professor, he knows his stuff!
Her is nice but tough.
No Comments
No Comments
Exams are hard, but easy to pass. hard to get A.  His one of the worst teacher i have had
Extremely curved grader, told us that the bottom 12% WILL fail, top 3% get an A+. I ended up with only a 28% in the class, and finished with a B+. Expect this.
Good professor, but he ragebaited me so hard during my argumentative essay that I did not even want to finish revising it at that point.
Pretty chill guy overall. Very open to helping out, will provide extensions. He is very focused on improving and helping you succeed. Instructions are very clear. I would take him again!

Very nice, understanding, and accessible professor; will provide extensions if needed. Classes can feel slow and random, but coursework is easy, and there's not much. Only one essay throughout the whole class, and our final project was a zine.

very few assignments were due which was nice but also those are what your grade was based upon. attendance was mandatory but he made it worth your time. lectures and in class help were really good. super clear rubrics and good feedback. super kind and understanding teacher!

Probably one of the easiest classes I've ever taken while being at UO. As long as you do your best with assignments, you'll pass the class. If you communicate with him for an extension, he'll give it to you. Essays are due every week and there are times where instructions aren't the most clear with him however hes super kind and understanding.

Probably the most normal professor you can take. Classes are a bit slow, essays are boring, but the final project (creating a zine) was very enjoyable. Dr. JJ is a kind person, and if you ask for an extension, he'll give it to you. Not much more you can ask for from a class every student is mandated to take.

Mr. Jung is a very nice guy, he cares about his students but the homework and the class itself is awful. Classes are slow, I feel like could be summed up in 20 minutes, the homework is a reading before class which is not bad at all and if you take notes about the reading you will be fine but every friday there is writing due,basically an essay a wk
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: It's clear that Dr. Wolf cares about what he does. His lectures are comprehensive and mostly engaging (sometimes quite fun). HOWEVER, his rubrics are insanely vague, the grading is sometimes unpredictable, the readings are offensively long, and the lectures are at 8:30 AM, twice a week. Take good notes or you will fail. Be prepared to write well.

Wrote 6 essays in 11 weeks but it wasn't too bad, fun lectures, but wasn't very good at making his GEs actually grade our papers. I know they're students too, but we had to push back deadlines because they wouldn't grade on time. Really cool topic, really engaging lectures. Don't forget to clarify how attendance is taken, it was a bit confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was really fun and enjoyable! There are lectures every single day so it's really important to attend every class and take good notes. We had to write around 6 papers (which are graded by the GEs) and had an online read and annotate due before each class. If you participate and pay attention you'll get a good grade!

Professor Wolf is passionate about teaching, and his lectures are usually engaging. However, the readings are extremely long and have little to do with the assignments, and the topics are more about social justice than music. We talked more about cultural origins and racial tensions of Latin music than their actual musical characteristics.

I am an education major and took this class to meet a gen ed requirement and I found the class to be pretty good. There is a lot of reading but you can easily do it now that we use Perusall, super easy to make a quick annotation and reply to someone and move on. The assignments aren't too difficult, just for me personally I found them hard.

I took this my fall term, was such a challenging course if you weren't a music major. There was absurd amounts of information along with a whole bunch of papers with unclear guidelines. I felt like I had to write another paper each week, for a class that had nothing to do with my major.
Loved him! Very easy to get along with, brings a different perspective to the media in terms of musical influence.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Insane amounts of work every week. Grading on THEME assignments is insanely tough, and we are docked points off for going over the word count while also being marked down for not including things that were not said to be required on the rubric. Constantly in tears over this class that was supposed to be an elective.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Bunch of reading to do. Was pretty hard for me because everyone in my class was taking this in our first term as first year students. Even the GEs say that this class should be easier for us first years. A lot of homework. Teaches super fast too, so if you missed it, its gone. His class is pretty interesting though, just hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I have NEVER had a class that required so much reading. 40-60 pages of reading a week, 2 reading quizzes a week. Pretty significant assignments due almost every other week too. As an elective, I had to spend more time on this class than I did for any of my core classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I've taken all my Core requirements and never had a class that depended so much on the reading (and there is a lot!). I'm a good test taker, but his multiple choice tests are tricky. Lecture is good though, and I appreciate the demonstrations and love the visitors. The information is interesting I just wish the homework was structured differently.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Doctor Wolf was great! He has a passion for what he teaches & wants his students to succeed. Keeping up with reading is VERY important. Attendance is MANDATORY mandatory. The class isn't difficult if you pay attention & do the work. He is understanding and flexible if you give him a good reason. GET TO KNOW YOUR GTF THEY ARE LIFE SAVERS!
Dr. Wolf's class was required for my major, but I genuinely enjoyed taking it! It's a tough class, but I learned a lot :)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Very knowledgeable within the finance industry, and he clearly enjoys his work. The nature of the class is difficult because there is a limited number of assignments that are submitted. Although this was a difficult finance class, it is absolutely one of the most valuable classes I have taken at U of O. Would recommend this class to others.

Great teacher honestly, he's a solid respectable teacher who cares, the material was informative and the class wasn't hard for the sake of being hard. Actually, learned in this class. One of the rare UO cases where you get your money's worth and not just another check on the degree guide.

Julio is one of the best professors I have had at the UO, especially within the Finance school. He teaches and explains concepts in a very digestible way, and is obviously passionate about what he teaches. He cares very deeply about his students, and is always happy to help outside of class. Exams are straightforward and expectations are clear.

Jody is great and cares a lot about her students. She is very willing to work with us to make the class better for us. Her lectures were very interesting and she is passionate about what she is teaching. The real world examples and talks we had were great. If you get the chance take MGMT 420!

A lot of other reviews on here are the exact opposite of what Jody's class was like. She brought a lot of perspective to the Global Business course, while also being extremely caring for her students, and very open to changing of course structure. Lectures were simple and information was digestable and very applicable to the real world.

She is very supportive, and obviously has a lot of experience. Honestly it's probably the most interesting business class I've taken here, she has a lot of cool guest speakers and stories about her life. Main project required a lot of effort, but it's a good class.
very misleading during projects and course hasn't been updated and points very racist towards specific students
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Had her for BA 361. She is a nice and very caring professor but the class material gets very repetitive. The lectures are long and boring. She is aware of these comments people read so if I have any advice for her:
-Shorten lectures
-Talk more about business less about Dubai stories
-Less busy work for our teams
-No final test
361 is great. Super fun and interesting with this prof. No clue why anyone wouldn't like it
Unbelievably caring prof and someone who wants to expand our understanding of the world. Super interesting and practical classes and tries to get everyone involved.

Took BA 361 with her. Worst class of my life, she hasn't teached in the US for very long and it shows. Completely unnecessary and time consuming projects that just leave you stressed and frustrated. Absolutely no feel for her students and has a talent for making people feel uncomfortable. I wish I had more words to rant about her but DONT TAKE HER!

Overall, the professor is very nice but not accommodating. The classes are almost 2 hours and she doesnt not waiver from using all of the time. There is countless assignments that are really just busy work, and have to read around 8 different readings/videos per week. Everything is hand written and for tests she does not give you a study guide.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I took this class for BA361 and thought it was great. She had lots of cool speakers and the lectures were applicable and engaging. Overall thought the class was very informing and not too difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Ironically, the weakest aspect of her class is the management. Anything canvas related is handed off to the TA, who may or may not give you a response in time. Tests include material outside class, so get reading

Prof Johnson was honestly great! You can tell she cares for her students outside of class and gives them the recourses they need to succeed. If you go to class and put in the effort (I never studied and did the bare minimum and was totally fine) you will really enjoy her class! There are also plenty of extra credit opportunities.

MGMT311 is a class about buzzwords, and Jody Johnson is exactly the person you would expect to teach that class. Not a single person I talked to enjoyed this class, it is 10 weeks of busywork taught by someone with the tone of a soul sucking HR manager. My class progressively bonded over dislike for her as the term went on.
The worst professor I've ever had in my entire life. Do not teach, do not grade, do not give feedback. Course design is awful!!!

Let me join the club in saying this is the worst professor I've ever had. Everyone else covered this already, but how a management professor could have the most poorly managed class I've ever seen still astounds me. Crazy thing is that she's aware of these insanely negative reviews and chooses to not change anything. Enjoy reading the textbook!

Hilariously awful. Worst experience I have had as a student at UO. Professor Johnson is a management professor, yet I have never taken a class this poorly managed. Her TA does everything. I have no idea what she does for this class besides spewing nonsense for 4 hours a week. The course curriculum is bad, but she finds a way to make it unbearable.

I'd rather listen to a baby cry for an hour and 30 minutes than go to her lectures. She is honestly just lazy - She covers less than the bare minimum in class, and is always doing the most elementary level examples. Her responses are bad and you have to message a TA before you can get through to her. Everything is mandatory and she doesn't care why

I don't know how it is possible she is still employed as a professor. I think the entire mgmt curriculum needs an audit because this whole thing feels like a circus. Absolutely ridiculous that she is a teacher with a room temperature IQ. The only reason I have been able to pass the exams has been because on my own time I read all the McGraw Hill.

Jody is truly a kind and caring professor. I will say that you will need to go to class and participate but you are given all of the tools to succeed. She cares about her students as people first before students and ensures that everyone takes care of themselves first.

The work she has you do is so annoying and wildly inconvenient. I think that this entire course should be removed because it does nothing but distract me from important classes. I know I sound angry writing this but it pisses me off that I am receiving this type of education after paying so much money. She needs someone to give her a reality check.

I can't believe she's a management professor—she's the most disorganized teacher I've ever had. She makes attendance mandatory but covers nothing relevant, and won't give study guides, claiming it's to “prepare us for upper-division courses.” Yeah, right. I'm a senior and still get study guides. Feels more like laziness than actual prep.

The CEO of inconvenience—everything is disorganized, assignments are overly complicated, and the exam system is absolutely ridiculous. She's not a bad person, but this class is tough to get through. I thought it would be low-effort, but it surprisingly demands a lot of time and effort for a social science course.

The only reason I show up to class is because it is mandatory. The whole class is ran by her TA while Jody sits around and tells you nothing that is relevant to the class. She's extremely disorganized and have never had one enjoyable moment in the classroom. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER

The WORST professor. She doesn't care about her students, and you're basically just listening to her bragging about herself. She's extremely passive-aggressive and not accommodating at all. One of my friends had to miss a class for some valid reason, and she marked her down for the in-class assignment. She should be the one learning management
Took her BA361 class. A good person but a bad professor. Very unorganized class, minimal instructions and time given to do group projects. No review guides for final exam at all.

I have Jody for BA 361 and would say all of the other reviews are very accurate. She brings lots of guest speakers which are pretty interesting but then mainly tests on textbook content. Her TA does all of the stuff on canvas so tbh I'm not really sure what she actually does. Little to no direction or time to work with teams or projects.
Horrible experience

Jody is a sweet person and means well, but she is not a good professor. I have to cut her some slack because she is new to teaching in the U.S. She spends most of class talking about her personal experience and bringing in guest speakers to fill up time. She spends very little time covering information in the textbook (which you will be tested on).

I find that while many of the other reviews have validity to them, she is new to teaching in her position. She has been given a horrible curriculum of which she is not in control of 80% of it. As the term went on, she made changes to try her best to make things more cohesive and organized, albeit some fell short.

Are you from Dubai? Have an AEC letter perhaps? If so, this is an excellent class for you. She is a cool professor with interesting stories about her time in Silicon Valley and fosters an active class environment. She likes to keep you on your toes changing due dates constantly and keeps you guessing about what's expected with unclear instructions.

Unclear about grading criteria/deadlines and never communicates with the class. Creates assignments with a deadline due that day or has already passed. The lectures aren't helpful, the classes are pointless, she barely gives us time to work with our teams. Not a hard class but she makes it confusing, and she does NOT respond to emails/Canvas inbox.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Everyone discusses why we even attend class. Lectures are super unorganized and the group project instructions are unclearly communicated. Super unforgiving with your grades and provides little feedback when you get something wrong. The canvas page has the wrong dates and assignments are not posted until the due date. Tests are open notes.

Very disorganized class. Feels like you are doing 3 projects at once while also doing normal class material and she does not help you organize any of it. She is unforgiving with a lot of things as well. Unable to use canvas and technology actually worsens the class. Blames a lot of her mannerisms on her time spent in Dubai which just feels weird.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Jody be wylin. There's quite a bit of work, you'll be working on a lot of things at once which can be tricky to manage. Her lectures are pointless and you'll wonder how she's still a professor. The topic isn't necessarily hard and as long as you read the chapters and take good notes you'll do fine. Tests are open note
Overall great class. Very easy class as long as you show up.
She's super kind and always very excited about what she is teaching. As long as you show up and read the assigned pages this class should be a breeze.

She's a sweet charming old lady but she rambles a lot. Also she goes on Zionist rants sometimes which is unfortunate. Class itself is easy if you just show up and take notes before each class it's pretty simple.
She does kinda ramble, but she is a very nice old woman. Only way you fail the class, is to not read and not show up.

Julia is caring and is passionate about arts and Russian culture. However, this is the most disorganized class I have been apart of in my entire academic career. Julia goes on weird tangents about nothing for a majority of the class. Furthermore, the class has an insane western pov, as Julia herself claimed that "people are killed every day in Rus"
Racist

She is an incredibly nice, caring woman who cares about her students and the content she presents. I'm taking her class online, and it is a bit disorganized. The homework is based off the reading, and the class itself is mostly various random discussions about Russian nuance. She's smart and very nice, her class is just a bit unclear. 2 textbooks.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Julia is one of the nicest and most caring teachers I've ever had. Her lectures are extremely disorganized, however, and I began to feel like the only reason I should even bother showing up to class were the weekly pop quizzes. As long as you complete all of your work on time you should get an A, as she is a very easy grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: This is Russian thru Theater- show up to the first class and audition, then Julia customizes a play and you start rehearsing. There's fun warmups, tech/set-building parties, bonding, etc. It's a lot of work (memorize, practice, work on art..) but a completely unique course and you end up with awesome experiences and great friends. Julia's amazing.

She definitely cares about all of her students and wants everyone to succeed. . Directions for assignments were sometimes unclear and the pop quizzes were difficult but she lets you do as much Extra Credit as you need to make up for any lost points. If you were happy with your grade at the end of the term, then you didn't have to take the final.
Very kind, she cares about all her students and wants them to pass.

Shes very interested in the material, and pretty funny in her own way. Yes the guidelines for the class are unclear, it is treated more like an upperdivision in that sense. Although the class is not difficult if you keep up on the reading and have a comment in class occasionally.

She was really interested in the literature and did a great job of explaining the works, which would've been hard to understand otherwise. You have to read and do write ups for every class, but they aren't hard. If you do well, you don't have to take the final. Offers extra credit assignments. Helpful if you ask for it.

She is awesome. Though it is unclear most of the time what needs to be done, she makes the class interesting and has lots of insightful and interesting facts about Russian culture and history. Participation is required.

Ridiculously easy class. You don't have to take the final. However, she is the most infuriating teacher I've ever had. She constantly throws her views of religion into class discussions. Also, her assignments and what is due when is very unclear. She also has a very thick russian accent.

Molly is an understandable professor. She does make-up videos for absences, and you can have up to 5 absences. She gives review sheet/session that is similar to the test, but she can be lecture heavy. Overall, she is willing to help you work out concepts that you don't understand, so if you put in some effort, you should be able to do this class.
Nice professor, but she has unreal expectations of how much time and energy students can put into her class. I recommend only taking this class during an easy quarter. Molly is very nice otherwise.

100 level class but her and the GE treat it like a 400 level. Harsh grading, extra credit and exam regrades to earn back points are a drop in the bucket compared with the overall volume of assignments. Reads the slides nearly word for word every lecture and relies on iClicker questions for engagement, makes an interesting subject mind numbing.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The class would've been fun and interesting but she made it very difficult. The regrade option for the tests is not helpful at all and there's no point in doing it. We are given a cheat sheet for each test but it's not helpful at all because everything written on them has nothing to do with the test.

Worst professor ive taken at UO. If you dont want the lectures she will comment on your assignments telling you to watch them, she comments on every single assignment and has something negative to say. The online lectures aren't even her lectures they are some other random professor. You will get a bad grade. Overall a terrible stressful experience
As long as you show up to lecture and lab and do your work you'll be ok. She makes the labs very fun if you're interested in the topics covered.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Made what could have been a fun class possibly my least favorite class ever taken at uo. I would recommend taking the lab section at a other school
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I thought this course would be interesting, but really all it did was raise my cortisol levels. Seriously, this class was so stressful that it made my hair fall out. Her grading is ruthless, and she will condescend you at any opportunity. Each interminable homework assignment takes about 6-8 hours to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Nice professor but can loose many points for small things in the lab. Even being a minute late would loose you -.5 points per lab. Always ran out of time when it came down to the tests.

Read Everything, 
This professor is incredibly strict, and you can and will lose points on anything and everything. Exams are long with very little time. Most people run out of time, and you need to be very nitpicky about everything especially in the Lab. Mistakes cost points and the more you make the more you lose.

Molly is nice and tries to make class as funny as she can with jokes but it just not cut out for teacher. Her lectures are fast and kind of scattered with heavy emphasis on knowing stuff for exams but then little to none of the lecture material is on the exams..

Not a good teacher at all and is overly strict her grading. She speaks to you like a kindergarten teacher but expects your answers to be grad level answers. Her class is boring and lecture quizzes were not stuff she covered in lecture so you will have to teach yourself most of the class. I would highly recommend avoiding her class if you can.

Professor Jud really seems like a sweet person but she is awful at her job. All participation is through iClickers and lectures honestly make no sense. Our exams are huge portions of our grade and she offers terrible help before hand. We get a study guide that has nothing to do with concepts we've covered and the class average is always around 60%.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Molly's class was more difficult than needed to be. She is lecture heavy and attendance is reliant on clickers. Her tests are based on the group problem sets and ungraded practice problems so focus on those. Go to office hours if you don't understand a concept. A big tip would be to map out processes. Watch the videos, skip the readings.

Very strange class setup. Mandatory videos made by a different professor, and she uses the same slides from the videos in lecture. Lectures are just going over the non-mandatory videos by the same professor. Midterm averages were really low. She's funny in class, but I wouldn't have gone if there weren't iclickers.

Molly has the most annoying voice I have ever heard. Her lectures are painful to listen to because of her lack of the ability to explain any of the concepts. She's sweet and tries to be fun which is why I put 2 stars and not 1. Course has video lectures from a different professor with embedded questions, 2 midterms+a final, & weekly review quizzes
Molly does not know how to teach. She reads information off of the screen and offers no explanation

The organization of this class is not practical.Lectures are speed reading of slides with lots of clicker questions for recall. It is practically impossible to learn the material without watching the recorded videos. The exams don't relate to the slides but rather the lab and ungraded problems. Horrible grading system, avoid her class at all costs.

Wasn't flexible to meet literally the most basic of accommodations. Was beyond frustrated with the lack of willingness to meet my single, basic accommodation. Didn't bring it to the attention of the AEC, but damn. Also, fruit flies are gross.

Molly is a fast paced lecturer (has videos if confused). Nearly no homework outside of weekly quiz, but is test heavy (2 midterm and final). Allowed to use a note sheet on tests, so if you make a great note sheet you'll do fine in the course, but if you do not put time into the note sheet this course is extremely challenging.

Molly jud has seemingly no knowledge of the subject outside of the course which makes answering student questions hard and the tests are nothing like the lectures. Im lucky I took ap bio so I had a good understanding of the subject but her lectures are slow, sometimes random, and full of tangents. They give out busywork but do offer EC.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I have already taken this course in HS and let me tell you something, the clarity of Mollys teaching is very hard to comprehend and she's just not cut out for teaching. Also the exams are extremely challenging with material that usually isn't covered in lecture with lots of vocab and memorization. This course is made way harder then it should be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Goes really fast during lecture which does not let me process anything in my mind lol. Tests are mostly based on the lab package and not what was taught on slides, so studying for a test was kind of brutal. Going to class is a waste of time since you can see the videos before hand, but need to go for clicker points.

I have Molly Jud for Bio 211 and while she is great for one on one teaching, her lectures are VERY fast and she's a little hard to follow. I recommend watching the Canvas videos prior to lecture and use lecture as a review. Don't expect to learn from lecture!!! Molly is very approachable and takes the time to explain things during office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I can definitively say I learned a lot in her class. Her dedication to teaching primary literature is taken to an extreme with long hours of homework and very tough readings.  There is also no credit to be found for trying your best (i.e. grades based on completion). This on its own would be fine were it not for her very stringent grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Molly is a great person, just new at teaching which made this class frustrating as she would have tests that were pretty hard and give no review material. In addition the lectures felt a bit useless as they would go through the material too fast so that you were really just learning it on your own.

This professor made me reconsider Spanish. I am shocked she has many 5star reviews. She does not have respect for her students, she will make inappropriate comments about you in front of the entire class. Had to fight her for my AEC accom. She made class uncomfortable.  Avoid!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I had the worst experience with prof Deveraux. She was incredibly mean, cynical, and had no desire to be welcoming or kind to her students. She has no desire to help you or to work with you. She cold calls and you will be humiliated and criticized if you don't know the answer. UO needs to reevaluate her place at this university.

Juanita keeps students engaged. She was a very quick grader, would have the assignment graded within the day it was due. Clear instructions on assignments. Very organized, sharp, funny. Very nice... unless she didn't like you. She was very rude to students who showed up late, regardless of if they had a legitimate reason. She is impatient.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I am honestly surprised by all of the positive reviews. Juanita is a very difficult professor and can be extremely harsh to her students. She has some positive moments for sure, and can be funny, but she is extremely impatient. It is very stressful going into class because you never know what mood she is going to be in.

Spent first 6 weeks on colonization of the America's, next 4 weeks on Chilean dictatorship. Way too narrow of a scope for a class on social changes. Didn't even acknowledge that every single Latin American country has experienced a dictatorship in it's history. So many tests on the exact same topic as the last test. Hours of reading every day.

Professor Deveraux was incredibly interesting and made the most boring parts of the textbooks worth reading. She made the ending of the 200 level Spanish sequence fun and was constantly engaging with students. She's known for cold-calling students, but you get used to it really fast. Take her if you get the opportunity!

Prof Devereaux is an amazing person. She assigns a lot of work but her tests are fair and all of the homework is applicable to the class. Yes, she calls on people but she is extremely chill if someone doesn't know the answer. As long as you show you are trying in the class and study for the tests you will do great!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: I love Juanita! Very passionate about her teaching and is obliviously funny. She can be very blunt but don't take it personal... and do not show up late!! She is very clear with expectations and all you have to do is read and show up to class to talk about it. Always a day of good review before exams. Take her class!

Juanita is the best Spanish professor I have had at the UO. Yes, she does cold call but you shouldn't be taking a Spanish class if you aren't going to speak it. She's very understanding and is passionate about the material she's teaching. Class is really interesting and fun once you get comfortable. Class discusses readings- make sure to do them !
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teacher and person. She really cares about her students and makes an effort to help everyone improve in Spanish. She is clear about assignments and expectations, so no curve balls! I really enjoyed this class, but there was a ton of reading and the tests were pretty hard. Definitely stay on top of assignments and don't forget to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Juanita is an excellent professor and person! She made learning Spanish so fun. I really appreciated her approach to grading which was focused on if you are picking up important concepts and can expand on those things. She also truly cares about the well-being of her students and asked often about what could be most useful to us.

She's coo. I mean she'll call on you every class but most of the time.. they're like short answer responses. Sometimes she'll pick on you to read big slides which is kind of annoying but it's good practice. Few assignments, 5 big assessments but they're lowkey light because it's online. She's nice and not rude.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Warning for anyone who wants to take this class. If you don't like participating, don't take a class with Juanita. She goes through the attendance list and calls on everyone's name more than once so you have to participate. Your grade is also mostly made up of 5 exams that are a ton of writing, studying and you have only 50 minutes.

I love this woman! She is so funny and really makes you feel confident and comfortable speaking in class. Most of class is her just asking students different questions randomly about what we are learning and is really understanding if you dont know the answer. Class isnt very hard if you have taken a Spanish class before.

Although this class includes lots of reading and lots of talking about the readings, it is a great class. If you do the work. This is basically a History class in Spanish. It can be hard to jump into such a reading-heavy class and retain all that info, but to get an A, you have to put in the work to understand and summarize.

Juanita wants you to succeed. If you mess up, so what? We are all there to learn! She looks for the best in all of her students and is amazing to get to know. Shes witty and makes class incredibly fun for all!

Required attendance, required camera on, required participation (speaking in class every day). Juanita tries to make the class as close to the online experience as possible, which has its advantages and disadvantages. I've stayed with her throughout all of the 200 level Spanish courses. I wish I could've taken her courses in person.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is scary, and tends to belittle her students pretty often, theres always a victim in every class. Loses her patience easily and gets frustrated when students cant pronounce or answer correctly. Class material could have been more interesting but it was educative.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class was okay, get ready to read very long and dry readings as long as you complete everything on time you will be fine. However if you have the chance to take the class with a different professor do it, Juanita loses her temper easily and can be rude and put her students down if they don't answer correctly or follow her guidelines.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Perhaps its just because of the online conditions, but She becomes very angry when students ask questions pretty much about anything and because of that students didnt ask questions and never knew what was going on. It got so bad that our class had a group chat with most of the students because no one understood what to do for the final project.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Juanita is very nice and funny, and wants the best for you. During zoom calls she will call on you randomly so make sure you read what you are supposed to before class. She a easy grader, just make sure you elaborate on your responses a little bit and that will give you an extra boost. Participate! And do the hw!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I found that Juanita wasn't very approachable. She has a clear grasp of the material but gets frustrated very easily if you get confused by any of the material and ask questions. When I went to class I didn't know if she was going to be chatty and perky that day or if she was going to be short and curt.

Juanita truly cares about her students and the curriculum she is teaching. She creates a safe environment for learning Spanish, which really allowed me to grow as a Spanish learner and taught me to be more comfortable making mistakes. One of the best professors in the Spanish dept. at UO.

Juanita is one of the best Spanish teachers I've ever had! She is very patient and clear on grading criteria. She listens to her students and wants you to succeed. Just had her for 203 and she made the class super fun! There is online hw every night that takes about 10-15 minutes and is actually useful to what you are learning.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Juanita is the best spanish teacher I have EVER had. She is passionate and makes class time pass quickly. She loves when students talk and isn't deterred by bad pronunciation etc. Love her! Learned a lot without feeling like the term was dragging by.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Juanita's class is lit take that if you can she's amazing! Super clear and I really feel like I learned a lot. She really takes the pressure of of things making it easy to focus on material. I am definitely going to take more classes with her in the future!
Juanita was hilarious and extremely passionate about the success of her students. She is a professor fellow students and I still talk about for being a great person.
She is my best Spanish professor. She is super helpful and hilarious. There are week tests but she graded easily. Also she always leaves a lot feedback on your homework.

Juanita is a confusing character at first -- extremely sarcastic and will definitely commit word vomit. 10 wks later, she is my favorite SPAN professor. Very passionate and likeable. Clear criteria. Read up because tests are difficult, but she only asks of you what is reasonable. VERY patient with non-native speakers. Take her. Take her. Take her!!

Juanita is by far the best Spanish professor I've had. She is very clear when teaching and she uses a lot of colloquial Spanish terms. If you attend class regularly she will be happy to help you and answer questions.
so good!!! so patient!!!

One of the best professors I have ever had! She truly cares about her students and she is able to make Spanish incredibly enjoyable and fun. If you put effort into learning in her class she will notice and she will like you a lot! I looked forward to this class every day.
Juanita is awesome! She loves her class and her students.
I loved Juanita. She was such a nice teacher and the lessons were super easy. Her class is structured really well and it's an easy A. Just come to class and do well on the quizzes.
Great teacher, easy to understand and a very reasonable grader! I really liked this class!
Juanita is a great teacher. I hope to take a class from her again. She is super helpful and very kind. Go to her office hours at least once because once I did I began doing a lot better in her class.

She's great! And such an easy grader. The class is really simple. You read stories and have a quiz every Wednesday but they are super short (who were the main characters and what happened in the end?) One paper and one presentation and 3 exams that are vocab from the stories and main ideas. She grades really easy so don't stress. She so nice!

Juanita is a very interesting teacher who cares a lot about both Spanish and her students. If you participate and do your best, you will get a decent grade. The unit tests are fairly hard, so pay read the stories carefully and pay attention to the student presentations. A third of the test is always vocal, so if that is a weak area, practice!

I took Spanish 201 and 202 and i have never felt so confident with my Spanish speaking. She knows how to teach effectively and really helps you understand the material. If you want to learn Spanish in a fun environment, take this class! If you go to class, participate, and have enthusiasm, this will be the best Spanish class you will take at UO.

By far the best Spanish teacher I have had at the University of Oregon. Extremely fair grader, pretty easy material. Very passionate about the subject AND her students. Class participation is key, she WILL learn your name and call on you.
Juanita is a great teacher- she's hilarious and enthusiastic. If you put in a good effort, you will get the grade you want.
Great professor. a Little Moody but she will get you excited about Spanish. I totally recommend Juanita.

She is by far my favorite teacher at Oregon. I used to be terrified of Spanish due to a few horrid teachers, but Juanita really turned my Spanish experience around. She is very fair on assignments, tests and presentations. She's understanding and cares about her students. Fabulous professor! I'm sad I couldn't get into her 203 class!

I had Juanita for Spanish 201 and was really bummed when I wasn't able to get her for 202. She has been my favorite teacher so far and I am really hoping I get her for 203. She is very funny and also very helpful. I never had to study for tests because she did such a good job at getting us all prepared in class. She made me not want to miss class!

Very helpful with everything. Will try her hardest to make sure you learn the material rather than just get through it. Homework is pretty much required because she does call on students in class, but provides MORE than enough opportunities to speak in Spanish which is prime to actually learn the language

Tries to be cool and joke around but I've had three other spanish teachers here and she's by far the least genuine and sincere.  If you get her at the beginning of the 200 level sequence she'll go easier on you for some reason; otherwise stay away.
my favorite teacher at oregon. shes helpful and nice, and really cares about her students.
She keeps class moving and jokes around. Little modesty in this class... its great.

Juanita was awesome! She goes above and beyond to make sure her students understand what is going on. Very fair grader. Also she makes it so that presentations are comfortable and not intimidating! I would definately recommend her!

Juanita is one of the best spanish teachers I have ever had, hands down.  I would highly recommend her, she is incredible and will connect with you past the teacher student level which is comforting to find in such a large university
Great prof, she is awesome.

Juanita is a great Spanish teacher! Quizzes can catch you off guard if you don't do the homework but in general class time always flies by. I've never been bored in her class and her emphasis on creativity makes class fun.

Juanita was the best professor I have had in college. I took her 201, 202, and 203 spanish classes. She always encouraged creativity and gave us plenty of opportunities to talk in spanish. Always provided helpful and critical feedback on assignments as well
