Easily one of my most favorit prof's in thre years at oregon.
The guy is awesome. Enough said.

Coach T, was a good teacher.  He kept moving due dates around for quizes and homework, this made it very difficult to stay on top of the homework and/or readings.  Overall I enjoyed the class, he's a good teacher I learned a lot from him that I think will be useful.
Coach T really wants you to get As but also requires you to learn and does whatever he can.  Homework was heavy but not up to him.  Great teacher.

"Coash T" is a very helpful teacher and really wants his students to succeed.  He sets up a classroom for his "office hours" to allow you to do your homework, and as questions there.  ALthough there is a lot of hw to be done (At least 9 pages per week) but it pays off in the long run because it helps on the midterms.  He is one of the best teachers i've had EVER

He explains his lectures very clearly. He goes at a slow pace so students can understand the material. He is very helpful and answers many questions. His well prepares his students for the midterms and final.

Such an awesome professor. I've taken three of his classes, but this one was definitely my favorite. I feel like you get a lot of creative freedom in the assignments for this class. Lectures are chill. Ty is always so open, caring, and passionate about what he teaches. All around great person with positive energy. Tries his best to make things fun!

I took 251, not sure why the only option is 250. Great professor. Lectures are fun and interesting, but not fully relevant. Syllabus tells you about the free software you can use. I felt like I belonged even though I have very little experience with video editing.I had Eric Franco as a lab instructor. He's nice and helpful, but difficult to hear.
Ty was an incredible professor! He really cares about all of his students succeeding, and gives great feedback!

Ty is a great guy, very kind, but not the greatest professor. Incredibly hard to reach and there wasn't clear communication between him and the GEs. Lots of difficulties with canvas too, assignments & quizzes weren't posted in a timely manner, or at all. Material was very interesting, but you will have to teach yourself the adobe suite.
Ty is fun! He's very nonchalant and is very passionate about what he teaches. The only homework you really have are the three lab projects and MAYBE some quizzes.

Love him! Amazing professor. He's the reason I knew I wanted to stay at the U of O. His lectures are really engaging, and he makes a point to show he cares and respects every single student. He's very understanding and supportive. I would honestly retake the class just to have him as a professor again if I could.

Ty really cares about everyone in his classes and is passionate. Ultimately class really depends on your TA though, 95% of your time is with the TA. I was more interesting in 251 and 252 than this class but it was decently fun regardless. Ty is entertaining, very political, and has some millennial humor for sure, but he is very chill.

Ty was amazing. He did three big projects throughout the term. It can be a lot of work but he gives out feedback and you have the ability to resubmit for a better grade. Lectures weren't always engaging but it was still a fun class if you're interested in digital arts.

First ARTD class I took, and it was good! I can tell Ty is passionate and loves his students. All around cool dude. He is even hosting office hours during Thanksgiving to talk to students this term :,). The class was interesting; lectures feel longer than they need to be......but its OK. Ty is great. Talk to him; he's a really good resource.

Ty is the most wonderful and inspiration professor I have met at UO. He speaks with such passion and clearly loves his students and appreciates their work. I'd say the grading is a little tough but it's mostly graded by graduate students so it's not always his opinion. He is really easy to talk to and is always willing to help. His projects are fun

Ty is such a kind and fun professor! I loved the apocalypse theme of this class, I thought that was really fun and innovative. This class uses a lot of Adobe Illustrator, which can be a bit of a struggle if you're new to Adobe, however, there is some leniency with using other programs as well as Adobe that you might be more familiar with.

Ty's lectures are my favorite. Super interesting and helpful. I think this class would probably be a bit more challenging if you don't have experience with Premiere Pro. But once you get the hang of that, the assignments are really fun and rewarding, if time-consuming. Really felt like Ty went the extra mile to relate to students and engage w them!

Easily my favorite prof so far. I'm hoping to have him again in the future, dude really cares about his students and makes the content very engaging. He was an inspiration to me & I sometimes got a little emotional in class as he covers some heavy topics v well. Lab was kind of a grind but very rewarding. Be on top of your work and you'll do fine!
BEST PROFESSOR EVER! Ty is so kind and smart, classes are always engaging and the workload is always fair and engaging. Definitely take every class with him that you can!

Don't be fooled: NOT A DIGITAL DRAWING CLASS it is solely video editing. Amazing lectures that are fun and informative. Beware that there is no hand-holding in this class and you are taught simple adobe premiere skills, you will have to look up how to do everything else/ask teacher. Projects are easy if you think outside the box and be different
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Ty is the best professor I've ever had. This class was also the hardest course I've ever taken. But the level of work makes sense and you will be proud of what you accomplish. His lectures are SO good I never missed one, and I usually skip class. Be prepared to work incredibly hard but feel rewarded. Ty has high but reasonable expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Super interesting class. You can tell Ty has a real passion for art and it shows during the lectures.

One of the best things about Ty is that he makes you want to push yourself on the projects and do well in the class. The projects are extremely time consuming but also very rewarding. I see comments about him being a tough grader but I'm pretty sure my GE graded my projects, idk. Kevin Yatsu is also the GOAT ge for this class.

Tyras is by far my favorite teacher I've ever had. I was blessed to be able to take him for two of my classes (and hopefully more soon) but this man is extravagant. When it comes to your grade, he absolutely hates giving grades and gives you as many tries as you want for the projects, as he explains "grades kill creativity and are non realistic"

Ty is really good at keeping the class engaged, and discussing material that is relevant to the projects in ways you wouldn't think they are. He is also a really hard grader, but he gives up until finals week to redo projects as many times as you'd like. I took ARTD 250 and 251 with him, and I'd do it again. My art has improved a lot with him

Very difficult projects are a part of this class but he makes it worth while. Super laid back and chill. Jokes around a lot and makes sure to include the fun within the work. Has very inspirational lectures that keep you thinking throughout the day. Highly recommend!

Ty is one of the best professors, but more realistically, mentors, I have ever had. He will make you work harder and more critically than you ever thought you would, but you will improve SO much as an artist. His class radically changed my work, and way of thinking, for the better. He is a good professor, but more importantly, he is a good person.

Ty is an amazing teacher that WANTS you to learn. I've never had a more approachable professor. There is a lot of work but Ty provides very detailed and informative feedback meant to guide you to improvement, not reflect who you are or what type of letter grade you deserve.

Ty is a very caring and empathetic person- but that being said hes one of the harshest graders Ive ever met. I learned a lot from him, and his lectures were engaging (although very long), but I wouldnt recommend his class to a non-major. Get ready to spend several hours a day on projects and get a poor grade. Still cant believe I pulled an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I've had Ty for 2 classes.  He's a tough grader and you will work hard.  I went to office hours and talked to him after class tho and he was super helpful.  The lectures are great, very funny and interesting.
fun class

Unless this is class is required for a major or minor I would avoid this teacher if not this course. Ty is the toughest grader I have run into and you can work the hardest you ever have and it still won't land you anything but a B. This is not an "easy A" by any means and unless you LOVE art projects I would steer clear.

You will probably love the lectures that tie art and modern culture together seamlessly, and then... you'll get your grade. Yeesh. I don't look at Ty the same anymore.   If you just want to learn the Adobe suite then skip the class and use Lynda which is what you're assigned instead of a textbook. Your project grades will depend on your gta.

This is my second class with Ty in the digital arts track. For a 200-level class, yet again, it is exceptionally hard. Ty leads fantastic lectures and they're the best part of the class, but you will probably work harder than you have in any other class  -- and still receive a lackluster grade. In ways, it's rewarding but it's also very stressful.

Ty's class was very interesting, however it's very difficult for a 100 level class. It's a lot of writing, so take WR 121 first before you sign up for this class. The visual assignments were fun, but there were only two. Don't expect to do a lot of art. There was a paper expected each week, but it had to be very well thought out and organized.
This class was so confusing and I felt like I got absolutely nothing out of it. I would have dropped it if I didn't need it for my major.

This Digital Arts classgradebook contains 3 big projects and 2 small papers - that's it. Ty is a notoriously hard grader so this class has a lot of stress with regards to pouring energy into these few assignments with hopes of getting a good grade. It's an interesting class - and the long lectures are engaging - but be very prepared to work hard.
Ty is awesome! The class was not easy, but if you work hard, follow directions, and pay attention in class, you should be fine. Ty is funny and always gets the class to laugh. Great professor!
Amazing teacher that knows how to inspire critical thought. More than willing to help with her classes and the digital arts department in general. I definitely recommend this professor.

Grades depend solely on your writing ability. I didn't expect this class to be an "Easy A" but I didn't expect it to be impossible to get an A either - which it basically is. I followed all of her suggestions and my grade never improved. Every week there was something new I was doing wrong. Only bonus is some of the art is actually fascinating.

Honestly the best professor I've ever had. TY forced me to think deeper and articulate my thought far more than anyone has ever asked of me. There is no midterm or tests. Everyday I looked forward to attending this class. Her teaching style is incredibly engaging   and fun. Truly a professor who loves her job, and is always there to help.

I feel that some of the comments posted here are from people who are shallow thinkers (or maybe not very smart). Yeah she's hard, but she's very willing to help if you're struggling so long as you don't do it at the last minute or try to BS a project. So if you want an easy A, don't take her classes, otherwise she's the bomb (and really funny!!) :)

Had potential to be interesting class, but became repetitive. The format of guest speaker, useless on-line "discussion" group and blog week after week became tedious. Also instructor used the F word so many times it was hard to take her seriously. If you absolutely do not need this class to graduate do not take it!!

I was really disappointed this was not an actual art class, but we heard from a different artist/professor each week and it was interesting! Attendance is practically mandatory, miss 5 your grade will drop. Each sunday we had to write a blog about the previous week. Pay attention and give thoughtful answers in your blogs and it's a piece o' caaake

Best Digital Arts teacher in my opinion. Very helpful when thinking of concepts for projects. Gives good suggestions and recommendations. Also runs the best critiques I've been apart of. She gives great feedback and inspires the rest of the class to give use full feedback. Plus she's just a fun teacher!
Awesome teacher! Don't be afraid to push yourself and take this class!
So awesome. Take her at any means necessary.
One of the best teachers I've ever had. Take her class.
absolutely LOVE her!!! she really wants you to push yourself and to enrich yourself as an artist. not the teacher you want if you just want an easy a.
Ty is the best. She is the best person to teach this course because she is a true artist. She knows how to get her students to think differently and find creativity. Super rad individual too.

Her humor is interesting. Its a cool class because every assignment is done in your lab, except for 2 papers which are a piece of cake, easy A's. As long as you work hard on your lab projects you should get an A. The lecture is interesting but because its 2 hours, its something that i ended up sleeping in a out 95% of the class.
One of my favorite digital arts professors. She offers great critique and helps to further ideas to places unimaginable at the beginning of the class.
Awesome professor.

So, let me just say first, that I do like Tyler Kendall as a person, and at times he does show a degree of intrinsic interest, however,  he is not a very good professor and he lacks an ability to see issues in the bigger scope of things. But at the end of the day, Tyler is just there to collect another check, he showed me that.

This class was very interesting and I learned a lot. Tyler is a good teacher and is extremely eloquent. Assignments are long and hard, do not wait last minute to do anything in this class. Great teacher, not for people who aren't majoring in linguistics.

So boring! His powerpoint slides are packed full of stuff you need to take notes on but he blazes through them so fast that you can't even write half of the information down. There was a ton of reading that was impossible to keep up.  I did not enjoy this class at all! Avoid it if at all possible!

Tyler is a really cool guy. He didn't give off a pretentious vibe at all. He managed to present the material in a way that wasn't at all overwhelming. He is also very funny. I highly recommend taking one of his classes.
Pretty cool, but a very calming voice. Figure out a good way to stay awake if you have problems wit that during lectures.
Great teacher, go to class and you'll get an A
Super Hipster
He is great

The best professor I have ever had at this University! His lectures were always very cool and were easy to learn from because he posts them online for you to access at any time after lecture. He's a bit of a goofball trying to be "hip", but thats part of what makes him enjoyable and the class enjoyable. Needless to say he's hilarious too. Easy A.

Chet Udell is one of the best teachers I've had! He had some really interesting lectures and some less interesting lectures, but the class itself was amazing. I learned a lot; this is definitely a class that you'll think about years later. I listen to music in a much more involved way, it's been a great experience.
One of the better professors I've had at the University of Oregon. Had great lectures and made teaching the subject as fun as one could make it. 10/10 Recommend
Fairly Easy Class, but one of the best, weirdest, but most successful professors Ive had in college.

I always looked forward to going to his class. He always had lectures that were easy to follow and really engaging. As a music major, the things I learned were really eye opening and helped me understand more of what I am really interested in. I would take every class from him if I could.

Dr. Chet Udell is incredibly passionate about the subject he teaches. He loves music and it creates an atmosphere in the classroom that I really enjoy. He dances to the music and truly enjoys himself which is a great quality of person, and teacher. His class wasn't incredibly intensive, you just need to show up and pay attention and you'll do well
Amazing professor. He makes class really really fun, and is always cracking jokes, while teaching you everything you need to be taught. I would definitely recommend him.
Kind of a goofy dude, but I guess that's better than a boring lecturer. Must show up for iClicker questions. That and reading quizzes are majority of your grade. Tests are really easy.

This is a super easy class as long as you show up to class and do fairly well on the iclickers. He tries to be really hip, but sometimes is rude to students. The lectures are entertaining though, easy A.

Chet's a cool dude. His class is pretty boring but I think that's just the nature of the material, especially when you're like me and have absolutely no interest in it. But it's easy; you gotta go to class (I've missed a few sessions and I totally regret it) to get iClicker points, which are a big part of the grade. Exams aren't too difficult.

His lectures are really interesting filled with cool music. However, you need to study ahead for iClicker questions. They count a lot. Also, if you are one of the top 10 students who scores highest iClicker points, you will receive automatic 100% on your final and don't have to show up to the final. Study for those iclicker questions!

Studying for his tests are impossible! His slides only contain opinions, not things you can actually study. He is an interesting lecturer but his tests and slides are so unorganized. He is funny though and says some quotable stuff. Textbook is NOT NEEDED
Chet is awesome. This was the best class and we learned about a ton of cool modern music. He's also hilarious.

Chet is awesome. His passion and knowledge for music help make the class so much fun. He is a cool and respectable dude, the class is always under control and engaged. So interesting and one of the most fun classes I have ever taken!
He's awesome!!!!!!! my peers never complain about him. He's always fair to his students. I know he's not an "Easy A grader" but he gives a very reasonable grade.

This class is boring. The content is mundane and the proff uses prezi to attempt to make the content more interesting and "hip" yet it lacks clarity (always) and usually contains only his opinions and not much factual evidence. The only reason why students come to class is to get iclicker questions (usually the questions are really random)

Class is so boring, but you need to go for the clicker questions. There are online quizzes on readings before every class but those are super easy and most of the answers can be found in the book. If you want to take a boring easy class that requires minimum work take this.
He is the best math teacher I've ever met. Nice and patient. Explains every question specifically. It's no attendance required, but you would like to go to the class every time.

Best math/calc teacher I've ever had!! super chill and easy class. he gives extra credit and the homework is worth a lot so make sure u do the homework. no way u can't pass this class. easy B,C need to put effort for an A
He's a great teacher and super approachable in office hours. He answers emails quickly and is always willing to help out. (Also, it doesn't hurt that his accent is hot af)
He talks with a funny accent but knows his stuff.  Just about everybody got an A.

Prof. Ursell is great! this is the only physics class I've ever taken and enjoyed. Lots of demos and generally a good time. The homework can be hard but there is help available. the general physics track would have been a waste if it weren't for this class. its kind of like a reward for getting through 201 and 202.

I loved Prof. Ursell for physics. A majority of our grade was quizzes and homework, but if you find a group of people to do the HW with it won't be too bad. The quizzes were always challenging but if you do everything else you'll be fine grade-wise. He was funny and had multiple chances for extra credit. Overall really caring and nice guy.

Tristan does a great job of explaining stuff in his lectures. He has really helpful and sometimes hilarious analogies. If you pay attention, you probably dont need to read the textbook. Homeworks are hard, but find a group of people to do it together with and use office hours.

I cannot praise this man highly enough. His intro physics course is one I would recommend anyone take. He's also very nice and will help you out if you ask him for it. Study the material, and you will do just fine. His lectures are also a treat, he lets you have a back and forth.

Hands down my favorite professor in my freshmen year. He is just awesome to be in his class and I look forward to going there every time. Awesome to joke with because his sense of humor was top-notch. 12/10 would recommend the professor.

Tyler was a really great professor! He cares a lot about his students and really appreciates when students participate. He is happy to answer any question and really explain it. He has a young family and understands if things come up. His quizzes and tests are a bit difficult but he gives you lots of review material. Don't read or buy the textbook.

Tyler is awesome. He's young and easy to relate to. Tyler shows current events nearly every day which really help show the prevalence of econ in our world. Tests are challenging but the kind of challenging that makes you feel good about the work you put in--they're very achievable and fair. I would love to take another class from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Tyler is the Dawg. He is very clear what he wants, and he really desires for students to do well in his class. Take him at all costs. He teaches the content very well and is extremely flexible when it comes to what the best method for teaching the students is.

Ty ty is the man!  The class is very straightforward and he makes clear what is expected of you.  He really is a great teacher, even if you were to disregard his age.  But the fact that he is a grad student makes it all the more remarkable.  Definitely one of the best professors I have had at the U of O.  If you get the chance...TAKE HIM.  He rocks

Tyler has been one of the best econ instructors I have had here at the UO, and he is still a grad student. Once this guy gets his Ph.D. he should have universities fighting for him. He made the class so enjoyable to attend and he is great to have a discussion with. He engages the class so well and current events tie everything together. Take him!
Every day of class Tyler shows up coffee-in-hand, enthusiastic and prepared to teach the class. Tyler runs a great class discussion and I recommend him to any Econ student.
Would recommend to anyone. Really cares about his students and economics. He is an interesting lecturer and you will learn a lot about world events along with economics. :D

T Schip is the man. He really cares about his students and takes a lot of extra time to help people who are struggling. He relates what you talk about in the class to real life events which helps make the class more interesting. Honestly if anyone can get you engaged and interested in economics it is going to be him. I have so much respect for him.

I went from having a horrible econ 201 professor to an awesome 202 (Tyler) professor. You can survive by missing a few classes but he explains things very well in lecture so it's in your best interest to go. His exams aren't hard, but they arent super easy. They're just right and if you actually read the book you should have NO PROBLEM getting an A
This guy is awesome. He makes the class so interesting and is always willing to explain more. I would definitely take another class with him
Easy class, helpful guy, interesting subject.

Tyler is a goddamn bro. Great teacher, very easy to talk to, very generous with help, and very easy to approach. This class could have been a nightmare but he loved it and made it very interesting and easy to learn the concepts. It gets harder towards the end but as long as you go to class it's not hard to do reasonably well.

He really enjoys teaching and cares about the material. If you put in the amount of effort he gives his students you will easily succeed. Reading over terms in the book proved helpful as his tests are written from book def's. Taking his econ 390 class, really enjoyed econ 202.
Tyler was awesome! I would take another class from him in a heartbeat. I would strongly recommend him. Tests are easy and not a lot of work outside the class.

Tyler is great. Anyone who doesn't think so didn't try. You don't have to work that hard to do well and he curves this course by a few percentage points so you get a nice buffer. If you're a complete moron and you do everything you're supposed to, you'll get a B at the very least.

Tyler is a great teacher. He makes his expectations clear and does everything he can to make sure students succeed in his class. The only teacher I've had willing to host a study session at 7pm AND have 100+ students actually show up!!

Tyler is awesome! He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Offers review sessions before quizzes/midterms that are helpful. He will re-explain examples and terms in class to make sure students understand. Weekly homework assignments aren't bad, and the 2 news summaries are easy points. I hate Econ but enjoy his class.

Tyler is an awesome teacher. I really enjoyed having him for EC 202. It made me enjoy it a lot more. He is very helpful and is always asking if we understand the material. Lots of examples which really help. The class is curved at the end so don't worry. Do the homework, go to class and you will be fine.

Tyler is a really good teacher. He is super nice and very helpful. Even if you don't do great on tests, if you do the homework and the summaries and do good on those, you'll pass the class. He is always well informed and energetic and tries to make it fun for the class, even at 8:30 am.
good teacher, he goes a bit fast at times, if you dont study a bit on your own you will fall behind. With a little work anyone can get at least a B.

He's an okay teacher, but basically reads off slides that come directly from the textbook.  He rushes through things without waiting to make sure the class grasps the concept.  The lectures are mind-numbingly boring, and it's hard to pay attention.
Awesome GTF/newly appointed professor. Very helpful and clear. He really cares about your final grade.

Obviously very excited about his topic, European politics, and very helpful in office hours. Lectures were very engaging and although he relied heavily on his textbooks, he picked good ones that were easy to read and interesting.
His accent is very difficult to understand at times. His lectures are not very engaging.
Prof. Urioste was very articulate and good at communicating complex ideas. He was obviously well learned and gave perfect explanations of definitions and events.
Scary good! Great lecturer, fair grader. Take his class if you can. Just one advice: don't even think about using your cell phone during his lectures, it pisses him off!
His accent is fun but often makes for some communication barriers. Tests hard with no study guide. If you don't mind working hard, he's not a bad teacher to have.

He has a nice accent, but that makes it very difficult to understand his lectures. I relied heavily on my text book to get me through the class. Heavy reading. Taught his 200 level like a 400 level. Not clear about his class expectations for his tests. Avoid, if you can.

I found Sebastian incredibly helpful in my first year returning to Spanish since early high school. There's something very cute about him, and his foreigner's humor is highly amusing. The class is very interactive, he always forces people to participate, and he is never frustrated with the students. There isn't very much homework, which is awesome!
HORRIBLE!!! Very socially awkward and unfair testing. He will snicker at you if you dont understand or ask a question. Went to office hours only to leave wanting to cry. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS.

worse teacher i have ever had in my life.  If you ask him a question he will look at you and start laughing at you.  He is extremely awkward and is always shaking.  Do not take his class or you will fail.
Soooo confusing. When you ask questions, he laughs at you. He is painfully awkward and makes everything 10 times harder than it has to be.

Easily the worst professor i've ever had. Seriously, head and shoulders above the others. Makes fun of you when you ask a question, and confuses you in office hours. He seems to take pleasure in making students feel dumb. I recall a few lectures where the entire class had no idea what was going on.

He goes way to fast for you to even ask questions and when you do ask questions you get looked at like your a total idiot, and then he never really ends up helping you. He gives homework with the pretense that you know material that has not been covered in the class or its prerequisites or the text.

Horrible teacher. States the concept instead of giving examples that would enable one to use the proofs and theorems. I went into his office hours 4 times and came out every time just as confused as i was before. When my friends in other 251 classes were on homework 7, we were on homework 17. A lot of work for little understanding of the class.
worst teacher ever. change out of this guys class NOW!terrible at explaining concepts. do yourself a favor and transfer out

Unlear, not helpful, does not communicate well with his students at all.  Says one thing, does another, contradicts syllabus, and is the most awkward teacher I have ever had.  He is a very intelligent man, but was definitely not made to teach.  He teaches like you already know the material, and that you don't need help.

When asking questions in class, he gets a look on his face like you should know the answer and kind of laughs at you. If I knew everything in this class I wouldn't be taking it. He was also lovely enough to give us an assignment due on sunday at 8am after homecoming. He doesn't explain all the way through. Get a tutor and you will be fine.

To the guy above: he states what he will answer in his email on the first day of class. This guy is pretty cool. He teaches quickly but will talk to you after if you have a quick question. If it isn't that quick he asks you to go to office hours. Its not that difficult to get help.
He sucks.  Never answers emails and never responds to questions.  My dog could have taught me math better than he can.  If you get him transfer or drop the class!!!!!!!
She's the greatest. She's like the mother figure of the architecture department. She actually cares and will go out of her way to help those who ask for it. She puts everything in an optimistic way.
She cares about all of her students! She is like a mother.  She will help you out when you need it.
Her head is in the clouds and she does not always know what she is doing

Glenda takes a deep personal interest in her students. If she hadn't done that for me, I would have quit the Architecture program. They don't call her "Mother Architecture" for nothing. That said, she has a lot going on, is always late, and is a little spacey. I love her anyway.

not super organized but shes really nice. during critique she rips apart models you spent all night working on :/ she is quirky and sometimes has her head in the clouds. it's kind of funny and oddly my studio and i love her. shes lenient with most assignments only b/c she scares us @ the beginning to work extremely hard :) shes like a grandma to us

Glenda is one of the worst teachers I have ever had. She is insincere and condescending, unclear and inarticulate, and a waste of time. I loved drawing before taking her class. She inspired a poem:  This summer I learned Someone had destroyed my love- Now I know art sucks.
No Comments

Glenda is a nice person.  However, it seems that she has some difficulty teaching the beginner.  Additionally she appears to grade subjectively based upon her expectations of the student... if you have some talent she grades harder.
Laura is an incredible professor. She is smart and humble, and always working to see the bigger picture of her student's art practices.

This is my favorite class I've taken at UofO. It forces you to approach drawing in a completely different way, and it is an all-encompassing practice. The assignments were fun, somewhat challenging, and rewarding. It is a mixed class with BFAs and MFAs, which created a fun environment and thoughtful feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Laura is a fantastic professor! She may not be for everyone because her prompts are open-ended and can be confusing. She is very knowledgeable about painting and truly wants to see you succeed. She cares deeply about her students and is willing to meet you where you're at. Her advice is terrific, and my skills have significantly improved.
Didn't learn a single thing in this class. The prompts are awful and the professor is even worse, doesn't know much about how to actually paint.
Something's wrong with this Prof. She pivots between total ambivalence and judgmental power trips on a dime. I honestly don't understand how she still has a job.

I called her out for not saying anything nice about what I drew and she completely denied even though I never was given any sort of praise on what I made. She decides whos art is good based off of what is pleasing to her eye. Thats not how it should be.

This is really sad to say but she ruined art for me. Art is not supposed to be good or bad based on your opinion. Any time I made a piece that I felt was meaningful to me, she would completely tear it apart because she didnt think it looked good. Her version of critique is not highlighting your strong and weak points, its just tearing you down.

She's as sweet as can be. She definitely cares about her students. Her class was at times ridiculous and at times very hard. Her vocabulary will astound you. Sometimes she is not clear about what she wants and I found her class very frustrating.
she is great, very understanding!
Amazing teacher!!! She takes what you know and just helps you explore more ways of thinking about it and ideas around art making. very smart woman.

worst teacher i've ever had. You have to follow her rules of painting and if you offend her status at all she will put you on a hook to show you who's more powerful. If you have a set way of painting and tend to disregard what teachers have to say...DO NOT TAKE CLASS WITH HER!! terrible...ruined my experience.

Laura is AMAZING.  She is helpful, kind, sincere, intelligent and clearly is very experienced in fine arts and is extremely passionate.  She went out of her way to help me when I struggled, as I'm sure she did for others as well.  She even kept in touch over the summer and acted as a pseudo-counselor when I was confused about switching my major.
Fabulous teacher, super smart and very nice.  She has helped greatly with the progression of my work.  I look forward to working with her again.
Very nice teacher, syllabus was very clear and was followed to a T.
Val was great, 3 tests worth 60% of grade but if you know the content her tests are not super hard, I appreciate that the questions on them are not meant to trip you up and are clear.

Val is a sweet heart. She lectures clearly and her tests are straight forward if you put in time to study! Shes very understanding when it comes to midterms and the work you have for other classes. She will decrease her workload during anatomy's exam weeks! Absolutely loved her and she responds quick to emails!

Val was so awesome, genuinely so sweet and is a great professor. Yes, the class is difficult, but she does a great job of having a very organized canvas and clear guidelines for everything. As long as you stay on top of the memorization and show up to lecture, you will be just fine.

MedTerm is not for the faint of heart. Be ready to use Quizlet/Knowt religiously, memorize medical word parts, and for weekly quizzes that will take getting used to. This is not a class to cram for IMO, but go to lectures, hone in your note taking(because she goes insanely fast), and learn to understand the material and not just parrot the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
Val is the most passionate professor/teacher I've had(in my first year). I'm not science savvy, however this was one of two(HPHY211 was taught also by her) lectures which you shouldn't miss. 
This was the first time I've taken any kind of HPHY class, and she is by far and away the best person to get started with. Wait to take her if you can.

Val seems to be constantly out of breath during lecture, I truly worry for her aerobic health. She gets visibly flustered when asked simple questions about the material. She once said "I don't know, I'll have to ask ChatGBT" when asked about a concept. You can't learn when your professor doesn't even know what they're talking about. Respectfully...

I took 211, not 212, but honestly she was my favorite teacher the term I took the class, she was super engaging, she's the sweetest, and made the class super fun. The tests are a little hard because its mostly all memorization, as is the whole class material. If you put the effort in, it will be a really fun and interesting class!!

Dr. Val makes the content of physiology easily digestible and engaging. She is genuinely caring for her students and will work with you in any way you need if you just reach out to her. She is easy to reach, good at communicating, and engaging. She is a very active lecturer; she is not static and engages with the crowd often. And she is very kind!

Val struggles heavily with lecturing. She is constantly pacing around the room and breathing very hard into her mic which is extremely distracting. She does not seem knowledgeable in the course material whatsoever. She consistently has to ask the audience about topics she should know. She fumbles over words the entire lecture terribly.

Val made physiology very digestible and interesting, making it much easier to show up to class ready to learn. You can tell she really cares about her students and tries her best to not overwhelm us. The lectures are content heavy but Val makes sure to take breaks and allows plenty of time for clarification. Would highly recommend!

Val is awesome! She is super funny and is very easy to talk to about class content. She often speaks quickly during her lectures so come to class with your EB completed and a surface level knowledge of the material that will be covered. The course moves through information quickly and a decent amount of memorization is required. Tests are fair.

Dr. Val tries her best to engage students, but the content is boring. Midterms and finals are all random stuff you barely went over in class. Talk to the GEs because they are the most helpful for this course

Horrible teacher. doesn't accommodate for grading and doesn't curve any grades. GE's are alright and tbh taught me more than the actual class. lectures are super dense and 2 hrs long. i wish there was a different professor honestly.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Not accommodating at all even in difficult circumstances. The class is poorly organized and you basically teach yourself. Attendance is mandatory. Assignments are very vague and the GE I had was unresponsive in communication and lackluster feedback was given. I wish there was another professor section of this course.

Studying for the final with the most nonsensical, idiotic, piece of trash review ever created was my last straw. Everything was compiled out of order and some questions don't have answers and the ones that do provide no explanation. You get a 1% increase after interviewing a grad student/participating in a research study as an extra credit option.
Literally the nicest professor I've ever met, always willing to give extra help. Would 100% take another class with her.
Not hard at all, super easy if you actually go to class/do the activities. She is really nice

Yasamin is super helpful and caring; always willing to re-explain or go back to more challenging concepts in class. Sometimes makes errors & asks students for help. Excel file uploads for each class and periodic quizzes/HWs on Canvas. Midterm & final are not terribly difficult; practice test is incredibly helpful and both are open notes.
She explains things well, uploads content weekly, very kind.

Solid online professor. She's engaging and does a good job of explaining the concepts. Online classes are hard to engage with and she does a great job of sending out emails that keep us updated and reminded. Pretty easy class if you like Excel and Statistics. A LOT of review from stats.

Took her online version, didn't learn much but that's on me if you are looking for a fair assessment of this class skip over this review, if you are a bit of a slacker looking for an easy alternative to take, I would highly recommend this class, but you should see if you can take an in-person class because this is important material!

Yasamin was a great professor, super easy to get help on home work and always willing to help. The midterm & final are easy and its open notes. You can get through the class without the textbook. I highly recommend taking her OBA 311 class.

Course was as good as it could be given the material. She is a very light grader and gives many opportunities for grade improvements, while also allowing late work to be turned in. Overall great course and learned a lot. However, I wish some of her lecture videos were condensed into fewer videos.

Vahdati was good! She has lectures every week that explain things well and the course was very well organized. Not a hard class to get an A in as long as you keep up with the assignments, which aren't too bad! Would take again
Took OBA 311 online. Gives great and thorough lectures and responds to emails really quickly. The class is super easy if you have basic excel knowledge. Content is dense but she makes it easy!

Honestly just the perfect online class. The modules are super structured, clear, and organized. She's very good at responding to emails and has plenty of office hours available. There's a decent amount of weekly lecture videos, but it's super doable compared to sitting in a classroom. I would imagine she'd be good in-person as well. Take Yasamin!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took OBA 311. She knows what she is doing, is very clear, and is super sweet. Definitely take from her!
just reads off the slides, not many ways to practice course material, miss 2 questions on a quiz and watch your grade drop by 3 %.

My diva. This is a tough course, especially if you have a separate major/minor. But, I found her to be understanding for those struggling. She's the only prof who's acknowledged that you shouldn't have to pay to do your hw. She does get a little ahead of herself, but she leads really interesting class discussions. She's also funny as hell.

I have taken Claudia for Italian 103, 201, and 202 so far and I keep taking her class because she is the best. Native Italian speaker and while her class is significantly harder compared to some other Italian professors, she's keen on the language and give really good feedback. You will 100% learn the language with Claudia

She's a nice person but honestly doesn't know what she is doing sometimes. You'll get a lot of feedback but it's because the instructions are not clear. Theres a ton of homework and it can be incredibly hard to maintain a good grade if you dont do every assignment.

Claudia is a great professor! She is extremely helpful in explaining stuff and answering questions. There is lots of homework for this class, like all 100 level Italian classes. She is available outside of class, cares about her students, and wants us to succeed. This class is hard, but it is very rewarding!

Claudia is a great person and I love having her as an Italian prof. She assigns a lot of homework so be aware of that however she is very understanding and won't mark you down for late assignments. She is accessible outside of class and does her best to help you understand the language and the content she is teaching.

Claudia is great, she's very kind and cares about her students. The homework load is very heavy, so be prepared to invest lots of time, but that's probably the same with any 201 prof. The tests aren't too challenging, and the content is engaging. I would definitely recommend her for 201.

Claudia is a good teacher, and will help you one on one if you need it. It's a 101, so it's pretty easy if you pay attention in class. There is homework every night but it usually doesn't take long. Just don't fall behind on homework and you'll be fine.
She is sweet as a person, but as a professor she isn't the best at teaching the material. This class is so accelerated I hardly was able to learn anything and the tests were always very challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Claudia is an interesting professor.  She always wears a smile to class, and is eager for her students to learn the material presented.  She does not use a "textbook" in this class, but does provide material on Blackboard.  Her grading criteria are very well explained and she is very fair when grading.

Great teacher! Helpful an always brings a positive energy to class. Lenient when grading tests - she wants students to succeed and is nicer than past Italian teachers I've had with grading. Homework is easy to get a good grade on and the other assignments are not too difficult - especially because she is nice about accepting late work. Take her!

She's a super nice teacher, and she's always smiling.  She creates a very comfortable learning environment. I never thought the work was too hard, but even when a class is difficult, suck it up.  You're in college now, classes are gonna be hard.  She was always very helpful when I needed something clarified and never lost her temper with the class.

Claudia is an amazing teacher! She really helped improved my Italian and give me a confidence boost to practice speaking. I would highly recommend her. Just pay attention in class and you will get a good  grade.
Claudia has great energy in the classroom. She is fun-loving and is always laughing. I've had her for two terms of Italian and wouldn't hesitate to take her class again!
Overall this class is easier than the other italian classes at UO as far as amount of work goes, but she is very unclear and grades quite harshly!
Out of the 3 Ital teachers I've had this year, she is definitely the most tricky. She is nice, but grades really hard. Her handwriting is also difficult to read.

Decent teacher but I noticed he targeted the students who are struggling in the class and would cold call on them and be extrememly passive aggressive if they didn't know the answer to his questions. Overall a good teacher if you can stay up with the class, but if you fall behind prepare to be purposely embarassed in front of the class.

THE BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE HAD IN A WHILE. Genuinely cares about your success and understanding, and will bend the rules if the vast majority wants it. 11/10 would recommend. So fun, tells personal stories but still stays somewhat on track. Sometimes grades a little hard, but is willing to work with you to get back to the right level.

took 202 with Javi- he's super caring and wants his students to learn/succeed. I definitely feel like my Spanish got better after taking his class especially since he makes an effort for us to improve skills like pronunciation!

Javi is one of the best professors I've had at UO by far. I took SPAN202 with him, and he made the class both interesting and engaging. He's very respectful and has a genuine care to see his students succeed.

Javier makes Spanish easy to learn with his conversational and approachable way of thinking. He spends a lot of time making sure students participate and are engaged which really helps when learning a language.
Javi is an incredible professor. He makes learning Spanish very fun, and really cares about his students. I would 100% take his classes again.
Javi was amazing and super helpful! He is kind and likes to joke around with students which makes coming to class fun and easy :)

Javi is great! I love that he's a native Spanish speaker (unlike a lot of the professors at UO apparently) and he's really fun and engaging. there are usually 1-2 decent sized readings per week, so you definitely will have to spend some time deciphering old Spanish literature, but I like how he does not overload students with reading

javi is one of the most caring professors I've ever had. he really cares about his students success and what they have to say, and he only assigns 1-2 readings per week so that you can really dig into the readings. he is a native spanish speaker and speaks slowly enough and enunciates for second language learners to be able to understand

I took SPAN 351 with Professor Velasco. He is one of the most caring and fun professors I have ever had. He is hilarious and brings a fun atmosphere to class. He is also extremely well informed on the subject matter and is always excited to hear the thoughts of students even when they diverge from his own. I highly recommend taking a class with him

By far one of the best professors Ive had. He is not only a great teacher but he makes the class more fun because he uses current events and videos that will not only make you laugh but also learn. If you get a chance to take his class, I would definitely recommend.

Professor Keller emphasises professionalism, and that is clear in her grading and lectures. She is a tough grader, but always clear in her criteria and expectations. She does not sugar coat anything, but she is also supportive and is always available during office hours and will walk you through an assignment if needed.

She genuinely cares about the course and topic, which is awesome. However, her slides are unorganized and fast-paced, and she stopped posting them halfway through the term, making review difficult. Expect to read, with an average of 2 long readings weekly. You can skim, but be prepared. The class is interesting, but be prepared!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Keller was good. She did go through her lecture slides very fast, but I found the class to be entertaining. Each week there is 1-2 readings which are pretty long, but you can get by with skimming through them. Overall, I wouldn't say her class is too hard, but attendance is mandatory and it is a big part of your grade.

TAs were very tough graders for this class, although I loved the lectures and thought Ms. Keller was very knowledgeable and passionate about the class. Very easy to get behind and mess up your grade tho

You're going to think this is a fun and easy class cause its about beer. No. Showing up to class is mando. That's fair enough, but she breezes thru info stupid fast. She eventually stopped posting the lectures on canvas so u cant follow along or look back at class material. This will be a rough class for anyone. Grades so tough

Professor Keller is passionate about this class, and has a lot to say. Her slides aren't very well organized, and a lot of her lectures are hard to follow. She moves too quick to take good notes. When it comes time for the midterm or final, she doesn't provide nearly enough review material and I always felt lost. Nobody I know got an A.

She obviously cares very much about the topic that she's teaching, however she goes through the slides very quickly and her "reviews" don't do anything to help. Honestly, the class isn't very hard if you pay attention and take notes but I wouldn't rely on her to help you in any way to review, the tests do pull questions from previous quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lots of online Hw other than that, attendance is a big part of your grade, so pretty much just show up and you'll pass. Class in itself is kind of a snooze fest but shes nice and approachable and responds to emails fairly fast
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Worst Professor i have had yet. Everyone in my class barely passed, she would go through the slideshow so fast that by the time you even read it, she was on the next slide. She gave NO time to take notes and genuinely made me want to die every time I went to her class. If you dont have to take her class then DONT.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is a good professor and obviously cares about what she is teaching, but she is terrible at student communication. Several times I have emailed her about very important questions and never received a response. If this is something that stresses you out, I wouldn't recommend taking Professor Keller.
Very clearly knows a lot about the topic, however she does tend to talk a little quickly and switch slides fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is her first time teaching this course so it will change overtime so take this review with a grain of salt, but with that being said she is a stream of consciousness lecturer. This class was super participation heavy and had a lot of group work/discussions. It can difficult to know what to take notes on. No exams but a big project at the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The lectures were somewhat boring and didn't feel totally fleshed out or prepared. She is very nice and helpful if you have questions but the assignments aren't very interesting and the class felt very casual.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I have never had a prof. try to make my life so difficult. She was unwilling to work with me, seemed annoyed that I had accommodations, and would tell me one thing and the class another. She also sent very passive-aggressive emails when I would try to come up with a solution (she was mad I was missing 1 class).
Professor Keller made the class easier than it already is. She helped all of us in the class get everything that she covered, and made sure we understand it.

Vera is great! She provides great feedback and even learned everyones name in class. This class was the History of Beer, and she did a great job of making the content enjoyable. Weekly participation, readings and quizzes are the main components of your grade, also a midterm and final. Overall really enjoyed Vera and this unique course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was super engaging. Included trips to special collections to look at manuscripts and primary sources. Prof. K is very knowledgeable about the subject and encourages engaging discussions during class. One of the best history courses I've ever taken.
She's super opinionated and rigid - it's basically her way or the highway.

Prof. Keller is so intelligent and fascinating. The topics of her classes aren't always immediately engaging, but she is able to make the material fascinating. Class discussions are lively, and thought-provoking. Hard work load, but  it's all relevant to class and papers. Papers and presentations, graded honestly and fairly. Highly recommended.

Prof. Keller is an excellent teacher,before taking her class I honestly didn't care about history at all, but she's passionate about her topics and makes the class interesting. After I got the grade on one of my first papers, I went to her office and  she talked to me about it and was very helpful, then let me try again. I recommend her courses.

Very smart lady, and does not tolerate bs. That being said, you will learn a lot in this class--maybe not a lot about history itself, but lots of valuable info regarding primary sources and how to write a decent paper with historical analysis. Class time is kind of boring, but the workload is manageable.

She is a completely unfair grader. She tells you that you are not allowed to use any sources besides the ones given in class, and then grades you down for not knowing historical information that was not taught in class. She is not open to new interpretations and thinks that her understanding is the only possible one.

She is horrible at facilitating discussions (when she has the class lead the discussion it goes much more smoothly). The class is solely based on reading assignments that you do outside of class and then re-read aloud during the class. Super boring.
Good professor. Knows how to facilitate discussion. Take her class.
If you are feeling nervous about Spanish, she is a good choice! She takes the time to make sure her students truly understand the material

The classes and the content were interesting. The assignments were a bit difficult, but the professor was very flexible with the grading, given that not everyone in the class had enough experience for this type of course. She was very understanding and approachable.
I liked the class and the professor. It is organized by week, which makes it very easy to follow. I was able to learn and correct my mistakes, as well as understand what I did well.

Professor Vidal is very supportive and truly wants her students to succeed. She cares about their learning and commitment is evident in the way she teaches.She is always willing to sit down with students and help them through any difficulties they me be experiencing.
I love this class. Professor Alejandra Vidal is very kid and flexible. Learning Spanish is hard but she puts you at ease. I will definitely take another class with her.

Extreme lack of tactfulness when giving feedback and will act disappointed if you struggle with course content. She will randomly call on students every class which in its self is not the issue, rather her demeanor and cadence when you answer incorrectly is like speaking to a disappointed parent. Would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Did not give clear instructions on anything. No lesson plans. Always had students guessing. Never on time with exams.

She will cold call you so participate in the in-class exercises in case you have to say the answer on the spot. I found it a really easy class but I understand it might not be that way for everyone. She is not organized or good at giving clear instructions for assignments or explanations of concepts.

She does not teach at all. She will just take chunks from the textbook and fill in the blank rather than actually teach. It seems to be that her activities for no class days are AI, as it looks like they are directly copy and pasted. Work load isn't bad, but to learn and fully understand that material you have teach yourself outside of class.

Okay professor. Homework to lecture to reading ratio is way off though. Very vague lectures, so you'll have to comb through the textbook to understand. Also vague and subjective grading criteria making it hard to know what she wants from the homework. The exams are fairly easy if you really know the material well.

She genuinely does not teach anything. Instruction comes from the textbook and short written documents on canvas. There is way to much work for what the class is, and it is extremely frusturating because, again, she does not teach at all. Avoid this class at all costs. I only took it because it is required for my major.

Took her SPAN102 class. Spoke only in spanish with almost no english clarification, even with new grammar topics. Very harsh grader. Inaccessible office hours and often cancels them with no reschedules right before tests. I did not feel supported in her class and I feel lucky to be passing. Made learning the language not fun or exciting.

This lady makes my blood boil. She is so passive aggressive and rude. Spoke entirely in Spanish to a beginner class and explained work instructions in Spanish only. Wouldn't elaborate or explain in english. Favored male students and let them do whatever they wanted.

Angélica is a lovely teacher who understands the difficulties of learning a second language; she is very patient and amenable while also pushing students to try their best. She is great at connecting with students in order to make a safe learning environment for everyone.

Extra credit for going to the sales club. The overall class and projects are really easy but he warns you in the beginning of the term that the reason people will not get an A+ is because his tests are tough. Highest test grade was an 84. You can still get an A- if you study for the tests and try on the projects. Overall really good teacher.

It was an online class based mostly on group work which didn't make sense to me. He has had some assignments with very clear errors and seemed to not actually look at any work when grading, it seemed like every group got a B on every assignment.

Don't Do it! His lectures are not organized the book didn't alien with what we was saying. His studies guides don't make sense (had things on it that we didn't even go over in lecture or have in his book) Not accessible out of class (didn't post office or office hours). Not clear with what he was teaching or what was needed for participation grade.

This professor gives so much unnecessary busy work and is an extremely overwhelming amount of work to do for an online class. His canvas site is very unclear and his expectations are very high for all assignments. There are so many group projects and they are very long. I would not recommend taking this course with this professor. SO MUCH WORK

The class was unorganized for sure, but not unreasonable. Lots of homework writing and lots of group projects, which is very annoying, defiantly try to communicate well and split up the homework, not everyone needs to do each one. Tests aren't too bad, but they aren't simple term questions, more like everyday word problems which made studyin tricky
i love this class and instructor is amazing and awesome!!!!!!!!I really like him!!!!!
This was the most unorganized class I have ever taken. Lectures were interesting, but not always productive.
Frank is hilarious! This was the only marketing class I actually enjoyed. Not the most structured class, but pretty easy and the material was interesting.

This is the most unorganized class I have ever taken. There were numerous typos and grammatical errors in his announcements, as well as multiple errors regarding the due dates and instructions for assignments. The only upside was that this class was insanely easy, and reading the lecture slides wasn't even necessary to pass the exams.

He sucks. He has no real grading rubric, grades on what he feels. His lectures often stray from the slides and is more of a conversation. I never have taken notes, because there's nothing to take notes on and I teach myself everything from the book before the tests. His study guides are unhelpful, he gives VERY UNCLEAR instructions and often change
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Never felt the need to rate one of my professors before Frank. He's a cool guy but should stick to coaching - tough but true. I did not learn a single thing as he talked more about bargaining at garage sales and sports - neither of which are Marketing. I've dealt with disorganized instructors but Frank is on another level & forget about emailing.

I have to honestly say that Frank Veltri is the least favorite professor I've had up until this point. Veltri is disorganized  and inconsistent, which is very rough to deal with. Assignments are unintentionally vague with very little to no in-class discussion. I could deal with these problems a little more if he wasn't so pompous and unapologetic.

Funny person and makes class some what interesting. Seemed like we didn't really learn that much the whole year, just learned about products. He is very unorganized though which makes it hard to keep up with. If his organization was better he would be a great teacher. Tests are relatively easy.

Frank is a really good guy. He is somebody you would love talking to at a bar. He is funny and keeps class interesting. However, he sometimes is unorganized in his expectations and instructions. He is always willing to help though, even on exams. He would basically steer you to the right answer if I ever had a question.

Frank is a dope teacher, he has long lectures but they are funny and he plays great Youtube videos in class. Knows his stuff well and doesnt ask much for midterms. If you do your homework and cooperate with your group you will do well.

The class is so disorganized and many people in the class was confused about how to do assignments. He'd assign homework that made little sense and he wouldn't explain how to do it. You are also in groups the whole term and you depend on them for most of the work. He's kind of funny but the class was confusing because of the way he organized it.
Frank Veltri is one of those guys in high school who walks down the hallways giving everyone an obnoxious shout out.

Veltri is the least organized, descriptive, and prepared people I have ever met. He is a funny guy whose class is easy to pass, but I learned nothing from him and was frustrated every single class with his lack of preparedness. He essentially made every assignment and class slide up on the fly and clearly had no idea what he was talking about.
Veltri is the chillest teacher here, though hes not very challenging. If you want a good grade, take his classes. He is also a cool professor with a lot of funny stories.

Really easy teacher. You won't have any homework other than the really easy group project and the tests are a joke. He says at the beginning of the term that if he knows you and likes you he will bump your grades up. Take him if at all possible!

Take him if you can. He keeps classes interesting and has a great personality. He also develops relationships with students and he makes it possible to get an A if you attend class and have a good group for presentation.
awesome professor-great personality and actually enjoyed going to class. attendance is mandatory. tests are easy but very oddly structured. fairly easy grader

Take MKTG with either him or Dore. Dr. V. is the MAN! Easy class, just have to go, one group project which is fun. Best teacher I've had at LCB so far. Funny, and unlike other teachers doesn't talk down to students because he is a doctor. TAKE THIS CLASS. Minimal effort and a B is easy.

DR.V is the man!! Fall 2013 was his first term at the UofO and his firm term teaching on a quarter system. I took his 8am class and he was able to keep the class awake and engaged. I definitely recommended taking his class. Tests and group assignments are fairly easy. TAKE HIS CLASS.

Fall 2013 was Dr. V's first term with the UO term system, which hopefully accounts for his lack of organization. His test questions are sometimes poorly phrased (ambiguous, outdated references, typos, etc), and he is not good at returning work back quickly at all. Other than that, he is a great teacher and a fair grader. MUST ATTEND CLASSES!

Felt like I was getting picked on the whole term and she definitely had her favorite students and sat them together. she is fluent in four other languages and expects you pick it up very fast. class is very fast paced, and you will get left behind.

Puts a lot of effort into students learning and cares a lot for their progress. Leaves very in-depth, motivational, and accurate feedback on assignments. Expects students to engage and be active learners.
Profe Hara is very engaging and honest with her students. She does not allow phones in the classroom and will yell at you for having one, but other then that she's a very solid professor.

I registered late and she was the only teacher with a spot left. I was really nervous considering the reviews on her. She is honestly one of the best teachers I have ever had. She has the perfect balance of seriousness&gentleness&cares for her students deeply; if you need any help she will always be there for you, but you must put in work too.

I love Profe Hara, she is so kind and an amazing instructor. The first test may be graded roughly, but improvement and clear grading structure follows which allows for you to improve your grade and spanish significantly.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Profe Hara is incredible! She truly cares so deeply about her students and puts so much love into what she does. PLEASE take her class because your Spanish will get so strong and being in her class is extremely beneficial!
Scarily difficult and stressed everyone out
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She expects a lot from her students but she is also very caring and will help you no matter what you are going through. ok

I

If you have never taken a linguistics class, I definitely don't recommend taking his course. He is a very knowledgeable professor, but I am very unfamiliar with the topics, so I am suffering. Don't miss lectures and go to office hours. He is helpful.
He made an extremely abstract class seem so easy. I recommend any class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

This is the best professor I've had in the math department. He does have a small accent, but after about a week you get use to it. Professor Vologodsky is a great guy. The subject matter that he teaches, however, is very difficult. He specialized in theoretical mathematics and number theory. SO MUCH READING. Journal posts due for every class, where you have to read 2 or 3 readings.  It's a little excessive.  The lectures are very based on comics and graphic novels, and sometimes it seems like the lectures don't really relate.  She's super nice, though.

Julie's great, so was this class there was a lot more work than I expected for an AAD class. Julie means well but her class is incredibly boring. If you enjoy being treated like you're in elementary school again, this is the class for you! Not helpful, do not recommend her.
Did not inform on how she was grading at all, then grades very hard. Class not interesting or fun. I would not suggest taking it with her.
My favorite teacher I've had at UO. She knows her stuff, teaches valuable material, and makes it interesting and fun. She is extremely helpful, and very understanding. I love this teacher.
Very easy online class, take it if you can with her.

she is the worst teacher i have every had. she doesn't even read your assignments. a guy in my class turned in two of the same assignments and got two different grades clearly she doesn't even read them. she is really mean and makes you feel really stupid. she gave me an A on my first draft then I made my edits and she gave me a B. horrible teacher
If you love writing pointless responses and being scared to talk in class, take writing 122!!!

Not open to opinions. Even though it is a discussion based class, only her answer is right. She talks down to students. She is rude and condescending. Makes you feel stupid. Wish there had been low ratings on here before I signed up for this class. Whoever gave her good ratings clearly likes being able not to express their own ideas. This teacher only thinks her opinion is correct. I enjoy writing, and get good grades but do not enjoy her teaching at all.
Very negative teacher and hard grader. Very focused on her own opinion instead of being open to other's

The only opinion that's considered right is her own. In class discussions where others argue their thoughts are immediately directed back to her initial opinion. Here's a helpful hint. Refer to the text and you're golden. The Professor was helpful when it came to one on one time during her office hours as well. Also, take notes during her class because her opinion towards the text should be applied to ones essays as well.
Made the material accessible, and provided fantastic discussion in class. Highly recommend.
Annie was a great instructor. She was always willing to help me outside her office hours. She knew how to explain the material. Her exams were relatively difficult, you had to study.
Annie was very unclear in her lectures and commonly displayed signs of frustration.
Great teacher

Anne is a wonderful teacher.  The kids in her class who had it rough were the kids who never came to class.  She was always willing to schedule extra OH for me when my schedule didn't mesh with hers.  I would definitely take another class with her as the professor.

Annie is a great GTF for EC 421. She will be teaching this class in Spring 2006. She is very easy when it comes to grading. She gives ALOT of partial credit and she is very considerate in grading homeworks and exams. Shes terrific!If I knew she was teaching EC 421, I would of waited and took the course with her! :)

This was by far my favorite class. Prof. Hannah is so smart, always gave constructive comments and made me fall in love with sociology. She also really cares! Hope to take more classes with her for sure.

Lotsss of reading and you discuss in groups what you think and turn in for attendance (allowed to miss 4). You have 2 in class essays, 1 midterm, and a final. reviews.comment: She is not a good professor at all. You will have to teach yourself the course content. I will not be taking any classes instructed by her.

Dr. Weissler was an absolutely amazing teacher! Her policies allow you to extend any assignment as long as it's before the due date. You're encouraged to ask questions and it's ok to be wrong about things. Thorough feedback. She was also very kind and cares a lot about her students. 

Great professor, lenient policies, and a very insightful class!!
In this course we were graded based off of very few but large assignments. I really enjoyed the content in this class and I think Dr. Weisseler did a great job.

I love professor Weissler! I took her LING 201 course Language and Power and it was amazing. She's super caring and expects participation in the class. Most brutal class of all time I learned genuinely nothing

Not tech saavy, partisan philosophy, unclear direction for class, vague assignment criteria and feedback, will ignore emails, changes due dates then docks points, needs to retire.

I really enjoyed this class, and I felt like I was able to take a lot away from each lecture and all the readings. Worst class I have ever taken, content is so boring. Exams aren't bad though because you get the questions ahead of time.
Do not take this class. Sarah Wald is a intelligent lady but the content of the course is horrible.

Dr. Wald was great for Nature in Pop Culture! The content was super engaging & I think she has the class figured out pretty well. Would absolutely take a class by her again & cannot recommend this class enough! There was a lot of expected reading, but otherwise, the class wasn't too bad.

Wald is great. Knowledgeable and cares about her students. We had a midterm and final that were both 4 short essay questions, a one page essay, and weekly reading posts. alright teacher. talks fast and is kinda not really accessible for virtual classes which is odd since it makes things so much more convenient for everyone. grading structure sucks in the class if you dont do well on the tests/comprehension tasks. rubric can be very vague and makes you feel dumb if you ask simple questions

Wants students to be super formal with her. always address by professor or doctor. assignments are somewhat easy but you kinda have to do a deep analysis about it, which the rubric is not clear about. they grade you but dont discuss into depth about the grading for comprehension tasks so beware if you take this class. you cant just do board ideas

Professor Wald is great. Her class is super interesting and eye-opening. She is a caring, intelligent, and supportive professor. The assignments and tests aren't too hard if you show up to class and take notes. You can tell Sarah really wants everyone to succeed in her class.
I think Sarah is a great teacher. Shes kind, caring, and flexible. Lots of discussions and you have to keep up with the readings, but if you do you'll get a good grade.

reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Sarah is a true gem, she is very passionate and well informed. Her lectures are very eye-opening and engaging. Lecture slides are posted online, documentaries are interesting and the class garden trip was so much fun.

Professor Wald is very thorough during her lectures. She is passionate about the subject and always tries to make sure her students understand the material. The grading criteria can be a bit vague sometimes but it helps to get clarification whenever you need it for homework assignments. There is a lot of reading and writing involved.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Wald did a great job explaining new concepts and helping us make connections among them. She was very receptive to feedback and you could tell she put a lot of effort into teaching the class. I left the class with so much new knowledge and a shifted perspective on environmentalism. Sarah is tough but she's fair. You receive participation points for attendance. She chooses readings that are interesting and relevant. There's a lot of competition for her attention so if you need to contact her make an appointment.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Look, if you do the readings, and pay attention in class, this shouldn't be a difficult course. The deadlines are brought to your attention WAY far in advance. Her grading guidelines were a bit vague at times but she was always prompt in responding to any kind of discrepancy.
Assignments were incredibly vague and graded arbitrarily.

Horrible communication on learning objectives and how material ties into them.  Skip this class if at all possible, take something else for group 1 requirement.
