Weird class. Linguistic textbook is written by a lawyer. Confusing material. Not even remotely related to any other linguistics texts I have ever read in the past (I've read more than a few). Nice person, but gives crazy amounts of useless homework; it's not related to the tests so hours(!) doing required homework was a huge waste of time. Avoid!

This class is a lot of memorization. If you want to spend your time memorizing different languages families and sub families within those language family..this is a class for you, if not...i highly recommend not taking this class. There is two papers, two mid term plus final. highly against this class. A LOT OF MEMORIZING. B careful of SAFEASSIGN
Make sure you google "cognitive linguistics" before you come here.

what a confusing person. i could never tell what she wanted from us. memories of her class: sitting in a dark dark room trying to stay awake, and then stressing out at home trying not to cry. but, fine fine she is pretty hot. thus 1 chili 4 u ^__^
No Comments

Jarrod is a great professor! He is super personable and caring and really wants to support your learning. Lectures can be a little dense, but the content is mostly review from CDS 455/Ling 150. The tests and assignments are fairly easy but sometimes graded a little harshly. Overall a great class/prof!

Jarrod is such a great instructor, he genuinely wants everyone to succeed in his courses. The only thing (not necessarily bad) is his lecture slides are just like cliff notes, he expands a lot in class. So its not one of those classes you can just review slides only and fully understand everything
Lowkey rude sometimes
Jarrod is the most caring professor I have had at UO so far. He cares about his students and our education and it shows through his teaching!
Jarrod is super caring and a great professor! I would 100% recommend taking a class with him.

By far the worst math class I've ever taken. Max is a kind guy but he used a chalkboard and did a terrible job of explaining the content. Even though I took AP Calc in high school, I had to bring my notes and reread them just to half understand what he was saying. Tests are worth like 80% of the grade. DO NOT take this class it will tank your GPA.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Max is a nice guy, he actually cares about his students succeeding, and he's really smart. But his class structure sucks. His lectures are hard to follow, and there's over 30 questions of homework weekly. He also never specified the curve. Use the study guides before tests, and go to his office hours, he's a lot more helpful one-on-one.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a person Max is a cool guy very smart, too smart to be teaching calculus. His lectures never make any sense, you are better off not going to class. He probably assumes everyone knows as much as him and skips over content. The webworks are insanely time consuming taking 8+hours weekly. The exams have an average score of 50%.

Max seems like a nice guy but this class sucked. The hw is 30ish webwork problems a week, I could do none of them myself and had to go to the library for math help and spend 8+ hours to barely finish. He writes on a chalkboard board, no slides on canvas, and the book is unhelpful. midterm averages were below 50% both times. DONT TAKE THIS CLASS.

Max Zimet is not a good teacher. He seems like a nice guy, so it sucks that this is my opinion of him as a teacher, but it is true. He moves fast across the entire chalk board, hardly explaining as he goes. His homework sets border on impossible to complete without cheating, taking 10 hours per week with 30-34 WebWork questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Max is smart and nice but fails at teaching struggling students. When asked about grade curves (midterm means were below 50%) he said "It's whatever the math department says". All HW wasn't graded until the end of the term, which left struggling students unsure if they're passing. I don't recommend taking his class if math isn't your strong suit.

Max's class was easier for me considering I came from a competitive HS area, he needs to improve on communicating math concepts in an easier way, i remember students just oggling at him in confusion when he was trying to explain a simple concept. He is very sweet tho, study guides are given before midterms, exact problems with switched out numbers
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Max is a brilliant dude but doesn't understand teaching very well (yet). He drones on about examples and concepts in lectures oftentimes, but he'll also be very responsive to students' needs when asked, i.e. solving examples of HW questions 1-on-1 help during some lectures instead of adding more material. He doesn't give details of the curve ever.

Max is a legitimate genius. Dude is a quantum physicist and punching well below his weight in this class. It's obvious that he cares and is trying his best to explain the coursework, but he can't communicate it in a way that's super simple. Class averages are super low and the curve is undefined, so the class can be very frustrating.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a super lovely person, but is a new and young teacher. It's evident he's still learning how to explain concepts to students, as he tends to overcomplicate things. (It's obvious he's trying his best, and will always try to answer questions). Class is hard, and curves aren't defined until the end of term. Max is great though

Very sweet, caring, and wants students to succeed. Posts helpful midterm guides. However, lectures and examples are overcomplicated, and aren't helpful at all in learning material. Was forced to learn all concepts through outside resources. Class avg. is consistently below 50% on midterms. Homework is difficult.

Great guy, not the best teacher.

I think about this class daily. Professor was really nice, funny and caring but assignments and course packet of primary sources was tough! He wanted us to develop skills useful in life/other classes through the class, specifically with asking specific questions and being precise in our writing. Tough but overall good class!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class is confusing from an organizational standpoint. Online lectures are required for the homework, but in-person attendance is also mandatory. The in-person lectures are for answering questions from the online lectures, but it's usually just repeating the online material. GE does the grading and is a tough grader, and feedback is not good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Zahler is a charismatic old-school dude who makes you feel like you're listening to a teacher in a 19th-century British boarding school. His travels of the world and his life experience make him an extremely lucid and down-to-earth thinker. You will not debate him or say literally anything that he does not lead you directly to in class.

Biggest mistake of my life was taking this course thinking it would be an easy A. Zahler assigns way too much work for this 100 level course with readings, quizzes, lecture videos, and essays, all on top of coming to the acutal class where it's just an open discussion. He is quite condescending, and GE's are the toughest graders and inconsistent.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I genuinely don't understand what is wrong with this guy. You can tell he cares about teaching and his students but he grades way to hard. And for some reason the final is 3 in class essays? I don't think I signed up for a english class. Your entire grade is just  essays

If you're already taking a difficult course load or have lots of other commitments, you'll not survive this class. There's tons of busy work, but it's worthwhile as he is one of the most engaging lecturers, who treats classes like an open discussion. He really challenges your understanding of the material. You'll get out what you put into it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Way too much work. I've taken multiple 400 and 500-level history classes that have half as much work. Have to spend 4-5 hours on lectures and readings, not to mention that the class time is just discussion. He expects you to do all of the work outside of class. Should be fired.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
If you're employed or in any other extra-curriculars, do not take this class.
So far, this class has had the largest workload out of any class that I have taken.12-16 hours per week of work outside of the class. Reading and pre-recorded lectures, days in class are pointless if all of the material is outside of class. Not fulfilling or worthwhile.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Such a frustrating professor. Thinks that students should do all of their learning outside of class, which would be fine if attendance weren't mandatory, yet it is. Also why would I pay you to be a professor if I am meant to watch all lectures on my own time? Similarly, there is SO MUCH ridiculous homework assigned. Dropped this class.

Professor Zahler assigned so much homework which is all weighted pretty high. Do it all to the best of your ability and you will be fine. You don't need to read the textbook but I would suggest buying it for the online quizzes. Overall I liked this class and learned a lot because of all the homework. He's very funny and a nice guy.

This is my third time having Zahler as a professor and like many of the reviews I wasn't the biggest fan at first either but over time he did grow on me. His method of teaching at first seems weird and a lot more work for students however out of all my classes I have retained the most information from his. He is super understanding and helpful.

I found it very difficult to engage in the class.The structure of the class was anywhere between 2-5 lectures per week and 1-8 readings on top of those lectures.There are two main essays but they are small and short but graded very tough.The class felt backwards as most of the learning was done outside of class and in person lectures felt useless.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I had a love hate relationship with Zahler, though he assigns a lot of homework and runs a strict class, no phones,laptops etc. he started to grow on me towards the end because he was a very interesting guy. Overall he grades the major assignments very harshly. As long as you make sure to do all of the little assignments u should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Honestly had a love hate

reviews.comment: This class has a lot of reading and the textbooks are expensive. Prof Zahler knows his stuff very well but I feel he could be more humble when explaining information. He tends to talk a lot during his recorded lectures on Canvas, and most of the time the questions on the quiz are from the bullet points, but not always! Overall interesting class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Zahler is a very entertaining lecturer and makes class interesting. Not super strict with grading, but there are lots of notes to take and lectures to watch. Weekly quizzes are pretty easy and straight forward.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Overall I learned a lot during this course. However I spent over $100 on textbooks for this class and he has a pretty strict no computers or phones in class policy. He does explain material really well. Sometimes the in class lectures feel pointless and repetitive since we do all the work outside of class.There are clear expectations from the start
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Canvas is poorly ran. In class discussions are repetitive and boring. Constantly asks for clarification on answers from students that are already clear. Essay assignments are unnecessary and don't cause you to think deeper about the topics. Having to turn in notes for the online lectures is comical. You don't have to go to class even once to pass.

Awful awful professor. Expects students to do 9+ HOURS OF WORK OUTSIDE THE CLASSROOM ON TOP OF LECTURES. Disrespectful and talks down to students who answer questions incorrectly. Does not know how to use canvas or email either. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This professor had told us he expects us to spend 9 hours of work in his class alone OUTSIDE of going to class. I had to spend hours on his homework and I feel like I have learned nothing. I would absolutely tell friends to not take this class just because it is absolutely ridiculous. Definitely not worth the credits take something else .
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Taking this class is a huge mistake professor doesn't respond to anything and the canvas is terribly ran and everything is him trying to put stress or pressure on students. no assignment in this class is for learning at all it is all to see how much you listen to every word he say's and how small of things he can pluck out to quiz you on.

Get ready to spend hours outside of class completing his unnecessary homework assignments. Although attendance isn't mandatory, he does go over quite a bit of material that you wouldn't gain from the lecture videos. In class, he is direct and often degrades students who answer questions incorrectly.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Although a lot of other students on here have said otherwise, I genuinely had a great time in his class. Although, it was lecture heavy, and we would have to do a good portion of our homework by turning in notes for the lecture. The grading was never really clear when it came to the notes, but I honestly blame the GE's critiques for being vague

Terrible professor, talks about the same thing in lecture as online but you have to do both, watch his three weekly online lecture hours, take notes, summarize notes, and turn them in plus other assignments. Way too harsh a grader. Easily the worst professor I've had so far

Zahler expects you to do your best in everything. To his credit, he will help you achieve your best (or at least improve) if you ask. His lectures are interactive and beneficial to understanding the historical concepts. Stay ahead of the reading, go to class prepared, and be explicit. Good educator if you don't take his comments too personally.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Zahler is absolutely insufferable. I have loved almost every professor I have had at this school but I absolutely cannot stand him. He is incredibly condescending and talks down to students in a way that can only be described as patronizing. He walks around class with his mask off and does not respect the 6 feet apart guidelines. Drop immediately
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Zahler is not helpful and when you listen to what he has to say but he's very specific if you want to speak up in class. If you try and answer a question he asks "why" to your answer repeatedly. One of the GE's was helpful and one was not. He didn't show up to class and always had his camera off and was the toughest grader for a 100 level class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Zahler is a nice guy. However, the GEs are some bums. The kids in a history class are exactly what you would expect. Some try hard know it alls who are lame. Lots of reading so if you cant focus don't take this class g. Def not a lot of chillas or sippas in this class. no babes either.

reviews.comment: Professor Zahler absolutely sucks, and thats putting it lightly. Its a super challenging class and he didnt explain anything that was in the readings, plus this was an entry level class. Skip him like your life depends on it because your grades do.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: By far the WORST professor I have ever had. Zahler assigns an absurd amount of reading and long response hw assignments. He's an extremely touch grader and overall just rude. Do not take a class with him unless you absolutely must.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: First of all, this is a 100 level class and it is one of the hardest classes I've had. The work load for this class is ABSURD. Hundreds of pages of reading and MULTIPLE papers for a 100 level history class. Professor Zahler is also a bit rude and would single people out during lecture and make borderline inappropriate comments and examples each day
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: TOUGH GRADER. He stated in class he rarely gives out As. Do the reading or die, reading quizzes have more weight than the final. Very knowledgeable, but tbh the reading never correlated much with what he discusses in class. I needed a double espresso shot to get through this class daily. Steer clear if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Zahler is profound in breaking through the bias of our understanding of the present, a unique opportunity to view things from the perspective of the past. This class may challenge you at times, but by the end you will understand the reasoning behind the format of the class. Perhaps the only class after 4 years I would repeat voluntarily.

The whole class is basically, reading, essays and quizzes, and then based off one paper. However he prepares he very well for the paper. It was very helpful for writing papers in the future. However, the GTFs are tough graders. Definetly not an easy A
great teacher, very passionate, little pompous, but hey, it equals out...

After fours years at UO, Zhaler is the worst professor I've had. The lectures are tedious, the reading is immense, and he is unbelievably rude. I absolutely hated this course and I would not take another one of his classes again. It is miserable going to lecture and he will consistently treat you poorly. Advice: do the reading or avoid the course.

He is extremely pretentious and rude. He knows his stuff, but I hate going to his class. He will shoot down any ideas that differ from his own. I've never rated a professor before, but I felt compelled since I'm a history major and really dislike his personality and the way he teaches.

Good professor, very intelligent, and personally one of my favorites. I recommend you think and articulate your question before asking, he will call you out if you do not. Also, avoid they if you can.

Reuben is a hottie for a professor! He's very funny and keeps the class entertaining. He really knows his stuff. Be sure to think before asking a question, he will call you out if you use the word "they" w/o specifiying. My GTF sucked but Reuben was great.
Very unprofessional.  You won't really learn anything about history, he just acts like he's there to entertain.  Then he acts like he's too smart for your questions.

Great and funny professor. Learned a ton in this class. He assigns a blackboard question every week related to the readings out of the textbooks. This class is ALL writing and papers. Not an easy A class.

I hate history but he is really energetic and gets people involved. He uses great examples and for someone who can't stand history he made the class bearable.  He tests on lecture though so you can't skip class and just study the slides. Make sure you do the reading sometimes and always go to class and your golden

GREAT teacher. funny, entertaining, and very clear. Takes thousands of years of history and condenses it into an easy to understand format. The only reason my grade was lower was because of the gtf's being power hungry, other than that, it was a great class and Zahler is an excellent professor. I would take any of his courses!
I'm a history major and I'm just trying to get a c, DON'T TAKE THIS COURSE!!!
Extremely hard grader but an excellent professor. Do not expect an A for average work, only seriously above and beyond effort is given A's.

Prof. Zahler has improved my paper writing and critical thinking more than any other teacher. He's brilliant, seems to know essentially everything about his subjects, and is very helpful in office hours. Take your paper ideas to him! He'll tear your arguments down, but helps you rebuild. Plus, he's a nice guy who cares that you learn something.

Funny teacher, knows a lot. I was always interested in class. It was hard not to pay attention. He teaches very well. Unfortunately GTFs grade the work/exams. I prefer if he did but he helps a lot in office hours and is a really nice guy.

Good class, clear powerpoints, and interesting subject matter. Professor Zahler takes somewhat uninteresting topics (i.e. serfdom), and gives them life. I enjoyed his teaching style, and he's pretty funny too.
a valuable source of knowledge

Great professor. Clearly passionate and knowledgeable. If you go to office hours, he's very helpful. Absolutely loved his class! Lots of reading, but very worth it. Discussions are always interesting and informative. Very highly recommended.

Good professor, good class. Gives pretty helpful comments on paper and very nice in office hour. He's also a pretty good lecturer as well. My only complaint is that I wanted to read more primary sources (which I think are interesting) and less secondary sources (which I think are boring).
Zahler is one of the best professors I have ever had.  I truly value the information I learned from him.  A tough class, but fair, and very worthwhile.
Zahler is the best teacher I've ever had in my life.  He changed the way I thought about the world. It is absolutely worth the hard work!!

Very strict grader on essays. You should definitely start working in advance, and go to office hours early- because after he destroys your ideas you WILL want to check back in. And maybe again after that. But the academic blood he spills must be for a greater good? Quizzes aren't so bad and discussion is usually interesting.

After a year of Zahler for history I have become a completely different student. He is constantly available for help so his high requirements also come with all the help you need to meet them. The readings are interesting, the class is straightforward and organized into ideologies which makes the subject much more approachable and applicable. Alway

He's a good teacher, don't get me wrong. But he's condescending and pretty hard to talk to.  He pretty much ignored me when I saw him outside of class. He was pretty tough and didn't really give high grades. Take him IF you want a challenge.

He says some pretty funny stuff and uses interesting examples. A very hard grader - also not too helpful in office hours. I know people who loved his class, but his teaching style just didn't mesh with me. He uses powerpoints and lectures.. not too much of an emphasis on discussion - it's more of him saying what he thinks and the students listen.

I'll hand it to you Zhaler, you're a smart guy.  But, the only reason why people say you are "intimidating" is because you are a self-righteous asswhole.  If you want a cockey professor, who knows a fair amount about history, take Zahler.  But, understand that he's a super-insecure dude, and he'll lash out at students to hide his insecurities.

He is maybe a little too smart for his own good and leaves very intimidating comments on papers, but gives grades higher than you would expect for how harsh his comments are. He is nice and funny, just a little intimidating sometimes. I liked his class though.

One word: Amazing. Zahler cares about your success in his class, and in your development as a student. My only advice; have your head clear when you speak to him, in office or in class - make SURE you have done the reading before speaking in class. He will see through you, and he will not like it.

Professor Zahler is one of the best professors in the Honors college. He is engaging, great about being available in office hours, extremely helpful and concerned with your understanding. i enjoyed his class but the reading are intensive and the class difficult. He expects top notch effort and will dock  essays if you do not challenge yourself.
Zahler has this look, like… I am incredibly knowledgeable about all types of history as well as extremely good looking. Seriously. He's an awesome guy.

Zahler is the best professor I've had in the honors college or elsewhere.  His lectures are engaging, interesting and insightful.  He encourages students to come up with creative paper topics and is willing to help develop ideas at office hours.  His comments are always extermely helpful.  Plus he's a real witty guy.

Great professor!! He loves what he's teaching, and loves the students. He's a really smart guy, and fun to debate with because he's very textbook about what you can and cannot argue based upon what you know and assume. I hope I can take more of his classes in the future. The final sucks though because it's hard =(
Good teacher, hard but just. I would recommend him.

Well… his lectures were boring, grading - harsh, and comments – unnecessary; but the worst thing is: he thinks that he works at the… Henry D. Clark Honors College!!! I think he needs to stop wasting my time and find a job somewhere else…)
There's a lot of reading and Zahler's a pretty demanding grader, but in the end he's just really good at getting his students to actually learn and remember and understand what he's teaching

Professor Zahler is a great lecturer, unfourtunately for those who are in the honors college and used to getting A's and high B's, only half the class gets them... sounds like he is great outside the HC though!

Zahler is great with his lectures, plus he's always making some sort of witty or comment or bursting out into strange accents.  He keeps things interesting.  He's not the best, but he's definately somewhere in the top.  My only complaint would be the amount of reading assigned, because it can be overwhelming, especially when you're trying to balance other classes with significant reading assignments.
Prof. Zahler was awesome. He actually made history interesting! I would highly reccomend taking a class from him if you have the chance, he's easy and fair.
Reuben's a friendly, energetic young professor who gives terrific lectures class after class. I give him a solid A.

One of the best professors on campus gives a damn about her students. This class that she taught was very inspiring and very eye-opening. There is one group project, and it sucks if you have terrible teammates who will drag your grade down.
Great professor and really cares about the students. I liked her so much I work for her now as a research assistant

This is by far the best class I have taken at UO! Dr. Zipay cares deeply about her students and wants them to be successful. The class material applies to so many parts of life. She listens to students and values their opinions and applies suggestions to the class. She creates a welcoming environment that makes participating easy!

Kate provides an excellent educational experience, that includes engaging lectures and relevant information. She deeply cares both about course content and her students, so rest assured you are in good hands. Kate is excellent at providing career insight and is very willing to engage in dialogue outside of class. 10/10 would recommend, LCB's best!

I love Nora. I specifically schedule my classes to have her as a teacher. She's very smart, helpful and overall awesome. She's so sweet and makes class fun. One of the best teachers I've ever had here!

Nora is great! Whenever I need help she is always there to help out. If you are struggling use her office hours! She is always understanding when people are late or cannot show up. She is an excellent teacher and person.

Nora is the best german teacher. If you want to have an awesome time learning german, take her. She wants students to succeed and will help you as much as she can if she is struggling. Sign up for her class, you won't regret it.
Nora is extremely enthusiastic and devoted to her class. I really appreciate her dedication and I learned so much.
Nora is am the sweetest instructor I've had for German so far. She has a sense of humor and brings joy to the classroom.

Nora is a wonderful teacher! I have learned so much in both her German 101 and 102 classes. She makes the class fun because she brings positive energy and she will brighten your day. I advise you to take her as a teacher.
She is very kind and helpful if you need it. She makes the class fun!

I've personally loved taking classes with Nora as a teacher. She is very helpful and is always available if you don't understand something. Just like with all classes you are expected to study outside of class and while that is necessary to pass that class, Nora is also very helpful with learning german.

I enjoyed the class. The teacher was friendly and I feel that I received a great introduction to German. I was also thrilled to have a native speaker. Obviously, learning a language takes discipline and I had to study good amount outside of class learning grammar rules and German is no piece of cake. Teacher was very committed and competent.
Worst teacher I have ever had.

Let me tell you why Nora is so horrible. She will tell us we have a quiz tomorrow and then e-mail us that night and say, "Oh I forgot heres the material I never taught you and it will be on the quiz tomorrow!" She has done this TWICE already. Also you can't understand a damn word she says in German because she doesn't enunciate. Never. Again.
Please take prof. Wang he is the best professor you will have at UO.
Hard class, great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He makes a very hard class doable. Very smart guy and good instructor, but the way his class is formatted makes it hard to understand things if you don't get it during class.
Professor Wang was really helpful, despite the class being difficult he made the process a lot less stressful.

Professor Zhi Wang is an awesome teacher, the only reason I got the grade that I did is because I didn't go to every class. He clearly explains everything and is very patient. He always knows what he is saying and is nice when explaining things to you. I learned a lot, do take because you will too.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is a super hard class, but Professor Wang is easily the best finance professor I've had at UO. He's the most willing to help you learn and understand the course and its applications. If you can, take the course from him. Go to office hours, study hard, and you will probably do better than I did.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's one of the nicest professors I've had. He gave candy out on Halloween. He changed homework due dates to help students on other midterms. He gets to the point during office hours and helps in coding. He did unexpectedly force us to present when last class he said we wouldn't. But very friendly and explains things well. Very good professor.

Zhi (Jay) is a great prof and knows what he's talking about. His lectures are awesome and he did a great job teaching FIN 380. Only reason he isnt getting a 5 star is because everytime you go to office hours it feels like he's trying to get you out of there as quick as possible. 40% Mid 40% final and he's a tough grader so study heavily.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: bad class. Don't take it.

He is an awesome finance teacher. He is extremely helpful in office hours and does not try to screw you over. He is passionate about what he is teaching and cracks really subtle yet hilarious jokes. I am hoping he is teaching more of the upper division finance classes so I can take him again.
I can't even process what that class just was. I feel like even he would fail the tests he wrote because they would be so confusing and his grading was so nit-picky.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is the most confusing math professor I've every had. Not only are the notes illegible, but they're inaccessible online. If you're sick and have to quarantine, good luck. When kids ask a question, he doesn't even know how to answer it. I've never heard a man complicate the area of a triangle until now. There aren't enough characters to say more
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: By the deadline to drop the class, more than half of the students in my class had dropped it. The lectures are a bit of a struggle to understand but if you're willing to ask questions and have him clarify things then they are bearable. HW load is average but you'll need a tutor. There has been a D or lower class average every test. Pray for curve.

Like many others are saying, this is the worst math teacher I have ever had. He is constantly second-guessing himself, loses his train of thought, and cannot talk to students. I've gotten tutoring for his class and even the answers my tutors come up with are wrong to him because I didn't notate it incredibly specifically. Don't take his classes.

I literally hate this class. This man is completely incapable of teaching and I'm pretty convinced I'm going to fail. He makes everything 300x more confusing than it needs to be. I've never had a teacher be so confusing for no reason. Would not recommend taking any class this man teaches.

He has such an unclear grading system, he just marks the whole thing wrong and gives no explanation. His lectures are tough as well. He has sloppy handwriting so when you don't understand what he's saying you can't look at his notes for much help. Would probably be much better in an in-person setting.

Professor Zou was the diamond in the rough of the UO Economics department. A great teacher who would draw up his lectures on the chalk board after looking at his phone for 5 minutes. He has passion and shows it within his lectures. He is always winning to help and is easily accessible outside of class. His tests weren't too hard, had note sheet.

Professor Zou is a very nice guy and easy to talk to, but his lectures are very boring and dry. All homework for this class is online and easy to do but the exams are hard mainly because the lectures are boring and not engaging. He does respond to emails very quickly if you do need help.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Zou is actually an insanely good professor for being so young. I would highly recommend taking this professor if you have to take Econ 311. I am not the smartest person at all but Professor You made this class and the topics so much more enjoyable and actually make sense. Take notes on everything he does and you will be just fine.

My only complaint for this class is that the lectures were painfully unengaging and therefore made it incredibly difficult to pay attention. This is of course only partly the profs fault as you can only make ec311 so interesting but nevertheless. Homeworks and tests were very easy but def just bite the bullet and buy Chegg, saves a lot of heartache

Marc is a helpful professor who is excited/enthusiastic about both the subject of Spanish and teaching in itself. He is fairly young and connects well with the students. He is very communicative and gives plenty of options to  do well in the class. This is my second term with him because, although he's not a native speaker, he knows how to teach.
Really nice guy, enthusiastic about Spanish and wants his students to do well. I highly recommend him! I am terrible at Spanish and actually did quite well to my surprise, but credit that to Marcos!

Marc is a really enthusiastic teacher. He obviously has fun at this job and loves the language and the culture of Spanish.  He's interesting and tries to make the whole class involved. He makes the students talk to each other everyday in every exercise and I think this is good. It forces everyone to use the language.
I had him over a year ago and he is by far the best spanish teacher I have had. He makes the whole class feel comfortable and you aren't afraid to speak up.

Marc is very helpful during class and responds well to e-mails.  He makes a difficult subject enjoyable to learn and is definitely the professor to take if you are worried about your Spanish abilities.
No Comments

Look honestly, Marcos is a good teacher. He's straightforward, he's not a super hard grader but he's not just going to let you coast. If you want to learn how to speak spanish, you should take him because the way he teaches the 100 level class is awesome.

Honestly the best Spanish teacher I've had at the university. He is so enthusiastic about teaching and does it in an effective way to boot. I strongly suggest anyone taking the 100 and 200 level courses to take him!

even though the information is interesting, any science lecture can't help but be a little dry. but whenever it starts sapping your will to live, professor zimmerman will revive you with his sense of humor. I think I had a crush on him
Great fun. Very wry sense of humor. He's kind of like the cool/crazy grandpa I wish I had.

A lot of my friends thought it was an awful class, but I really enjoyed it. I hate physics and science, but this class was thooo cooo'. I don't want to graduate without taking at least one more class from him. that's right.
One of my all time favorite prof's!  Love him!
terrible class, totally incomprehensible. funny teacher doesn't know how to teach though

who wouldn't want to check out the line spectra of hydrogen through a prism? comments like "now i need someone to come volunteer to blow up the room." however he moves very quickly, so reviewing slides is recommended.
best professor i have had yet.
Maybe he was a good teacher in the past but I have never been so bored in a lecture! His tests were awful and I didn't think he was a very big help at all. I didn't learn anything in this class.

BRILLIANT! Take this class for your science req and for fun. Lectures were always amusing and worth going to, but no biggie if you missed a lot. Make time to visit him in his office - he takes the time to get to know you, and thats a good thing! Funniest prof i've had, and also the oldest!
Best teacher I've had at UO so far.  Easy but you still have to do some work.
comments like "If you fall of the empire state building, no big. If you fall of the sun you have problems"
Very interesting, very easy.  Just do your homework and go to the lectures, and maybe you'll walk away with an A+ like I did.
Great class.  Great prof.  Can never go wrong taking a class from him as he is very clear and always there to help.
great class, fascinating topics, hard to understand concepts at times, needs a little spice in the class
HE ROCKS MY WORLD!
Took the whole sequence with this guy. Such a character! I aced the whole year!

what a boss, i loved every min i was in lecture with this guy...all you have to do is the work he assigns(which isnt much) and go to lecture, listen, read a bit(not a lot at all) and your set...good call for a new student
Zimmerman Rocks!!!
Great way to get science credits. Homework was easy. Should study well for the tests.
Bob has this weird accent, so that the words "special" and "spatial" sound exactly alike and you can't tell which one he's saying.
My favorite prof. I still joke about his Missourian accent with friends to this day!
Class was definatly challenging and sometimes you had no idea what he was talking about. But if you choose to take astronomgy, take it with him.
I hated this class. Yes, it was easy, but he was disorganized and confusing in his lectures.
No Comments
I LOVE STEVE!!!! STEVE RULES!!!
Zimmerman is awesome.  A little kooky, but I learned SO much from him.
No Comments
Excellent professor!
Great Prof, great guy
Zimmerman is an awesome guy.  Yeah, his joke are corney, but he is a good teach.
No Comments
No Comments

She is so nice and helpful! She's a really fair grader and does not mark off points usually if you mispell something or forget an accent. I would definitely recommend her! She made learning French fun and moderately easy!
She is really nice

Clear, relatively easy, fun, engaging. Enjoyed her class a lot and so will you if you take my advice. Step 1. Don't call her Mommy...too much. She gets annoyed. Step 2. If you're already set on calling her mommy, don't! Step 3. Please, please don't mention my name to her. We didn't end well. Step 4. Just sit back and enjoy the ride.
Great sense of humor! She made me enjoy coming to class and was very accommodating.

Loved having Aara for FR 202.  She is incredibly supportive, positive, and has a great sense of humor many other professors lack!  Her teaching style greatly lessens your anxiety over learning a new language, and she tries her best to make it more of an enjoyable experience than merely a hurdle to jump to complete your language requirements.

This is a great class. Professor Zunterstein is a very understanding and kind professor. The grading is pretty easy, and the rubrics are very clear and accessible. Very well organized! I would take another class from him.
The most lenient grader ever. Will give you 100s on every assignment if you give him a reason to. Super friendly and forgiving about late work.
he was really great. a very enthusiastic, passionate guy who cares about spanish. would definitely take again.

Professor Zunterstein was a very understanding professor. He gave a lot of extensions and understood when I was having a hard time with an assignment. He also gave a lot of good feedback with my assignments. You can tell he enjoys what he does!
Great professor, makes learning easy and fun. Very understanding.

I loved Alex’s class. He has been so accommodating and awesome, even with the class being asynchronous. Because it’s asynchronous it’s kind of teach yourself, but Alex answers emails very fast (even on the weekend) and is readily available if you want to meet with him on zoom.

My class was completely asynchronous, so I never actually met him. But, he still was incredible to have. There are a ton of assignments but most are complete/incomplete so there's not much stress. Gives reasonable feedback too, occasionally it can be kind of confusing but usually it's beneficial. Interesting readings too.

This was online/asynchronous, which is likely why I didn't enjoy it that much. He can give vague feedback, but is a good teacher. He is very understanding and gives extensions when needed, there are PLENTY of assignments so your grade doesn't count on a few things. We focused on 2 texts so we got the chance to really understand them. I'd recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: LOVED ALEX. I am so sad I won't have him as a professor next term. He was so caring and understanding about everything. I am really not great at Spanish but he graded so fair and really helped me understand. I had a horrible experience in 103 so this was such a relief. TAKE SPANISH WITH ALEX
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Truly a wonderful professor, one of the best I've had. After a horrible experience in 103, Professor Zunterstein was refreshing. He truly wants you to succeed, and participate but does not force you to speak in Spanish if you don't understand. His teaching style pushes that you do your best to speak up, or you may fall behind on personal immersion.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Alex is so great! He truly cares about each of his students and wants everyone to do well. He is kind and understanding. There is a lot of writing, but he was a fair grader and gives really good feedback.

He speaks so quickly and gets easily off topic. While open to helping, he should really just spend more time in class actually teaching instead of just talking at the students and hoping they retain the information...

Alex is such a sweetheart. He wants to work with you and want to give you a great grade, but he does expect you to put in the elbow grease. This class was pretty straightforward, and I really enjoyed having Alex as a professor. Also, he talks a lot, but in a good way.
Wonderful teacher. Very clear in his teachings and makes you excited about the subject. Increases your confidence in writing so much!

Great teacher, very helpful and open to talking outside of class and creates a friendly and open atmosphere in his class, most of the readings were in English though which makes the writing a little tougher.

Very energetic and friendly. However, I felt his class was much too easy, I didn't really learn that much that I didn't know before. He is a fair grader, the class is just taught at too slow of a pace.

At first, I was a little worried. He came across as kind of an OCD Oddball; however, as the term progressed, he turned out to be an excellent teacher. Not to mention, SOOO NICE! He was very passionate about the language, but he did understand that it was difficult to learn for some & tried his best to help his students get the best grade possible!

Can't say i got bored in his class. His hyperness is unmatched. I come from a school where the foreign language program absolutely sucks. He's the first spanish teacher I've had that knew the material and could teach it well, then again that could be the difference between HS and college. I will try to take him again in future spanish classes.
Very approachable, best and most helpful spanish teacher I have had yet!

There is nothing bad to say about this teacher. He is SO organized, so innocent and kind and is understanding of every student. Class can get a little boring but thats just because its so long. You write two essays and he is a fair grader!

poor quality of teaching. speaks fast in spanish only, and does not answer questions. He stands in front of class and gives a speech, rarely involving the students and then expects students to figure out the material on their own. Most boring class I've ever taken, and while he is probably a nice guy, he comes across as incompetent and boring.
Best Spanish teacher ever!!!!
Great Spanish professor.  He really cares about how students are learning. Fair grader. Definitely would recommend.

He is so great! accepts late work! always kind, smiley and energetic! super helpful and will talk to you in english if you want, not stingy or unreasonable, fair grader, flexible and easy to understand and work with!

Energetic without being excessive.  He always has a smile and is willing to help. The class atmosphere he creates is good too because he does not call on people randomly. This is nice because it allows people time to relax and think about things instead of always feeling pressured.

Nice guy, very like-able. Will help you if you need help and ask for it. Still don't think I got what I wanted to out of the class, but I do believe this is the Romance Languages Depts fault. He's not the easiest grader, and the pop quizzes are hard.
Best spanish prof ever.

He may be a nice guy but I really didn´t feel I was getting what was needed out of the class, not only was he difficult to understand the majority of the time but the classes didn´t seem very well used. I ended up dropping out of this class and waiting a year to take it with a professor I could really learn from.

hes great. the fact that he isnt foreign makes it so easy to understand him and learn from him. with any class, what you put into it is what you get out of it. his pop quizzes become expected when you understand the routine of the class.

He's the nicest professor I have ever had. He may be a little easy but we're in college, if we want to learn we learn, if we don't we don't. He's a great teacher and I have learned a lot in his class because I want to and because he has a lot of clarity. He's a great teacher and you can learn a lot if you want. I recommend him for sure.

He is reallky helpful.  He seems to know how to teach Spanish to cater to how students learn Spanish.  He is a pretty easy grader if you do the work and he is really nice.  Sometimes he is really akward, but that is what makes him so great.
Great Job!!!!!!!
Very easy grader so the class was enjoyable but I probably didn't learn that much. I loved his personality!

He is very easy, and like the other comments say, lacks discipline, which is a good thing or a bad thing depending on who you are. Easy grader, you can get away with anything. He's funny in an awkward way, he gives a nervous laugh after everything he says.

Although I agree that he's very nice and helpful he lacks discipline so it makes it easy to go through the class without learning much.  If you are the type of person who needs a challenge to learn I would suggest finding another teacher.  But if you are just taking the class because it's required or you are incredibley self motivated go for it.
SUCH a nice guy, always willing to answer and questions, and very lenient with grading.  I would highly recommend taking a class with him.

such a nice teacher. very helpful and very clear. easy-going and very friendly! i definitely recommend taking a course through him. not to mention he isn't too tough of a grader and wants his students to succeed
